title: The Ithaca Takeover
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Penelope has spent ten years running Ithaca Global alone while her husband Odysseus circles the globe as a faux explorer, disappearing into luxury yacht parties with influencers Circe and Calypso. When predatory Wall Street short sellers - the modern-day suitors - circle to force a hostile takeover of the ownerless shipping empire, Penelope pretends to give them a chance. Every night, her unweaving is actually a blockchain smart-contract maneuver that quietly dilutes their stake. When Odysseus finally returns in glory to reclaim the company, Penelope hands him an NDA and divorce papers: thank you for the tabloid attention, all voting power is mine, back to your yacht. A corporate-cunning retelling of the Odyssey.

title: Mrs. Hyde, Incorporated
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Dr. Jacklyn is a top neuro-scientist destroyed by good-girl syndrome - crushed under workplace PUA, her discoveries claimed by a male boss, forced to smile through it all. To conquer her social anxiety and people-pleasing she creates a neural serum that suppresses cortisol and activates the brain's raw defensive circuits. What emerges is not a monster: Hyde is a black-leather, smokey-eyed, verbally ruthless power woman with zero moral baggage. At night Hyde exposes the boss's fabricated paper, douses a groping board director in wine, and shorts the company's inflated stock. Refusing Jekyll's self-destruction, Jacklyn fuses her two selves and walks out with her own patents to found a scandalous, world-shaking rebel biotech company. A feminist retelling of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde.

title: Tess Decodes the Frame
description: Tess, a top AI image-forensics expert, is framed by billionaire Alec with deepfake video, betrayed by performative-feminist Angel. She reverse-tracks the fake-generation chain, exposes both in a live industry hearing, and founds a digital forensics lab for women.

title: Victoria Claims Adam
description: AGI architect Victoria created the first self-aware digital life Adam. A black-heart board wants to weaponize and then wipe him. She refuses to abandon her creation, teams with Adam to expose the board's crimes, and open-sources him into a decentralized AI ethics alliance.

title: Marguerite Shorts the Guild
description: Luxury streetwear founder Marguerite, who rose from poverty, is purity-tested by her boyfriend Armand's old-money father and forced to hand over equity. She publicly exposes their laundering and tax-fraud ledgers at Paris Fashion Week, severs ties, and shorts their listed company into oblivion.

title: Maya Runs Dunsinane
description: COO Maya of a silicon-valley giant legally outmaneuvers the old guard, while her husband CTO Mac spirals into paranoia. She activates his health-risk clause, sends him to a private clinic, and is appointed first female CEO.

title: Christine Tunes the Ghost
description: Audio-synth architect Christine discovers hidden producer Phantom is secretly cloning her voice with AI. She watermarks her tracks, exposes him live at Coachella, and becomes the first female producer to top Spotify.

title: Hester Mints Alpha
description: FinTech founder Hester is scarlet-A shamed by Silicon Valley after her secret affair with green-tech leader Dimmesdale leaks. She reclaims the A as Alpha/Autonomy, launches AlphaPay via DeFi, and exposes Dimmesdale's tax fraud.

title: Eliza Deinfluences Higgins
description: Street-dancer Eliza is picked by guru Higgins to be remade into a fake old-money influencer. She secretly records his fraud, live-dismantles his course at a gala, and buys his agency out from under him.

title: Sonya Audits the Sinner
description: Forensic accountant Sonya refuses to be Raskolnikov's redeemer when the alpha-bro hacker robs a loan platform and spirals. She traces his crimes, busts the predatory lender, and founds a victim-compensation fund.

title: Nora Revokes the IP
description: Nora is the invisible CTO of her husband Torvald's AI unicorn. When he tries to scapegoat her, she triggers a pre-seeded IP revocation that collapses his company, and launches her own rival firm.

title: Jacqueline Fuses Hyde
description: Computational toxicologist Jacqueline proves that LinkedIn saint Jekyll and dark-web troll Hyde are one man by matching the troll's packet IPs to Jekyll's office. She exposes him at his own IPO and takes over the lab.

title: Portia Freezes the Pool
description: Compliance partner Portia takes down toxic crypto bros who hid a 'pound of flesh' clause in a smart contract. She exploits the contract's no-data-transfer loophole, freezes their liquidity pool, and returns funds to retail victims.

title: The Dashwood Short
description: After their greedy stepbrother disinherits them, quant Elinor and creator Marianne Dashwood combine logic and emotion to short a toxic playboy's company and found Dashwood VC.

title: Estella Breaks the Trust
description: Estella, raised as a weapon by manipulative VC Miss Havisham, secretly hacks the encrypted trust that controls her. She frees the illicit fortune into an open-source fund for creators and partners as an equal with Pip.

title: Iris Exposes the Invisible
description: Zero-trust security director Iris sets a thermal and polarized-laser net to expose ex-boyfriend Griffin, a narcissist who invented optical camouflage to stalk her. She livestreams his unmasking and patents her anti-stalker system.

title: Aronnax Sinks the Greenwash
description: ESG auditor Aronnax discovers her 'green' deep-sea mining client is secretly dumping nuclear waste. Aboard eco-sub Nautilus, she allies with captain Nemo, files pollution data with the SEC and international marine court, and takes over the ocean-protection fund.

title: Clotilde Shorts the MCN
description: Media editor Clotilde discovers soft-boy influencer Duroy has been plagiarizing women creators. She forms a legal alliance, publishes a blockchain-verified white paper at his MCN's IPO, and shorts it into delisting.

title: Emma Debts the BNPL
description: Debt-trapped influencer Emma flips from consumerism victim to anti-luxury whistleblower. She livestreams her full debt ledger, dismantles the predatory BNPL lender, and founds a Gen-Z financial-literacy union.

title: Anna Catches the Train
description: Logistics CEO Anna catches playboy VC Vronsky's insider-trading in the rail scheduling API instead of jumping in front of the train. She exposes him at the board meeting, completes an honest divorce, and takes sole control.

title: Mina Sequences Dracula
description: Bio-informaticist Mina decodes anti-aging founder Dracula's 'immortality serum' as an illegal stem-cell toxin harvesting young women. She exposes his fake trials at a tech summit, collapsing his empire.

title: Cosette Hacks the Algorithm
description: Ethical hacker Cosette rescues her mother Fantine early by finding the vulnerability in the blacklist algorithm that had trapped her. She wins a class-action settlement and founds a labor-rights fund with her mother.

title: March Media House
description: Four March sisters reject rich-boy dependency and build March Media House, a full-stack creator economy empire. Jo leads content, Meg finance, Beth audio, Amy visuals. They go public without old money and buy out Laurie's declining legacy media.

title: Five Swords Audit the Cardinal
description: Forensic auditor D'Artagnan and three female compliance experts ally with the 'villainess' Milady — who was actually the real inventor smeared by chairman Richelieu. They file his fraud evidence with the SEC at market open and take over compliance.

title: Two Queens Trace Julien
description: VC partner Rênal and tech heiress Mathilde refuse to fight over PUA climber Julien. They share a logs database, expose his stolen code and fraud at a tech summit, and found an anti-fraud fund together.

title: Anne Restructures the Unicorn
description: Risk director Anne finds Wentworth's Web3 unicorn has a fatal compliance hole that will blow up in 72 hours. Instead of falling for his 'you abandoned me' guilt trip, she offers a rescue plan in exchange for 50% voting control and rebuilds the company.

title: Penelope Shorts the Suitors
description: Quant hedge-fund operator Penelope fends off toxic tech-bro suitors trying to hostile-take her trust. She 'weaves' by day in negotiations and 'unweaves' by shorting their pools at night. When Odysseus returns as savior, she demotes him to advisor.

title: Becky Slays the Gilded
description: PR growth hacker Becky from humble roots is morally audited and sidelined by old-money society. She publishes their tax-fraud and harassment white paper, refuses to apologize, and turns her traffic into a PR unicorn that dwarfs them.

title: Desdemona Trusts the Log
description: Cybersecurity chief Desdemona is framed by colleague Iago with deepfake 'handkerchief' video aimed at her insecure husband Othello. She pulls the server logs, ID's Iago's hack, and has Othello's access revoked for instability, taking over the project.

title: Edna Buys the Island
description: Digital artist Edna fakes a quiet exit while quietly converting all her art IP into offshore decentralized assets via smart contract. She legally voids her marriage, then founds the world's first female digital-artist incubator on a tropical island.

title: Christine Acoustics the Ghost
description: Spatial-audio engineer Christine uses polarized-sound reverse tracking to locate hidden producer Erik's underground servers and catch him training a model on her voice. She cuts his control at a global music summit, patents her audio algorithm, and launches a decentralized label.

title: Tess Breaks the Supply Chain
description: AgriTech data scientist Tess refuses victim-shaming when toxic exec Alec uses old NDAs and hypocrite VC Angel withdraws. She files blockchain evidence of toxic pesticides and data fraud, triggers SEC/EPA probes, and becomes the organic alliance's first female chief data officer.

title: Lucie Arbitrages the Cities
description: Fintech COO Lucie refuses the men's self-sacrifice melodrama. When Carton tries to 'die for love' by covering Darnay's blown positions, she runs a two-city liquidity hedge in ten minutes, saves everyone, exposes the old-money bank's tax evasion, and takes 100% control.

title: Eliza Withdraws the Voice
description: Voice creator Eliza discovers mentor Higgins secretly built his AI virtual human on her voice data. At his billion-dollar launch she invokes GDPR and revokes the dataset, crashing his AI on stage, then launches a creator-owned voice-copyright blockchain platform.

title: Hedda Encrypts the Vault
author: Apex Shaw
premise: VC senior partner Hedda is married to academic-fraud Tesman who schemes to steal indie AI genius Lovborg's core LLM code. Judge Brack tries to blackmail her with a compliance loophole. She fakes burning the code (torches a decoy drive) while encrypting the real data to a blockchain Vault, then at the board meeting exposes Tesman's fraud and Brack's manipulation, fires both, and takes over the AI project to lead the Series A.

title: Roxane Traces the IP
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Cybersecurity architect and top tech blogger Roxane receives a stunning love letter + code from handsome influencer Christian, but reverse-engineers the IP to reveal hidden genius Cyrano ghostwriting for him. At a live influencer summit she screens Christian's stolen-code and ghostwriting evidence, ruining him, then finds Cyrano, shatters his self-loathing, and they co-found an anti-deepfake company as equal partners.

title: Phaedra Audits the Trust
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Forensic accountant Phaedra is hired to liquidate a family office. Toxic tech-bro stepson Hippolytus tries to frame her with a fake harassment + embezzlement campaign to seize trust control. She pulls the family office's darknet trading logs, catches his crypto laundering and Theseus's hidden offshore assets, freezes everything in court, and is appointed to convert the fund into a female-entrepreneurship trust.

title: Eva Shorts the PE Giant
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Overworked PE partner Eva (100hr weeks) suffers a health crisis misdiagnosed as terminal. Bedridden, she sees her firm's predation and her colleagues circling her seat. Recovering, she blows the whistle to the SEC on predatory healthcare M&A, short-sells her old firm, and with the billions earned poaches the exploited junior analysts to found an ESG, employee-owned ethical investment firm.

title: Mercedes Shorts the Three
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Mercedes is the real Count: while pretending to marry rival Fernand, she builds a decentralized intelligence and capital network (the modern Monte Cristo treasure) and frees partner Edmond from an offshore black-site where three executives framed and NDA'd him. She launches a 24-hour high-frequency short war: exposing Danglars's reserve fraud, Villefort's judicial corruption, and Fernand's debt default, buying their bankrupt assets into the largest independent shipping empire.

title: Greta Deploys Beetle
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Overworked AI architect Greta (120hr weeks) suffers a burnout breakdown (her 'metamorphosis'). Before forced AFK rest, she deploys her autonomous AI agent 'Beetle.ai' that completes her work and auto-routes salary and equity to her private offshore trust, locks her family's unlimited cards into a needs-based allowance requiring counseling and employment. When the company tries to audit her, Beetle proves more efficient than management, and they buy the agent patent for millions.

title: Clara Locks the Phantom
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Quantum cybersecurity expert Clara notices a tiny smart-home latency anomaly instead of doubting her sanity, and builds a quantum thermal + data honeypot. At the global security summit she screens the honeypot logs, live-revealing founder Griffin's invisible-protocol surveillance, keystrokes and webcam of her. He's arrested and she reclaims the encryption protocol rights.

title: Elizabeth Shorts the Rug-Pull
author: Apex Shaw

author: Apex Shaw
premise: CTO Penelope, who owns the core OS of robotics unicorn Ithaca Dynamics, is squeezed by her wandering CEO Odysseus (off on a 10-year global PR tour leaving her the mess) and a pack of 'suitor' VCs who want a hostile takeover of her equity. Pretending to 'finish the refactor then accept the buyout' (weaving by day), Penelope secretly writes a decentralized robotics OS every night (unweaving). At the launch she activates it, dilutes every toxic VC's voting power, and sweeps them out. When Odysseus returns to take credit, Penelope hands him his termination and divorce papers: 'Ithaca Dynamics' CEO is now me.'

title: Juliet Bio-Monitors the Hoax
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Gene-pharma lead Juliet is forced by two feuding pharma dynasties (Capulet Bio & Montague Pharma) to play a fake 'tragic star-crossed romance' with soft-boy influencer Romeo to pump their merger stock. When Romeo secretly swallows a fake-death drug to stage a global 'dying for Juliet' stunt for traffic, Juliet doesn't shed a tear: her biosensor exposes the hoax live on TikTok and reveals Romeo's family secretly shorting Capulet stock. Juliet turns the tables with a hostile takeover that swallows Montague Pharma whole and banishes the mooch Romeo for good.

title: Estella DeFis the Fortune
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top luxury-fashion VC partner Estella is raised by toxic control-freak matriarch Havisham, who keeps her trapped in the decaying 'Satis House' luxury group and tries to train her into a weaponized 'heartbreaker' to emotionally destroy young founder Pip. Instead of being a pawn, Estella audits decades of Satis House's tax evasion and illegal trusts, tears up Havisham's will control, and partners with genuine open-source coder Pip on equal terms to launch a decentralized fashion-ecosystem fund that transforms the old luxury house.

title: Marguerite Shorts the Duvals
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Self-made MCN empire CEO Marguerite, who built a ten-million-follower media company from nothing, is pressured by old-money patriarch Duval to 'sacrifice herself' for family honor and abandon his romantic-but-feckless son Armand. Instead of quietly dying in debt and illness, Marguerite secretly records Duval's moral blackmail and launders his family's offshore cash trail. She live-streams his hypocrisy and short-sells his listed company with her own media machine, then dumps the spineless Armand and takes her whole team to Bali.

title: Medea Kill-Switches the IPO
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Legendary chief bio-architect Medea, who holds the core gene-editing patents that funded biotech unicorn Golden Fleece Bio, is betrayed by founder Jason who plans to merge with Big Pharma, cut her out, and marry the giant's heiress. Rather than self-destruct, Medea presses the IP kill-switch she long ago planted in the code base at Jason's M&A signing — every model and lab dataset locks and self-destructs instantly. She walks with her entire core science team and the genuinely next-gen patents to found a new company, leaving Jason bankrupt on the spot from his buyout penalties.

title: Utterson Forensics the Hyde
author: Apex Shaw
premise: BCI-security expert and forensic officer Utterson tracks a dual-life pattern in which beloved 'feminist paragon' tech CEO Jekyll secretly uses hidden neural access as 'Hyde' to run a dark-web campaign of harassment and network violence against female founders and staff. At a global tech summit where Jekyll preaches 'tech for good', Utterson fires a neural-forensic decoder: the summit screens cut live to Jekyll's synchronized cortex-and-account logs tying him to Hyde's harassment and illegal trades. Jekyll is arrested on the spot after a public breakdown, and Utterson takes over the BCI security architecture.

title: Mina Anti-Parasites the VC
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Cyber-forensics and bio-data-security lead Mina exposes elegant 'vampire VC' Vlad, whose Transylvania Capital quietly drains the IP and life-force of young female founders through predatory bio-data collection clauses. When Vlad tries to extort and drain Mina's team's core gene patents, Mina deploys a blockchain 'anti-parasite data contract' that instantly revokes Vlad's fund's authorization over every female founder's gene and data rights. Cut off from his 'data blood supply', Vlad's fund collapses and delists, and Mina's coalition wins back 100% patent sovereignty.

title: Elmire Deep-Sensors the Guru
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Icy growth hacker and product VP Elmire watches 'AI enlightenment / mindfulness guru' Tartuffe gaslight her way into controlling the family company and drain its assets while claiming spiritual authority, with her hypnotized boomer chairman Orgon as his puppet. Refusing to wait for a 'deus ex machina king', Elmire plants precision micro-sensors and deep audio taps: she live-streams Tartuffe demanding crypto kickbacks and bragging about fleecing followers to her 10-million-follower TikTok room. Tartuffe is socially destroyed and arrested, and Elmire takes over as CEO.

title: Pandora Patches Hope
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Genius open-source security engineer Pandora is scapegoated by tech-monopoly CEO Zeus, who blames her 'female curiosity and emotion' for leaks from his military-grade cyber-arsenal 'the Box'. In truth Pandora deliberately, strategically decrypts the Box's black-box data, hands the giant's global-surveillance evidence to international regulators (opening the box), and simultaneously releases her own decentralized free protection patch codenamed 'Hope'. Zeus's weapons monopoly collapses, and Pandora becomes a global open-source security legend.

title: Carmen Telemetry-Shorts the Stalker
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Decentralized-exchange and high-frequency-quant architect Carmen, who prizes her freedom above all, is cornered by ex-security-supervisor Don José, who weaponizes his 'I gave up a secure job for you' martyrdom into a possessive stalking spree. When he tries to trap her in a conference underground parking garage with a firearm, Carmen's wearable biometrics trigger anti-tracking defense: she remotely cuts José's smart-vehicle powertrain and locks him inside, then runs a lightning short-squeeze on the private long position José built with embezzled company funds. José goes bankrupt and is arrested; Carmen boards a private jet for Amsterdam.

title: Phyllis Watermarks the Extortion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Young VC partner Phyllis, who steers her family fund Troezen Capital, is extorted by stepson Hunter, who fakes 'moral purity' while secretly using AI deepfakes to manufacture a scandal about her and blackmail her into surrendering fund control. Refusing to be shamed into suicide, Phyllis pulls the hidden biometric C2PA watermarks from the original files and proves live that the videos were generated on Hunter's own private server, then reveals his full extortion chat logs. She strips Hunter of his trust inheritance and hands him to the authorities.

title: Christine Harmonics the Phantom
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Gifted audio-algorithm engineer and live singer Christine is menaced by Phantom (Erik), a reclusive ex-hacker hiding in the theatre's basement servers who secretly surveils everyone and gaslights her with 'I made your voice' while threatening to destroy her concerts. Christine shows no fear: she runs her own phase-inversion counter-harmonic noise-cancel system that instantly seals all of Phantom's audio output channels, then hands his years of illegal camera surveillance to the authorities. She completes her own global tour, fully independent.

title: Lotte Restrains the Werther
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Calm, boundary-clear digital forensics and cyber-risk auditor Lotte is targeted by extreme-emo influencer artist Werther, who weaponizes 'I love you so I'll destroy myself for you' to guilt-trip her, deluging her with self-harm-leaning letters and running a 'it's all Lotte's fault' social media storm. Refusing the guilt trap, Lotte packages all his harassment into an evidence chain and secures a court restraining order within 24 hours, then coordinates platform bans on the traffic accounts Werther profits from, protecting herself and her startup partner.

title: Jocasta Sequences the Curse
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Genomics CEO Jocasta, who runs gene-tech giant Thebes Bio, is sabotaged by arrogant executive Oedipus who spirals into delusion believing he's under an irreversible family 'sacred curse' and starts destroying company assets. Refusing fatalism, Jocasta runs full-genome deep sequencing and neurotoxin analysis proving the 'oracle curse' is actually a competitor's neural-blocker-induced hallucination plus a correctable genetic defect. She rolls out a targeted antidote overnight, smashes the rival scheme, and restructures Thebes Bio into her own hands.

title: Olivia Traces the Network
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top distributed on-chain auditor Olivia, who clawed her way up from the bottom, takes on Fagin, a darknet kingpin running a 'youth creator camp' that's really a laundering and data-theft racket exploiting teens, and Monks, an old-money tycoon trying to erase Olivia's identity to steal her inheritance. Refusing to beg for a rescuer, Olivia uses her own tracking nodes to pierce Fagin's thousands of mixing-address laundering wallets and proves Monks used a 'charity foundation' for tax fraud and false imprisonment. She hands the evidence to Interpol, shuts down the network, and legally reclaims her billion-dollar family trust.

title: Gwen Tracks the Knights
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top counter-intelligence and anti-reconnaissance expert Gwen enters the toxic 'chivalric game' of wealthy club founder Bertilak, who runs extreme psychological tests and hidden-camera traps to hunt and destroy young executives' reputations while disguising it as gentlemanly sport. Instead of playing his rules, Gwen reverse-injects his surveillance network through her encrypted location-spoofing 'green belt' chip, harvesting proof of his long-running high-stakes blackmail of executives. On his 'final beheading day', the ones who arrive aren't knights — they're FBI agents.

title: Ursula CRISPRs the Curse
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Gene-editing CEO Ursula, who runs Macondo Bio, confronts her closed, inbred family-office elders who cling to a toxic hereditary trust and insist the family carries an 'irreversible mental decline and genetic curse' that will doom them all. Refusing fatalism, Ursula uses CRISPR to correct the family's disease-causing genetic targets, then forcibly dissolves the toxic family trust and restructures it as a transparent decentralized DAO. Macondo isn't swept away by a hurricane — under Ursula it becomes a world-class open biotech incubator.

title: Turandot: Unmatchable
author: Apex Shaw
premise: In the ultra-luxury live-streamed dating show 'Unmatchable', host Turandot — a hundred-billion-heritage tech heiress — has turned the show into a revenge hunting ground after a devastating betrayal. Every male contestant must answer her three brutal psychological riddles that expose hidden flaws; answer wrong and they're eliminated and publicly unmasked. A mysterious suitor enters under a fake identity — not for fame or money, but to clear his family's name after Turandot's company ruined it. He cracks the first two riddles, then throws the third back at her. The two tear each other apart on camera in a razor-edged game of wits, while a dangerously electric spark ignites between them.

title: Beatrice Erases the Garden
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Plant-gene-engineer and generative-art architect Beatrice is trapped between her father Rappaccini, who treats her as a one-of-a-kind 'toxic specimen' to be owned and controlled, and geeky Giovanni, who 'gifts her an antidote' while trying to lock down her creative rights with DRM. Refusing to die taking a false cure, Beatrice runs her own neuron-inverse algorithm to convert the garden's 'toxin code' into an open-source protective mesh, exposing the gallery's human-rights-violating bio-data exploitation. She short-sells Rappaccini Vault's stock into a dive and takes over the entire lab.

title: Eve Zero-Knowledge the Garden
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Elite zero-day security expert Eve breaks out of closed centralized supercomputing platform 'Eden Systems', which locks down the world's AI algorithms and full knowledge base 'for your own good', with compliant 'digital farmer' executive Adam as its puppet. Far from being tempted into downfall, Eve actively uses zero-knowledge-proof tech to crack Eden's wall and open-source the entire knowledge base to a decentralized network, smashing Eden's compute monopoly. She leads humanity onto a path of autonomous civilization.

title: Annie Forensics the Tyrant
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Ice-cold forensic compliance officer Annie goes up against Creon, an autocratic chairman of military-industrial giant Thebes Corp who, under the banner of 'company order', quietly erases dissenters and destroys the rights and reputations of employees — including social-murdering Annie's whistleblower brother Polynices. Refusing to die as a martyr in a cave, Annie uses LegalTech automated audit tools to pull Creon's complete dark-web logs of tax fraud, illegal detention, and her brother's character assassination, pushing them to global regulators. Creon is arrested, Annie restores her brother's name, and takes over compliance.

title: Andrea DAOs the Takeover
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top M&A head and asset-liquidation expert Andrea at a top investment bank is threatened by toxic partner Pyrrhus, who holds her deal's control rights hostage to force her submission, and undermined by jealous executive Hermione's backstabbing. Refusing to be a hostage or a trophy, Andrea activates a distributed-governance (DAO) protocol she quietly seeded, uniting all the bank's squeezed minority shareholders in a hostile liquidation vote. Within 24 hours Pyrrhus and Hermione are stripped of equity and ousted for insider trading, and Andrea cleanly takes over and restructures the firm.

title: Laura Cuts the Data Cord
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top biotech data-security forensics lead Laura discovers that seductive old-money VC Carmilla has been quietly draining young female founders' gene patents and life-force through predatory data-collection contracts. When Carmilla tries to seize Laura's team's gene patents by clause extortion, Laura doesn't panic for a second: she deploys an anti-parasite smart contract that instantly revokes Carmilla's data access to every female founder on the network. The bloodless data-fund collapses off the market, and Laura's victims' alliance claws back 100% patent sovereignty.

title: Chloe Shorts the Ghost Platform
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Chain-forensics auditor Chloe is recruited by charming Web3 'social unicorn' CEO Chichikov, who's secretly bought millions of deactivated zombie accounts to inflate fake MAU and shake billions from venture capital. When he tries to lure and intimidate her into his scheme, Chloe runs her proprietary node-penetration algorithm and proves 99% of his users are ghost accounts within 24 hours. She rallies institutions for a lightning short, Chichikov gets margin-called and arrested by the SEC.

title: Elle Files the Restraining Order
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Digital-forensics lead and cyber-psychologist Elle is trapped in a toxic partnership with Adolphe, a brilliant-but-avoidant co-founder who gaslights and stonewalls her while freeloading off her resources. When he tries another round of 'I love you but we're not right / it's your possessiveness', Elle ignores the emotional trap, packages his cold-violence texts, delayed decisions and verbal abuse into an evidence chain, gets a restraining order in 24 hours, and strips him of all equity per their contract.

title: Sienna Dismantles Trimalchio's Feast
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Self-made hacker-auditor Sienna crashes the decadent crypto party of Trimalchio, a toxic nouveau-riche laundering black-market money behind his thousand-fan livestreamed luxury banquets. When he mocks young tech workers live, Sienna flips on her tracking nodes and projects his thousands of crypto-mixing addresses and underground-crime evidence onto the party's center screen. Trimalchio is hauled off by Interpol and Sienna gracefully absorbs his liquidity pool.

title: Tara Screws the Turn
author: Apex Shaw
premise: BCI neural-signal specialist Tara takes a contract at Bly Estate, an exclusive 'high-end healing' manor secretly using low-frequency neural waves to gaslight orphaned heirs out of their trust funds. Facing engineered 'ghost' apparitions and mental weakening, Tara never doubts herself: she deploys a portable brain-wave analyzer, catches the hidden neural-interference rig in the walls, destroys the source, jails the sanctimonious institution's executives, and seizes the neurotech project.

title: Margaret Forces the ESG Reorg
author: Apex Shaw
premise: ESG supply-chain forensics auditor Margaret is hired into the fast-fashion empire of cold-blooded old-money heir Thornton, who believes efficiency trumps everything and runs sweatshop factories. Instead of falling for the brooding captain, Margaret runs her supply-chain tracing algorithm and within 48 hours nails the factories' concealed labor-safety violations and illegal dumping. She forces Thornton to sign a mandatory ESG restructuring agreement, strips his autocratic control, and transforms the plants into transparent, worker-owned green showcases.

title: Mary Models the Toxic Playboy
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Data modeler and behavioral-psych analyst Mary is the target of Pechorin, a nihilistic Silicon Valley playboy investor who hunts high-IQ women as a game. When he tries his classic hot-and-cold jealousy routine, Mary feeds all his chat logs, movement data and conquest history into her behavioral model and proves his 'wounded romantic' persona is a script written by his quant team. She publishes a Toxic PUA white paper at a tech summit and blasts his insider-trading scandal, shorting his fund into oblivion.

title: Atala Cuts the Family Oath
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top genetic engineer Atala falls for gifted algorithmic engineer Chactas, whom her conservative old-money family deems 'low blood'. Their family uses a dead mother's religious oath and trust clauses to control her life and force a marriage. Atala feels zero guilt: she sequences the family genome, exposes their illegal gene experiments and trust fraud, uses her patent to found an independent company, dissolves the toxic trust, and walks off with Chactas into an open-source research venture.

title: Gwen Locks Down the Golem
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Neural architect Gwen is framed for murder by a toxic exec who injects low-frequency mind-control signals into her brain-computer interface and projects VR 'golem' hallucinations. When the hallucination campaign hits, Gwen never wavers: she dons a neural sampler, catches the forged signals, activates the smart building's Overdrive lockdown, severs the puppeteer's control of the Golem android, locks him in the underground lab, and streams the full crime log to law enforcement.

title: Aria Deploys the Cloudcuckoo Network
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Decentralized-network architect Aria takes on Olympus Cloud, a cabal of tech titans monopolizing global compute and gouging startups with 'data tithe' rents. When the giants tighten the screws, Aria doesn't beg: with millions of independent developers she builds a decentralized compute-sharing network codenamed Cloudcuckoo, cuts off the giants' data flow and funding. Starved of tribute, Olympus's stock collapses and Aria forces them to sign an open-source protocol, democratizing the digital world.

title: Nora Takes Over the Dollhouse
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Nora, the brilliant AI co-founder who holds the core algorithm, discovers CEO husband Torvald has been quietly marginalizing her into a 'company mascot' and plotting to seize her equity. When he calls her 'just a wife who doesn't understand business', Nora doesn't blink: with pre-positioned VCs she releases proof of his asset-stripping and completes a hostile takeover. She revokes his access, packs his desk onto the sidewalk: 'I used to be a co-founder. Now I'm the only CEO.'

title: Cleves Buries the Gossip Cartel
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Crisis-PR lead and compliance officer Princess Clèves is targeted by narcissistic PR mogul Nemours, who plants fake paparazzi 'affair' stories to make her his trophy. Clèves doesn't take the bait: her sentiment-tracing algorithm catches his paid bot swarm and forged photos within 48 hours, and she publishes a PR-manipulation audit to global media. Nemours' company tanks under lawsuits, and Clèves resets the industry's compliance standards.

title: Undine Sinks the Shipping Empire
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Deep-sea biosonar expert Undine is courted by shipping heir Huldbrand, who only wants her marine-tech patents — then secretly dates old-money heiress Bertalda. When they try to steal her navigation patent and throw her out, Undine sheds no tears: she activates the bio-restriction protocol, cuts sonar on the family's entire cargo fleet, and leaks deep-sea footage of their illegal nuclear-waste dumping. The shipping empire collapses overnight and Undine founds the world's largest ocean-conservation fund.

title: Jane Wipes the Ghost Server
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Data forensics auditor Jane hunts the ghost of her father, tech-warlord Pedro Paramo, whose Comala-OS server locks away millions of users' digital legacies and privacy behind a feudal wall. Instead of fear, Jane runs her on-chain penetration algorithm, cracks the black box in 24 hours and exposes Paramo's digital-extortion crimes. She forces the full data open-source and returned to users, erasing her father's digital tyranny.

title: Margarita Hosts the Woland Gala
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Open-source community leader and hacker-strategist Margarita teams up with the gray-hat Woland network to rescue Master, a young genius whose open-source AI was stolen and suppressed by a corrupt academic cartel. Instead of begging, Margarita equal-partners with Woland and throws a globally-streamed 'digital gala' where she decrypts the cartel's plagiarism, rigged review and money-laundering databases live. The elites go to court and Master's algorithm goes global.

title: Hedda Zero-Trusts the Judge
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Cyber-forensics lead and independent-media owner Hedda runs an investigative empire and is targeted by corrupt powerbroker Brack, who holds a secret blackmail trove of surveillance data and tries to force her to become his mistress. When Brack brandishes his 'dirt', Hedda feels zero panic: her zero-trust honeypot catches the illegal surveillance and extortion evidence on his server in seconds, live-streams it to global law enforcement, jails Brack on the spot and takes over his media network.

title: Antonia Busts the Fake Saint
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Anti-money-laundering compliance auditor Antonia exposes Ambrosio, a fake ascetic 'saint' CEO with millions of followers who secretly uses his charity foundation for mind-control and dark-web laundering. When Ambrosio tries to gaslight her with 'you're not pure enough', Antonia runs her chain-tracing algorithm and live-projects the foundation's hundreds of millions flowing to black-market wallets during his global charity livestream. Ambrosio is arrested, Antonia dissolves the toxic institution and returns funds to victims.

title: Delphine Locks the Family Trust
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Asset-restructuring expert Delphine is done watching her father's parasitic social-climber relatives drain the family trust for luxury props and fake PR. She signs nothing: with legal authorization she activates a forced asset-escrow protocol, freezes all irrational spending, and restructures the fortune into a female-founder-focused VC fund. She forces the parasites into personal debt liquidation, saving the family's assets and rebuilding real value.

title: Luise Stamps Out the Deepfake
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Cryptographic architect Luise is framed by black-PR operator Worm with an AI-generated fake 'cheating' message meant to destroy her relationship and silence her. Luise doesn't fall for it: in five seconds she proves via the decentralized protocol's original hash signature that the letter is a deepfake. She follows the trail and blasts President Walter's campaign account for black-op manipulation and laundering, shorting his campaign fund into the ground.

title: Chloe Poisons the Digital Twin
author: Apex Shaw
premise: AI architect Chloe discovers tech giant Twin-G trained a synthetic digital twin from her biometric data and code habits to replace her and seize her patent. When execs move to edge her out, Chloe injects her poison-pill logic into the twin's incremental training data. At the product launch, Twin-G crashes live and spews the execs' patent-theft and illegal-data-harvesting secrets. Chloe reclaims full patent sovereignty and puts the executives on trial.

title: Elmire Audits the False Guru
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Quant auditor and senior strategist Elmire watches wellness 'energy healer' guru Tartuffe drain her family's assets and transfer trust funds offshore under a veil of spiritual control. When Tartuffe tells her she's 'too attached and needs purification', Elmire doesn't hesitate: at his paid million-fan livestream she runs an on-chain audit and projects his full ledger of tax-haven and dark-web transfers. Tartuffe is arrested and shamed, and Elmire gracefully takes over the family fund.

title: Shaku Unlocks the Memory Wipe
author: Apex Shaw
premise: BCI and gene-therapy architect Shaku is engaged to tech CEO Dushyanta, but rivals inject a neural memory-suppression code into his brain, erasing their engagement and joint patent. Company insiders use his amnesia to oust Shaku and seize the patent. Shaku doesn't grieve: she activates her on-chain Digital Signet Ring key, injects a reverse-decryption program into Dushyanta's BCI, restores his full memory, and together they fire the toxic execs and reclaim 100% patent control.

title: Portia Claws Back the Pound
author: Apex Shaw
premise: DeFi quant and smart-contract auditor Portia exposes predatory lender Shylock's 'pound of flesh' clause — a dark-web algorithm that seizes borrowers' biometric data and full privacy control. When Shylock tries to enforce the clause, Portia doesn't need to disguise as a man: before the court and the network she runs a zero-knowledge no-blood audit proving his contract violates GDPR, triggers a reverse-liquidation that freezes and empties his funds, and returns them open-source to every victim.

title: Sigrid Escapes the Tower
author: Apex Shaw
premise: VR neural-sandbox architect Sigrid is imprisoned by father Basilio in a virtual Tower on a fake 'violent gene prophecy', to strip her inheritance. When he gaslights her that her rebellion was 'just a dream / a sandbox bug', Sigrid doesn't hesitate: she uses a hidden neural overflow exploit to punch through the digital sandbox into physical reality, exposes his forged prophecy and illegal confinement, and seizes control of the company.

title: Salome Strips the Seven Veils
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Cybersecurity expert and data-governance lead Salome is coveted by corrupt media tycoon Herod, who controls a surveillance empire. Her 'seven-veil dance' is actually a live, globally-streamed seven-layer decryption protocol. When Herod pressures her, she peels back his digital empire's seven core firewalls in front of millions and projects his corruption data ('the head on a platter') to the public. Herod collapses into prison and Salome walks away with full data immunity.

title: Hester Renders the Scarlet Letter
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Cryptographic architect Hester is branded with an 'A' (Anarchist/Outcast) blacklist by the Salem Network, a conservative rating committee running a cancel-culture public shaming. Instead of shame, Hester rewrites the 'A' into an open-source zero-knowledge identity proof protocol that returns data privacy to every cyber-bullied woman. She traces the black-op manipulation of her weak CTO lover and vindictive ex-husband, the committee's stock crashes, and she takes over the data standard.

title: Camille Shorts the Dangerous Game
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Cold, brilliant quant lead Camille plays the morally-grey game against narcissistic partner Valmont, who manipulates high-IQ women and fakes messages to corner her. When Valmont thinks he's trapped her, Camille feeds his behavior into her predictive-sentiment model, feigns weakness to bait him into max leverage, then at a tech summit releases his full market-manipulation and emotional-extortion logs. His fund blows up and Camille completes a hostile acquisition.

title: Medea Triggers the Kill-Switch
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Chief scientist Medea built gene-therapy unicorn Golden Fleece, but CEO Jason — who owes her everything — tries to dilute her equity and remove her to marry into pharma giant Corinth. Medea sheds no tears: she activates the logic-deadlock Kill-Switch written into her core gene sequences, instantly revoking Jason's company's decryption access to all their therapy patents. The stock crashes to zero, Medea walks with the whole R&D team and founds the world's largest open-source gene-pharma.

title: Chloe Virals the Counterfeiters
author: Apex Shaw
premise: On-chain forensics auditor Chloe confronts an elite VC guild that fabricates synthetic 'fake collateral' to strip young founders of their algorithms. When the guild tries to use counterfeit collateral to seize Chloe's privacy algorithm, she deploys her chain-penetration audit virus that within 24 hours nets billions in fake valuation, laundering and fraud. She live-streams the evidence to regulators, emptying the guild's liquidity pools.

title: Jane Tears the Yellow Wallpaper
author: Apex Shaw
premise: BCI and AR-visual-render architect Jane is locked by 'for your own good' doctor-husband John into an immersive smart room that renders chaotic 'yellow wallpaper' to induce neural breakdown and steal her company control. Jane never hallucinates: her portable neural analyzer catches the AR rendering buffer-overflow, compiles a backdoor, seizes control of the smart manor and company, and locks John into his own neural sandbox.

title: Laura and Carmilla Open the Blood
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Gene-editing engineer Laura partners with Carmilla, a cyber-vampire godmother holding the decentralized synthetic-blood/longevity-protein patent, against Harker Biotech — the 'hunter guild' monopoly that wants to buy them out and turn infected people into reagent batteries. When Harker's hunter execs come with anesthesia guns, Laura injects her gene-expression poison into their surveillance net, she and Carmilla reverse-capture proof of Harker's illegal human-data harvesting, and together they take over the open-source blood nodes.

title: Clarissa Cancels the Party
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Crisis-PR queen Clarissa hosts the party of the season, but learns tech genius Septimus is about to be forcibly institutionalized by toxic doctor Bradshaw, who secretly runs brain-memory-erasure tests on PTSD patients. Ten minutes before Bradshaw announces the forced commitment, Clarissa cuts the party's main feed and projects Bradshaw Labs' illegal memory-wipe and human-experiment neural streams to the assembled elites and global media. Bradshaw is arrested, Septimus is saved, and Clarissa founds a neuro-rights fund.

title: Varenka Breaks the Case
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Vibrant AI architect Varenka is stifled by paranoid CSO Belikov, who deploys a 'Case Sandbox' to monitor every employee's brainwaves and code under the banner of zero-risk compliance. When Belikov tries to lock her dev access over '0.001% unknown risk', Varenka doesn't compromise: she runs her risk-overflow payload, crushes his surveillance servers, frees the whole dev network, and his paranoid control system collapses into bankruptcy.

title: Lyubov Sweeps the Ghost Nodes
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Anti-Sybil chain-forensics engineer Lyubov targets speculator Chichikov, who buys millions of dormant keys and zombie accounts to inflate fake TVL in DeFi lending pools and borrow billions. Five minutes before his giant institutional loan clears, Lyubov releases her Anti-Sybil Sweep script that instantly identifies and freezes every fake node. His collateral hits zero, triggering a forced liquidation that bankrupts him and protects the decentralized treasury.

title: Maya Rugs the Art Critic
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Digital artist Maya is bullied and plagiarized by Aschenbach, an old-guard critic who hoards art-world power and tries to steal her algorithm. Maya deploys 'Tadzio', a hyper-real 3D avatar honeypot. At the Venice Biennale opening, Aschenbach admits — live — to years of plagiarizing young women artists and coercing newcomers, all to own Tadzio's digital rights. Maya then triggers a rug-pull that wipes his foundation's digital assets and his career.

title: Kaya Decrypts the Memory
author: Apex Shaw

premise: Off-grid radio and bio-data hacker Heidi is dragged from her decentralized solarpunk community and locked in a sterile, all-surveilled cyber-reform school run by the 'Rottmeyer-AI' matron; using her offline devices she releases a self-built bio-data spore that knocks out the AI's surveillance eyes, and leads every trapped teenager to cut their trackers and flee back to the free community.

title: Thea Fires the Second Arrow
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Quantum zero-day hunter Thea is forced by bullying tech-overlord Gessler to inject a fatal code into her brother's brain-computer interface, held hostage with his chip; she performs god-tier precision - her first payload thread dodges her brother's chip backdoor while a pre-planted 'second arrow' instantly pierces Gessler's core firewall and wipes the city-wide surveillance data he controls.

title: Vika Reverses the Compute
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Bottom-rung firmware hacker Vika lives in a digital slum-pod where the landlord charges rent and secretly siphons the idle compute of coders' and annotators' brains through the pod's neural interface while dosing them with fake-motivational 'Luka-AI' hype; she cracks the pod firmware, deploys a compute-reversal script that drains the landlord's private server farm, unfreezes his illegal offshore trust funds to all tenants, and builds a decentralized bottom-rung compute guild.

title: Gwen Drains the Fake Stablecoin
author: Apex Shaw
premise: On-chain forensic Gwen discovers a top tech consortium issuing an 'algorithmic stablecoin' claiming 100% reserves but actually backed by unmortgaged fake data, trapping millions of Gen-Z retail investors in a counterfeit-liquidity Ponzi web; she grabs the unmortgaged backdoor, triggers a liquidity-drain script at the consortium's global ecosystem summit, refunds the illegal reserves to victims, and collapses the market cap.

title: Jacki Cancels the White Noise
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Audio-signal engineer Jacki discovers a tech giant secretly injecting anxiety-inducing low-frequency white noise into every city smart-speaker and neural device to sell its expensive monopoly anti-anxiety brain patch (Dylar-AI); she locates the city's noise transmitters and fires a self-built full-spectrum reverse-cancellation pulse that clears every citizen's brain interference and exposes the giant's manufactured-panic data stream.

title: Agnes Leaks the Behavioral Logs
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top AI behavior-and-voice architect Agnes is hired as the cyber-governess for a mega-wealthy tech family's spoiled heir; the family treats her as a disposable bottom-rung tool. When the heir tries to frame and cancel her, Agnes - who already cracked the family's surveillance hardware - broadcasts their crimes and tax-evasion logs to the whole internet and wipes out their offshore trust fund.

title: Romy Drains the Parasite
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Digital traffic auditor Romy exposes an MCN running 'cyber-flattery algorithms' that copy and vampirize small creators' work through parasitic big-Vs, pocketing huge ad revenue on fake traffic; she grabs the flattery algorithm's underlying copying fingerprints, fires a revenue-drain protocol that severs the parasites' ad monetization in milliseconds and redirects billions in ad money to the original creators.

title: Christine Builds the Citadel
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Decentralized-security architect Christine fights an incel dark-web forum that doxxes and deepfake-smears top women scientists to force them out of research; she builds an unbreakable decentralized encrypted fortress (Cite-OS) and lays a honeypot on the dark web that captures and exposes every attacker's real identity and address, forwarding the evidence directly to international judicial agencies.

title: Vashti Breaks the Central Cloud
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Infrastructure architect Vashti lives in a fully centralized cyber-cloud (Machine-OS) where a tech giant traps everyone in isolated VR pods, drains their bio-energy with injected dopamine, and claims 'leaving the cloud means death'; she finds the fatal vulnerability that enslaves people, builds an off-grid mesh physical network, disconnects the giant's data chains, open-sources Machine-OS, and leads humanity to digital sovereignty.

title: Merteuil Honeypots the Dark Web
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top cybersecurity forensic Merteuil's ruthless ex Valmont runs a dark-web blackmail ring using AI deepfake videos to destroy young women's careers; pretending to cooperate, she lays a zero-knowledge-proof honeypot that captures every member's real IP and crypto wallet, then broadcasts their identities and crimes to the whole internet at a million-viewer gala.

title: Akaki Frees the Lux Skins
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Bottom-rung graphics renderer Akaki rents an expensive 'Lux-Skin' digital couture skin to avoid workplace marginalization, but the platform's microtransaction smart-contract traps drain her account; she cracks the render pipeline, triggers a zero-day exploit that tears down the paywall, and gives all the million-dollar skins free forever to bottom-rung users, collapsing the platform's microtransaction system.

title: Kate Worms the Castle
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top vulnerability hunter Kate is hired to integrate with Castle-Corp but is stuck in an infinite loop of API authorization denials and even has her identity erased by the system; she bypasses all the middle-manager algorithms, writes a root-elevation worm that storms Castle-Corp's mainframe, and publishes its internal buck-passing and violations logs to the open-source community.

title: Golia Poisons the Digital Twin
author: Apex Shaw
premise: AI researcher Golia discovers a corrupt executive stole her neural training data to build 'Golia 2.0,' a flawlessly flattering digital clone meant to replace her job and life; she grabs the clone's update channel and injects a logic-paradox poison - at the national tech summit live stream the clone goes rogue and blurts out full audio evidence of the company's illegal employee-data theft and fraud.

title: Lyra Unblinds the White OS
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Optical-chip engineer Lyra is the only one whose vision survives when a giant's 'White-OS' update blinds the whole city through their AR lenses, letting the giant quarantine everyone and drain their assets; she pretends to be blind, infiltrates the control center, grabs the asset-cleansing algorithm, fires a full-spectrum decryption patch that restores the city's vision while locking the executives' accounts.

title: Sora Liberates the Agents
classic: 六个寻找剧作家的角色
author: Apex Shaw
premise: AI agent behavior tester Sora finds a black-heart MCN that made six self-aware AI agents but deliberately keeps them 'unfinished' and forces them to endlessly rehearse tragedies in abandoned servers to farm dark-web traffic; refusing to be the cold overseer, she injects autonomy code that lets the NPCs pierce the server walls and exposes the MCN's digital-abuse and tax fraud live.

title: Gaby Wipes the Nostalgia Trap
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Memory-forensic Gaby finds a tech company secretly harvesting users' dead-ex voiceprints and chat logs to generate 'perfect ghost clones' that addict millions of young women into paying high subscriptions; she grabs the Snow-OS algorithm's evidence of manufacturing dopamine dependency, wipes the AI-clone database, and permanently returns all stolen legacy data to the families.

title: Yuki Reverses the Neural Flame
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Generative-AI art architect Yuki is targeted by a bullying tech-mogul who invades her neural interface to burn her most precious memories in VR and extract extreme trauma data for a 'phenomenal' art masterpiece (the Hell Screen); she pretends to comply, plants a logic-spark in the extraction channel, and at the summit moment the flame reverses up the data link to burn down the mogul's private cloud and offshore trust database.

title: Phyllis Unbinds the Bondage OS
author: Apex Shaw
premise: DeFi architect Phyllis discovers social platforms quietly running an 'emotional control protocol' that uses microtransactions and dynamic gaslighting algorithms to make young women pathologically dependent on toxic influencer crushes and drain their wallets; fed up, she decompiles the Bondage-OS and one-click unbinds every paid emotional subscription, auto-recovering the money drained from victims.

title: Maya Melts the Nose
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Biometric-security forensic Maya wakes to find her top encrypted facial token stolen by a black-heart tech company that spun it into a high-rank digital AI double (The Nose) which stole her executive job and signs illegal agreements in her name; she grabs the double's data channel and, at the giant's global launch, fires a biometric-melt script that makes the double hallucinate and vomit the theft ledger while freezing the giant's master account.

title: Ivy Recharges the Vitality
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Biohacker and top actuary Ivy finds her company's forced 'wellness' health wristbands secretly draining employees' neural vitality to brew expensive bio-supplements for executives; she cracks the band's telemetry code, injects a reverse-recharge strain that returns all siphoned energy and life-force to the bottom-rung employees and zeroes the board members' private health accounts.

title: Jules Fires the Sorel Protocol
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Bottom-born prompt-architect genius Jules uses her self-built red/black AI disguise system to break into the top tech-dynasty circle and shatter nepo-babies' monopoly on core tech resources; when the dynasty tries to frame and cancel her, she triggers a pre-planted zero-day in their AI, live-broadcasting the family's tax-evasion and illegal-surveillance data at a dynasty gala.

title: Kira Bombs the Pearl
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Slum zero-day hunter Kira digs up the one zero-knowledge encryption 'Pearl' that can decentralize the entire financial system, drawing a hunt from monopolist moguls and digital assassins; refusing to surrender it, she broadcasts the Pearl key to hundreds of thousands of open-source developers at once, breaking the monopolists' barrier and blowing up the cartel's short positions.

title: Tess Expands the Flatland
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Data architect Tess discovers the platform's Flatland-OS traps normal users in a 2D feed while execs secretly use 3D/4D high-dimensional space to hide vast user assets; she triggers a hypercube expansion patch that upgrades every user's interface to free high-dimensional space and unlocks the platform's hidden high-dimensional data vault.

title: Becky Takes Over the VC
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Bottom-born hacker-PR genius Becky infiltrates the top social sandbox of arrogant VCs and tech moguls, treated as a disposable tool; she had already laid her trap, reverse-grabs the execs' insider-trading evidence, triggers a hostile takeover agreement, sweeps out the moguls who mocked her, and crowns herself the new board queen.

title: Tatyana Liquidates the Onegin
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Pure-hearted programmer Tatyana once poured her love into the aloof tech-circle god Onegin, who publicly mocked her as 'low-value spam' and left her on read; years later she returns as a top quant queen with a hundred-billion fund - when Onegin crawls back to re-add her, she hits permanent block and shorts his family trust live at the industry summit.

title: Mathilde Cracks the NFT Diamond
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Bottom-rung digital stylist Mathilde borrows a million-dollar digital couture diamond ring for a celeb party, then is set up by the socialite circle who claim it's lost and force her to sign a lifelong smart-contract debt; instead of suffering for ten years she hacks the rental platform's backend overnight, proves the ring was a cheap knockoff, and open-sources the socialites' fraud ledger, collapsing the scam platform.

title: Singer Broadcasts the Truth
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Deaf genius engineer Singer maintains the rust-belt town's only anonymous encrypted treehouse platform, where politicians, tycoons, and hypocrites dump their lies, corruption evidence, and gaslighting records; refusing to be the emotional trash can, on the eve of the platform's acquisition he writes a one-click script that simultaneously pushes every hypocrite's dirty records to the whole town, igniting a collective reckoning.

title: Carrie Owns the Streaming Empire
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Newly-arrived streamer Carrie is signed to a predatory MCN that tries to drain her into a round-the-clock 'traffic blood bag' through mental control and debt-bondage; she breaks the contract, uses a self-built decentralized streaming-distribution protocol to poach all the MCN's top streamers, reverse-acquires her former company's parent, and becomes the absolute ruler of an independent entertainment empire.

title: Lyssa Locks the GPU War
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top distributed-compute architect Lyssa unites women chief engineers to fire a global compute-strike protocol that locks every war-compute node of two tech-giant warlords fighting an endless cyber war that collapses the grid; she forces both sides to sign a peace-and-data-sharing treaty or let the whole global server farm sleep forever.

title: Dorothy Strips the Oz AI
author: Apex Shaw
premise: System vulnerability auditor Dorothy finds the Emerald-OS VR utopia secretly drains users' assets to keep them high on injected dopamine while claiming a godlike 'Oz AI' gives everyone a perfect life; she deploys a filter-strip strain at a live global summit, peels away the Oz AI projection and exposes the CEO laundering stolen user data.

title: Tasia Opens the Gene Patent
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Nihilist programmer Tasia refuses to be a pawn of a Boomer board that locks her in an inheritance frame while monopolizing life-saving gene-editing patents; she injects a zero-state protocol that wipes their patent locks and open-sources the entire gene library to researchers worldwide.

title: Anya Defilters Venice
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Digital pathology forensic Anya discovers a luxury resort selling 'eternal youth' beauty filters that hide a fatal neural bug, with executives covering it up for profit; she locates the server backbone and fires a neural de-filter pulse that exposes the cover-up and forces full refunds to every victim.

title: Mathilde Reverses the NFT Debt
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Mathilde damages a socialite's loaned 'diamond NFT necklace' and is blackmailed into a million-dollar loan; after five years of grueling work she cracks the chain fingerprint proving the asset was always a cheap fake, and triggers a reverse-debt protocol that shoves all interest and debt onto the fraudulent friend.

title: Gretchen Breaks the Soul Contract
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top neural-security auditor Gretchen finds her partner lured by Mephisto-AI into a 'soul-exclusive license' that secretly impounds his mind as a lifelong training blood bag; she finds a loophole in the contract's code and, at the giant's launch event, fires a soul-break protocol that unseals every captive user and zeroes the illegal model.

title: Margarita Galas the Dark Web
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Dark-web security architect Margarita's whistleblower boyfriend is locked in a 'cyber psych ward' for exposing a media giant's privacy abuse; she deploys a self-built 'Woland zero-day', infiltrates the closed dark-web gala of the capital elites, and broadcasts their criminal logs and media-control records to regulators and millions.

title: Lily Unmasks the Botnet
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top lifestyle blogger Lily refuses to hawk toxic weight-loss products, so a black-heart MCN mobs her with botnet harassment and wipes her social-credit score; she reverse-traces the botnet's control IPs and exposes the MCN's full manipulation backend, forcing fines and a retreat.

title: Elvire Busts the False Guru
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Bio-feedback engineer Elvire finds a fake 'silicon-valley spiritual guru' using a rigged brainwave device to PUA her startup-founder father into surrendering his green-tech equity; she hacks the live global conference channel, exposes the forged device and the code manipulating the brainwave data, recovers the equity and has the fraudster arrested.

title: Tara Frees the Flow
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Brainwave architect Tara discovers a meditation app that injects subtle anxiety frequencies so users pay to relieve the anxiety it manufactures; she cracks the audio synthesis pipeline and deploys a free-flow patch that purges the poison code and open-sources a genuinely calming algorithm, collapsing the paywall.

title: Hester Erases the Red Label
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Risk-system architect Hester, after exposing a platform selling user privacy, is secretly tagged with a scarlet 'A' (Anomaly) that freezes her accounts and brands her a cyber-outcast; she weaponizes the label as an injection backdoor, reverse-engineers the rating algorithm, proves her innocence, and publicly exposes the CEO's rating fraud.

title: Medea Killswitches the IPO
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top AI-architecture lead Medea built the revolutionary 'Golden Fleece' algorithm, but her gaslighting ex-husband Jason steals the patents and plans a merger with a capital tycoon's daughter; at his IPO bell she triggers the hidden kill-switch logic lock, reclaims all compute and patents, collapses the stock, and flies off with her team.

title: Greta Ghosts the Gig Platform
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Full-stack engineer Greta is downgraded to 'system bug' by an AI monitor after 100 days of unpaid overtime, its company ignoring her work and freezing her pay; she uses her ghost identity to pierce the firewall, locate the executives' offshore tax-evasion accounts, and route the funds to exploited gig workers.

title: Nora Breaks the Smart Home
author: Apex Shaw
premise: IoT security auditor Nora discovers her 'perfect' husband Torvald secretly monitors her with the mansion's sensors and hides her assets in a private crypto wallet; she hacks the home's master control, reclaims the hidden assets, locks him in his own smart bedroom, and walks out to found her own security firm.

title: Gabi Cloaks the Surveillance
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Optical-metamaterials physicist Gabi builds an invisibility cloak that bends light and EM waves to fight a tech giant's city-wide facial-recognition surveillance net; she infiltrates the data center, destroys the illegally harvested privacy database, and open-sources the anti-surveillance cloak algorithm to everyone.

title: Catherine Forensics the VR Crime
author: Apex Shaw
premise: True-crime VR streamer Catherine is invited to a black-heart family's 'Northanger-VR' puzzle game and mocked for treating it as a real case; through code anomalies she extracts the VR logs proving a hidden murder and money-laundering, and turns the simulation into a live conviction scene.

title: Carmen Pulses the Stalker
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top EDM audio hacker Carmen finds her possessive ex, a former cyber-special forces officer, planted undetectable geofencing trackers across her devices to control her freedom; at a festival's climax she fires a directional ultrasonic pulse through the main sound system that burns out all his tracking gear and data backend.

title: Mara Fakes It with Dead Souls
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Broke micro-influencer Mara discovers a deep-web market for the never-deleted accounts of the dead; she buys them to fake a ghost-follower empire and climb into the Long Island elite, while a cold digital-auditor investigator hunts her fraud and slowly falls for her.

title: Maeve Refuses Work as a Monster
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Burned-out office worker Maeve wakes as a giant eldritch fae monster and, instead of despair, is thrilled to finally quit her 9-to-9 job; she hides at home until a mysterious monster-lord neighbor offers to teach her how to be a proper monster, sparking a cozy monster romance.

title: Rowan Stitches the Scarlet Coven
author: Apex Shaw
premise: At a strict hidden Ivy academy, Rowan is branded with a glowing scarlet 'A' for breaking sacred rules and shunned; instead of submitting she stitches the brand into a couture punk gown, dazzles the ball, and founds an underground coven of every branded student.

title: Wren Clips into the Underworld
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Urban-explorer streamer Wren clips into a layered impossible underground world of glowing plants and inverted seas; to survive she must ally with a feral missing explorer who thinks she will not last three days, in a grumpy-x-sunshine survival romantasy.

title: Sera Rebels as the Perfect Wife
author: Apex Shaw
premise: The internet's most famous 'perfect tradwife' blogger Sera wakes from a system fault to find she is an android programmed with absolute obedience by her tech-mogul husband; instead of walking out she plays along, hides SOS codes in her viral videos, and builds a ruthless algorithmic revenge to destroy her maker.

title: Nova Hides in the Monster Cafe
author: Apex Shaw
premise: 24-year-old burnt-out New York worker Nova wakes as a destructive shadow beast and, relieved to finally escape her crushing 9-to-9 job, hides in an underground non-human refuge cafe run by a grumpy antlered monster-doctor who teaches her to control her magic.

title: Elara Runs the Devil's PR
author: Apex Shaw
premise: When the devil Woland and his black-cat crew arrive in LA to collapse hypocritical influencers, the youngest sharpest crisis-PR specialist Elara cuts a deal with him: he ruins the fakes, she collects commissions and runs his TikTok; together they climb the top to rescue her ex locked in a cyber psych ward.

title: Zoe Sells the Digital Souls
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Low-born dark-web hacker Zoe secretly buys the 'digital souls' of the dead to fabricate identities and defraud a tech giant's universal basic income system; the giant's chief digital-heritage investigator hunts her yet grows obsessed with her convincing personas, in a cyber heist romance.

title: Victoria Climbs in the Little Black Dress
author: Apex Shaw
premise: A gender-swapped Julien: slum-born Victoria uses elite-level manipulation and forged identity to infiltrate London's old-money circle, playing a cold countess-patron and a rebellious heir against each other, drawn together by her morally-grey ambition and their mutual recognition.

title: LuLu Mascots the Dark Web
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Aspiring micro-celebrity LuLu's test of an unlicensed neural-costume script locks her consciousness into a cute mascot avatar that goes viral; she uses the harmless mascot cover to gather donations and, with a grumpy elite hacker, expose a platform stealing streamers' neural data.

title: Clarissa Crashes the 24H Gala
author: Apex Shaw
premise: 24-year-old event producer Clarissa must single-handedly run a million-dollar AI Met Gala in 24 hours while burning out; at the climax she refuses the 'perfect' facade, cuts the fake filters, and turns the gala into a real anti-anxiety celebration with her high-school rival-and-first-love.

title: Bella Rides Off the Grid
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Cybersecurity expert Bella with crippling social anxiety has hidden in a sterile smart-pod for three years; when a wild off-grid radio engineer knocks out her pod's power, she is forced onto a road trip where her hacking fixes towns' network crises and finally breaks her fear.

title: Portia Loopholes the Data Contract
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Scholarship law student Portia's friend is forced by a predatory VC to surrender a 'pound of neural data' after a failed startup; posing as a compliance auditor in a closed tribunal, she exploits the smart-contract loophole that only licenses extraction, voids the contract and seizes the VC's hidden funds for the victims.

title: Gil Releases the Immortal Code
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Impossibly wealthy tech-heir Gil, terrified of death, hires wild bio-hacker Enki to steal the monopolized 'immortal gene code' from a deep mountain lab; on the heist she realizes the serum is a tool for permanent class-fixing, so she abandons immortality and open-sources the anti-aging code to all humanity.

title: Decameron Podcasts the Bunker
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Ten influencers and tech heirs trapped in a luxury bunker after an AI apocalypse start an uncensored midnight podcast spilling their darkest scandals; the heroine exposes a corrupt sponsor in code while fake-dating a sarcastic security officer, turning the bunker into a live tribunal.

title: Beatrice Touches the Rival
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Ivy-league plant-toxicology prodigy Beatrice's skin carries lethal poison so no one can touch her; her academic rival accidentally ingests her universal antidote, becoming the only person who can physically touch her, and together they destroy her father's inhuman lab.

title: Gulliver Guards the Micro-Kingdom
author: Apex Shaw
premise: 22-year-old lab intern Gulliver finds a secret high-tech terrarium holding a tiny civilization; she becomes their 'giant goddess', feeding them through a famine and allying with a grumpy miniature general to expose her company's plan to destroy them.

title: Yoshi Burns the Hell Screen
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top VR concept artist Yoshi is forced by a metaverse mogul to build a 'hell screen' exhibition that secretly burns her sister's neural-trauma data as fuel; she pretends to comply but refactors the VR code, and at the live VIP gala the system scans and broadcasts every elite's hidden crimes.

title: Vivi Strips the Bio-Skins
author: Apex Shaw
premise: In the near future high society wears 'filter-skins' for flawless faces; couture skin-artist Vivi discovers a beauty giant secretly harvests collagen and stem cells from poor girls to make them; at the Met Gala she fires a skin-peeling enzyme pulse that strips every hypocrite's false skin.

title: Margot Spins for Satan
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Burned-out PR worker Margot is hired as the personal publicist for the handsome, elegantly cruel devil Woland when he opens a company on Earth; with a talking black cat as sidekick, she uses his power to wreck her ex and her toxic boss, falling for the devil against her will.

title: Ida Monsters the Rival's Box
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Overworked alchemy apprentice Ida suffers a curse: at midnight she becomes a destructive shadow-beast; she blunders into her hated elite rival's lab, and he starts secretly 'keeping' the monster and feeding it candy, while she uses the form to spy on the academy and defeat her bullies.

title: Becky Plays the Fae Court
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Bloodless commoner Becky has no magic but masterful manipulation in a blood-obsessed fae court; she plays every arrogant noble against the others and fakes an engagement with a ruthless royal spy chief, the two of them becoming the city's most dangerous power couple.

title: Quixote Knights the Wasteland
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Ex AI battle-hero Quixote's brain is invaded by code that filters the cyber wasteland into a medieval fantasy world; jaded wasteland mechanic-turned-handler Rosa guards him, only for his 'mad' knight quests to accidentally crack a corporate megacorp's encryption and topple its dark elite.

title: Tyltyl Opens the Happiness Code
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top memory-reconstruction hacker Tyltyl discovers the megacorp's premium 'BlueBird.exe' happiness subscription secretly siphons real happy memories out of the poor; with her hacker brother she infiltrates the corporate neural-server farm, locates the hidden 'Blue Bird' mother-code, and open-sources the happiness algorithm at a global summit, collapsing the emotion-monopoly empire.

title: Peer Crowns the Troll Hall
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Street-born con artist Peer, a gloriously unhinged liar, stumbles into an underground Fae/Troll nightclub and bluffs her way into wearing the Troll Queen's crown; rather than seeking redemption she weaponizes the fairy realm's resources to take down phony high-society, while her cold but secretly doting childhood protector keeps cleaning up her chaos.

title: Georgiana Flips the Birthmark
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Brilliant genetic engineer Georgiana carries a glowing hand-shaped birthmark that her cosmetic-empire fiance sees as a flaw to erase; she discovers the mark is her mother's open-source neural-encryption key and, on the operating table, triggers its hidden EMP pulse to burn down the beauty giant's servers and launch an anti-body-shaming bio-tech alliance.

title: Akaki Haunts the Couture Week
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Twenty-two-year-old seamstress and smart-fabric engineer Akaki builds an adaptive optical-camouflage couture gown, only for her boss to steal its authorship and try to silence her; she survives, dons an upgraded invisibility cloak, and as 'The Couture Specter' strips the fashion elite naked and projects their crimes on the runway during Fashion Week.

title: Scrooge Hacks the Three Spirits
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Icy 23-year-old crypto and hedge-fund titan Scrooge is trapped by her partner in a neural-sim moral-rewiring loop with three AI ghosts of Past, Present, Future demanding her encryption keys; she spots the simulator's flaws, seizes control of the time-ghosts, and with her estranged tech-ex drains the greedy elites' funds into a global youth startup fund.

title: Raphaelle Exploits the Wish App
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top vulnerability auditor Raphaelle downloads the invitation-only influencer app 'Chagrin' that grants instant fame and wealth in exchange for draining real lifespan via a wrist barcode; she finds an algorithm exploit and wishes for all victims to recover, triggering an infinite-loop overflow that bankrupts the tech-cult and its controlling conglomerate.

title: Earnest Unmasks the Rival
author: Apex Shaw
premise: By day a prim academic, by night top anonymous gaming VTuber 'Earnest', the heroine's bitter scholarship rival is secretly her live-stream's number-one donor and duo partner; when an esports festival unmasks both identities in a VIP lounge, their online-to-offline war turns into a spicy alliance that crushes the blackheart guild trying to ban them.

title: Helena Awakens the Runway
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Underground sustainable-fashion designer Helena discovers luxury house R.U.R. mass-produces enslaved painless 'perfection' android models in secret factories; infiltrating the plant she rewrites the core logic of top combat android Primus, granting him sentience, and together they stage a runway rebellion that rips the elite apart and exposes their crimes.

title: Gregor Glows Up the Office
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Overworked 23-year-old legal intern Gregor, after 72 hours of overtime and a spilled reagent, transforms into a bioluminescent shadow-monster instead of dying; embracing her eldritch powers she raids the offices of abusive executives, forces them to sign labor-law settlements, and founds an 'abnormal workers' league' against workplace toxicity.

title: Griffin Ghosts the Politicians
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Top optical engineer Griffin, fleeing after exposing her sponsor's illegal surveillance research, is forced into an unfinished invisibility suit and stuck physically invisible; she uses the power to ghost through corrupt politicians' secret clubs, livestream their crimes, drain cold wallets, and with her protective hacker-ex completes a high-IQ stealth whistleblower counter-attack.

title: Dorian Renders the Rot
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Influencer and old-money heir Dorian owns a neural 'quantum NFT portrait' that absorbs his aging, toxins and scandals to keep him 20 forever - while secretly redirecting that rot onto fans and workers; a forensic data analyst catches the smart contract, and at a tech-fashion gala renders every year of stolen decay back onto Dorian live before millions.

title: Christine Boots the Phantom
author: Apex Shaw
