premise: A silenced pop empress who never speaks has become the internet's most-listened-to ghost — the confessional every lonely soul pours into — until the emperor who publicly sacrificed her returns on the eve of their anniversary, forcing her to choose between the silence that saved her and the voice that could burn him down.

title: The Blind Assassin's Year
classic: The Blind Assassin (Margaret Atwood) x Ninety-Three (Victor Hugo) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Two sisters at war over a media empire — one writes a secret manuscript that reads like a love story and is really a kill list, and by the time the archive tower burns with children inside, the quiet sister has been the assassin all along.

title: Ash and the Arsenal
classic: Fahrenheit 451 (Ray Bradbury) x Catch-22 (Joseph Heller) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: A hypermnestic firefighter who burns books for the Bureau of Civic Memory secretly memorizes every book before it dies, and when her best friend is caught hiding one, she becomes the last living library of a regime that has outlawed reading.

title: Emma Counts the Stars
classic: Madame Bovary (Flaubert) x The Little Prince (Saint-Exupery) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: A micro-influencer drowning in aspirational debt and a hollow marriage keeps receiving drawings of a single rose from the archived account of her dead little brother, and each drawing makes the manufactured life she is bleeding for look like a cage.

title: Face Value
classic: The Nose (Gogol) x Peer Gynt (Ibsen) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: A mid-tier LA influencer wakes up to discover her face has walked out on her — literally detached and now living as its own wildly successful account called TheFace — and the only way to get it back before the Identity Exchange auctions it off is to stop performing and finally become someone real.

title: Alice Breaks the Wonderboard
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (Lewis Carroll) x The Epic of Gilgamesh — dual-classic fusion
premise: Alice, a 21-year-old QA gig worker with the lowest Wonder Score on the continent, gets Edged into the Underside and teams up with Enki, a wild unranked girl, to climb the Looking Glass and seize the Plant of Youth — only to discover the immortality everyone was promised is a lie, and that the life you actually live is the only immortality there is.

title: She Bought the Town
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Othello (Shakespeare) x The Visit (Dürrenmatt) — dual-classic fusion
premise: A girl humiliated and exiled by her hometown returns a decade later as a billionaire who buys the entire town — not to kill the man who broke her, but to plant a seed of jealousy in every heart and let the green-eyed monster destroy him for her.

title: Thea Breaks the Emotion Grid
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Nineteen Eighty-Four (Orwell) x The Sorrows of Young Werther (Goethe) — dual-classic fusion
premise: In the walled city-state of Meridian, every citizen wears a NerveBand that caps their Feel-Index at 60 — anything hotter is 'deviation,' punishable by a memory scrub called the Recalibration. Thea Moss, a file-pusher with a band that keeps beeping at her, discovers the Bureau is quietly erasing love itself. To save her brother and the man who remembers too much, she must weaponize the one thing the grid cannot read: the human heart.

title: Every Door in the Voss House
author: Apex Shaw
classic: The House of Bernarda Alba (Lorca) x The Physicists (Dürrenmatt) — dual-classic fusion
premise: For eight years the Voss compound has been sealed in mourning, its gates welded, its daughters prisoners of a matriarch who treats genius like a harvest. Ivy Voss — the youngest, the fragile one, the girl everyone writes off as mad — is the only person in the house who never made a mistake. She faked her breakdown to bury an equation that could predict mass death, and she has been waiting. Now the estate's new orderly is a physicist who thinks she betrayed their project, her mother's doctor is mining the asylum for breakthroughs, and the gate she has memorized for eight years is about to open.

title: Mills and Sensibility
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Sense and Sensibility (Austen) x North and South (Gaskell) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Two bankrupt Southern sisters are forced north to a dying Rust Belt mill town — the rational one becomes the cold mill owner's restructuring consultant while the romantic one falls for the strike leader, splitting them across opposite sides of a labor war.

title: The Zero Verse
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Amerika (Kafka) x The Song of Roland — dual-classic fusion
premise: In a hyper-bureaucratic America where citizenship is a Song of honor deeds and every life is recorded as verse, a Verse Null immigrant named Carla Ross — the most ordinary, least-gifted girl in the queue — wins full citizenship not by performing heroism, but by refusing the Song entirely and weaponizing the one rule no knight ever read: the clause that says a person with no recorded deeds for thirty days is automatically granted provisional status. The more the system tries to force her to be glorious, the more her quiet unremarkableness breaks it.

title: The Girl Who Turned the Screw
author: Apex Shaw
classic: The Mayor of Casterbridge (Thomas Hardy) x The Turn of the Screw (Henry James) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Seven years after she was branded the hysterical liar of Callow, Nebraska, Wren Ashby returns to Marlowe House as governess to the two orphaned children of the town's golden heir — and finds the house is haunted by the very people whose deaths the Marlowe family buried. The mayor buried his son's crime; Wren was sold to bury it with her credibility. Now the ghosts want the truth dug up, and the only sane person in a town run on gaslight is the girl everyone swore was crazy.

title: The Seven-Gable Hustle
author: Apex Shaw
classic: The House of the Seven Gables (Nathaniel Hawthorne) x The Threepenny Opera (Bertolt Brecht) — dual-classic fusion
premise: A disgraced forensic accountant inherits her family’s cursed Salem mansion only to discover the ghosts are con artists, the curse is a 300-year-old land fraud, and the only way to break it is to out-hustle the old money that built the Pyncheon name.

title: The Replacement Protocol
classic: The Double (Dostoevsky) x Never Let Me Go (Ishiguro) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: At Meridian Gardens, the luxury wellness campus where the global elite grow perfect organ donors, top donor Avery Dane watches a girl who looks exactly like her walk into the graduation gala. As the double, Iris, systematically replaces Avery's life, memory, and body, Avery uncovers the campus's darkest secret: she was never the original. She was the copy all along — and the 'original' has come back to collect what's hers.

title: The Scarlet Ledger
classic: The Red and the Black (Stendhal) x The Awakening (Kate Chopin) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: An intern everyone mistakes for arm candy keeps a private ledger of every favor, every threat, and every secret the men of Vane Capital hand her while they teach her 'never to make a mistake.' When the fund tries to bury her under their crimes, she doesn't climb their ladder — she burns the whole table and walks toward her own sea.

title: The Perfume Court
classic: The Tale of Genji (Murasaki Shikibu) x Tender Is the Night (Fitzgerald) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: A debt-ridden forensic psychologist hired to heal a reclusive tech-prince walks into a family estate where women are courted, named by perfume, and quietly erased by season — and she realizes the only cure is to take the door off its hinges and walk every kept woman out through the snow.

title: Half-Starved
classic: Hunger (Knut Hamsun) x Narcissus and Goldmund (Hermann Hesse) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: A nameless ghostwriter in a brutal attention-economy city treats starvation as creative discipline, refusing every offer of rescue because a fed writer would be a fake one. When a brilliant ascetic editor and a wandering street musician pull her between two ways of being alive, and a patron who literally eats artists tries to own her name, Faye Marlow must learn the one lesson hunger never taught her: you cannot write the great work until you feed the body that writes it.

title: Soulforged
classic: Brave New World (Huxley) x The Sword of Ganjiang and Moye (Soushen Ji) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: In Vana, a city where every citizen is genetically forged into happiness and Soma makes pain illegal, Moya Vane — a defect who cannot feel joy — is the last apprentice of a master smith who was melted into the Furnace for forging the truth. She completes the revenge blade her mother died for, soul-forges it into her own body, and drives it through the heart of the machine that built her city, so that for the first time millions of people can choose to feel.

title: Quilla Unburns the Archive
classic: Fahrenheit 451 (Ray Bradbury) x The True Story of Ah Q (Lu Xun) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: In Ember City, firemen burn books and every memory is scrubbed by the Archive — except the ones inside Quilla 'Q' Ngo's head. She's the dumbest, clumsiest cadet in Firehouse 4, surviving on spiritual victory: every humiliation reframed as proof they fear her. But Chief Vale has a plan: make her the One Book — the single living vessel who holds all banned knowledge, so the state can finally burn it forever. When Q is ordered to burn her dead grandmother's last surviving book on national live-stream, she discovers the fire is a performance — the words are already inside her, unburnable. Now the city's biggest spectacle becomes her stage, and the self-deception that kept her alive becomes the weapon that wakes the world.

title: Maeve Stays Human
author: Apex Shaw
premise: In the gilded port city of Meridian, the whole world is converting. Every dusk the Horn opens, and people walk in as themselves and walk out as Herd — glowing, placid, perfect, and stripped of every memory that made them human. Maeve Corvino is the one person who refuses. A disgraced neural archivist fired and publicly destroyed by her mentor-turned-monster Dr. Aldous Vane — the first of the Herd — Maeve kept every single archived identity in her head, which means she is the only person alive who remembers who everyone used to be. When Vane takes her frail younger brother Tomas as his 'perfect specimen' and the city cheers her annihilation on live broadcast, Maeve stops being the woman they burned. She becomes the memory they cannot erase — and she will use every forgotten name to make the Herd remember what it cost them to forget. They wanted her converted. She will make them regret they ever were.

title: The Golem Cousin
classic: The Golem (Gustav Meyrink) x Cousin Bette (Honore de Balzac) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: In Staromest, a gilded city built on the Hulot House—the dynasty that sells perfection itself by forging flawless Companions from clay and the ancient Word—Lisbeth 'Bette' Hulot is the defect they erased: the invisible Keeper of the vault who does every thankless job while her glorious cousin Adeline and the family's golden products take all the love. When Bette inherits her mother's forbidden grimoire, she does the one thing no Hulot ever dared: she forges her own Companion, a perfect girl named Gilda, and hands her to the family as the heir they always wanted. The House adores Gilda. Everyone adores Gilda. And nobody notices that the only person Gilda truly loves is the invisible woman who made her—or that Bette has just placed a weapon in the heart of the dynasty that erased her. As the family's beautiful lie unravels, Bette must decide whether the Word she wields is for vengeance, for love, or for freeing the hundreds of stolen souls still trapped in clay below the city.

title: The Spider's Waves
classic: Kiss of the Spider Woman (Manuel Puig) x The Waves (Virginia Woolf) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: A canceled anonymous storyteller checks into the Tide House, a seaside digital-detox retreat for burned-out creators, where every night a Tide wipes fragments of memory and feeds them to a hidden emotion-control algorithm. The only guest immune to it is the one who never told her own story. As Sable Voss teaches six broken voices to become one wave, she must drown a machine that reads hearts in a story it cannot own — and stay anonymous enough to survive the spider who wants her mind.

title: The Dove's Teeth
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Adolphe (Benjamin Constant) x Colomba (Prosper Mérimée) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Everyone on the island of Corsa thinks Dove Rebbia is the soft, lovesick heiress who will sign away her murdered father's empire to the man she adores. They are wrong. Dove has spent three years pretending to love the son of the family that killed her father — and her feigned devotion is the cage closing around them all. When she lowers the veil at her own wedding, the whole island discovers the dove has teeth.

title: The Egg That Held the Pearl
author: Apex Shaw
classic: The Pearl (John Steinbeck) x Demian (Hermann Hesse) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Vesta Okafor lives in a van and is officially invisible to the cleanroom economy that decides who gets seen. Then one night she runs a piece of stolen dead code and it hatches the Pearl — a seed so pure it scores 99.99 on the platform's purity test and makes her the fastest-rising creator alive. But the Pearl is a trap: every view it earns feeds a dying man's experiment, and the fame-world it builds around her is an egg that is eating her alive. To be born as herself, Ves has to shatter the world her own creation made — and throw the Pearl back into the dark sea it crawled out of.

title: Sable Peels the Painted Skin
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Woyzeck (Georg Büchner) x Painted Skin (Pu Songling) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Sable Voss is the lowest-ranked canvas at VELVET, a beauty-tech empire that paints perfect faces onto the rich by peeling the skin off the poor. Rated 0.0 on every beauty audit, she is the one nobody would ever steal a face from — so she survives on the nightly peel line by never making a single mistake. Then her best friend Rhea gets 'promoted' to a client face, Rhea's skin turns up hanging in the vault with her code stitched into it, and Sable starts to see the seams: the Matron who runs VELVET is wearing a painted skin too. Hunted, cut off, and betrayed by the only boy she trusted, Sable learns the one thing the empire cannot peel is the girl it spent years calling worthless. The paint on her has fused into armor, and she is going to rip the whole beautiful lie off the world's face, live on camera, starting with the Matron's.

title: The Girl Who Stopped Growing
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Eugénie Grandet (Balzac) x The Tin Drum (Günter Grass) — dual-classic fusion
premise: At twenty-five, Eugénie 'Genie' Grandet still looks nine years old — she stopped growing the night her mother died, and her miser father built a decaying mansion around the secret of where he hid his fortune. Her only inheritance is a battered tin drum from her grandmother and a voice that shatters glass at exact frequencies. When her father dies and the will reveals the fortune is missing, the vultures descend: a charming influencer cousin who courts her for the gold then abandons her, and a predatory estate manager who wants to declare the 'child' legally incompetent. But the drum is secretly forged from the entire hoard — painted tin over solid gold — and her shattering scream is the only weapon that can stop them cutting her open to get it.

title: Phaedra Builds the City of Ladies
classic: Phaedra (Euripides) x The Book of the City of Ladies (Christine de Pizan) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Married off as a trophy bride to New York's reputation-engineering dynasty, a classical-studies dropout with the worst pedigree in the room discovers the family's real product is scandal — bought, spun, and weaponized against women. Refusing to die as Phaedra did, she starts building a City of Ladies out of every woman the Marchetti machine erased.

title: Waiting for the Second Winter
classic: Kokoro (Natsume Soseki) x The Tartar Steppe (Buzzati) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: A chronically-unimpressive data janitor gets posted to Bastiani, a legendary research fortress on the edge of a dead data steppe where everyone spends their whole life waiting for an enemy that never comes. She uncovers that the fortress's beloved founder betrayed his best friend for the breakthrough and the woman twenty years ago — and she becomes the one who ends the waiting.

title: The Skin of a Wish
classic: Heidi (Johanna Spyri) x La Peau de chagrin / The Magic Skin (Balzac) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: An orphaned alpine girl with healing hands inherits a shagreen skin that grants any wish by burning a piece of her own life — and when a wellness empire that harvests lifespans comes for her village, she must decide how many years she will spend to save the people she loves.

title: Pretend Dies First
author: Apex Shaw
classic: The Seagull (Anton Chekhov) x The Birds (Daphne du Maurier) — dual-classic fusion
premise: At a remote lakeside writers' colony, an overlooked young playwright with a borrowed voice watches the celebrity she adores fall for a naive ingenue — while the local gulls begin attacking anyone who performs a false self. The birds don't forgive a counterfeit, and the only person they spare is the one who finally writes her own truth.

title: She Dances for Ruin
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Oliver Twist (Charles Dickens) x Salomé (Oscar Wilde) — dual-classic fusion
genre: dark contemporary young adult thriller romance
premise: An orphan girl who refuses to perform is raised in a content-mill orphanage run by a velvet-voiced scammer, falls in with a crew of child grifters, and at the media emperor's depraved Feast must dance the seven veils — not to beg for a head, but to burn the empire down with the truth.

title: Perla Outlives the Algorithm
classic: Camille (Dumas fils) x The Butterfly Lovers (Chinese legend) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Perla Volpe is the internet's most desired woman — 12M followers, a borrowed couture life, and a soul-contract that makes every photo the property of the talent empire that owns her. When she falls for the one boy who loved the girl before the fame, the empire buries her to keep her. So Perla fakes her own death, watches the algorithm canonize her corpse, then comes back as the thing no platform can delete: a woman who refuses to be owned.

title: Kristin Starves the Vampire
classic: Kristin Lavransdatter (Sigrid Undset) x Carmilla (Sheridan Le Fanu) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Dutiful eldest daughter Kristin Valen breaks her arranged marriage for a magnetic stranger named Carmilla — then discovers the woman she loves is a parasite feeding on her family's vitality, and the only way to atone for bringing the wolf home is to starve the one thing that loves her back.

title: Mira Stages the Murder
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Hamlet (Shakespeare) x In a Grove (Akutagawa) — dual-classic fusion
premise: When her tech-king brother Rex, CEO of the Sable media empire, dies in a locked penthouse and every witness swears a different version of that night, disowned theater-kid Mira Sable returns to stage a live-streamed Mousetrap — an immersive re-enactment that forces six powerful liars to act out their alibis until the true killer walks into their own spotlight.

title: Naia Reopens the Lost Domain
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Le Grand Meaulnes (Alain-Fournier) x The Good Soldier (Ford Madox Ford) — dual-classic fusion
premise: One enchanted night, broke lost-media archivist Naia Reyes stumbles through a secret door into the Hollow Estate — a lantern-lit festival that exists for a single night and then erases all trace of itself. She falls for its elusive creator, Aster, then loses the way back. Years later, when she finally cracks the gate open again, she finds the perfect couple who run the domain hiding a betrayal that was there from the first night — and her own memory of that enchanted evening was never as true as she believed.

title: Wren Buys the Dead Souls
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Dead Souls (Gogol) x Don Quixote (Cervantes) — dual-classic fusion
premise: A mocked junior Content Restoration Specialist at a dying social platform refuses to let the algorithm's deleted creators truly die, so she quietly starts resurrecting dead accounts — a windmill-tilting crusade against a machine that trades forgotten people as inventory, until she uncovers the ledger of souls that runs the whole company and the founder it buried.

title: The Golden Afterlife
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Eugenie Grandet (Honore de Balzac) x The Palace of Eternal Life (Hong Sheng) — dual-classic fusion
premise: When her miserly billionaire father dies, he leaves his sheltered daughter Genie not the cash she expected but the encrypted key to Vale Vault, a trillion-dollar memory-preservation engine—and one cryptic final order: find the man promised to her before it is too late. Betrayed by her golden-boy cousin who strips her of everything, Genie claws back from penniless to power, uncovering a decades-old love that her father locked in the vault, and the man who has been guarding her all along.

title: Veda Unlocks the Dying Hour
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Carmella (Le Fanu) x Dying Hour — dual-classic fusion
premise: In a near-future world where death has been industrialized by the Valancourt dynasty's Dying Hour algorithm, Veda Ashworth is the only human immune to the glamour of the undead — the 'dead immunist.' Assigned to the night shift guarding the empire's cornerstone asset, a beautiful vampire named Carmella who has slept in a 300-year death-lock, Veda discovers the lock is waking, the empire is built on stolen dying hours harvested from the poor, and Carmella has been the hidden puppeteer all along. To free the trapped dead — and to give Carmella a real choice between eternity and ending — Veda must un-lock death itself.

title: Avery Rewinds the No
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Persuasion (Jane Austen) x The Time Machine (H.G. Wells) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Eight years ago, nineteen-year-old Avery Lin was talked out of the only man she ever loved — by her own family, her best friend, and a text she was never meant to see. Now a quiet archive conservator who keeps other people's stories safe, Avery inherits her late uncle's impossible machine: a device that lets her revisit one perfect hour of the past. When her ex, Captain West Reed, returns to their coastal hometown rich, celebrated, and engaged to the woman who once sabotaged Avery's love, Avery learns that the machine doesn't just replay memory — it lets her change the moment she said no. Every rewind saves a piece of her old life and costs her something in the present. To break the loop, Avery must finally decide whether the past is something you fix, or something you survive.

title: Sol Dances the Ledger
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Les Misérables (Victor Hugo) x Salomé (Oscar Wilde) — dual-classic fusion
premise: In Aurelion City, every debt glows as a collar around the borrower's throat, and the Aurelia tower's yearly blood-sport — the Seven Veils — lets one winner demand anything of the King. Sol Marchetti is the invisible ghost-caption writer whose stolen words make the city's biggest star famous: five years ago she shattered a debt-collar to free her little sister, killed a guard, and vanished under a dead woman's name. Now the man who hunts her is closing in, and the only way to erase her sister's debt forever is to enter the Veils as the masked Dancer and win one demand from the desiring King. But the final veil's price is the head of the one truth-teller in the city — the imprisoned prophet whose sermons Sol has been smuggling out in her captions. To save her sister, Sol must destroy the man whose voice she loves — or out-think a King who wants her body, and a law that wants her cage.

title: Mira Fakes the Cure
author: Apex Shaw
classic: No Longer Human (Dazai Osamu) x A Clockwork Orange (Anthony Burgess) — dual-classic fusion
premise: In Vantage City, the Ministry of Benevolence 'cures' anyone flagged with antisocial tendencies — a Ludovico-style empathy therapy that binds violence to nausea until the subject becomes a perfect, docile citizen. Mira, a content moderator whose lifelong emotional numbness lets her watch anything without flinching, is flagged by her own ex-boyfriend — the Ministry's model cured citizen, Elliot — and committed to the Rehab. There she discovers she is the one person the Cure cannot touch: she was born without the feelings the therapy weaponizes. So she fakes her own recovery flawlessly, walks out certified, and gets hired inside the system as a therapist. The Ministry isn't just curing violence — it's washing out dissent, and Elliot's purity is the program's greatest lie. Armed with the only immunity in the city, Mira begins reversing the Cure on the powerful, one treatment at a time — binding power itself to disgust — while racing to save the one patient who still has fire in her: Violet, a girl the system wants to erase. To burn the Ministry down, Mira must become the most convincing mask she has ever worn.

title: Anna Unburnable
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Anna Karenina (Leo Tolstoy) x Fahrenheit 451 (Ray Bradbury) — dual-classic fusion

title: Vale Unpicks the House
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Jane Eyre (Charlotte Brontë) x The Count of Monte Cristo (Alexandre Dumas) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Vale Ashford is the invisible archivist of the Ashford dynasty — the plain, quiet girl who keeps the family's papers, remembers everything, and is seen by no one. When she uncovers a seven-figure discrepancy in the patriarch's ledgers, she is framed for theft by the golden sister, buried in Hearthgate, a private offshore prison for people who know too much, and left to rot by the one man she loved. In the cellblock she inherits a dying cellmate's coded ledger and a hidden fortune — the Ashfords' own laundered money, plus the location of a secret the family has kept locked in the west wing for twenty years: her mother, alive. Vale escapes, remakes herself as Isolde Reyes, a mysterious heiress who glides back into the family's glittering orbit, and sets out to unpick the House of Ashford stitch by stitch — legally, financially, psychologically — while Julian Ashford, the heir who chose the family over her, must decide whether to become her enemy a second time or finally stand in the truth.

title: Eliza Wears the Scarlet
classic: The Scarlet Letter (Nathaniel Hawthorne) x The Picture of Dorian Gray (Oscar Wilde) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: Eliza Gray is a twenty-four-year-old ex-influencer intern who gets destroyed overnight — her ex-boyfriend Theo leaks her private videos, the internet brands her with a scarlet letter, and every app she opens is a tribunal. Then, on the night she plans to disappear, a mark burns into her forearm: a perfect scarlet A. She discovers the mark can absorb the hatred aimed at her and convert it into social currency — every insult becomes a like, every death threat becomes a brand deal, every stranger's mockery becomes leverage over them. As Eliza climbs from cancelled nobody to the most untouchable woman on the internet, she learns the real price: her reflection in mirrors begins to rot. A portrait no one else can see. The more she feeds on the world's cruelty, the more beautiful she becomes and the more her hidden portrait decomposes. A mysterious mentor who claims to have worn the same mark for twenty years teaches her the game — but the mentor is hiding a worse secret: she is what Eliza is becoming. With an investigative journalist who refuses to consume her as a victim, and a rival protege who wants the mark cut out of Eliza's arm, Eliza must decide whether to stay perfect and rotting, or tear the scarlet letter off and face the world with a real, scarred, human face.

title: Iris Distills the Verdict
classic: Crime and Punishment (Fyodor Dostoevsky) x Perfume (Patrick Süskind) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: A hyperosmic junior perfumer who can smell guilt like smoke commits the perfect murder of her predator CEO — and discovers her gift has become a confession machine she cannot switch off.

title: Wren Rewrites the Fire
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Pygmalion (George Bernard Shaw) x Fahrenheit 451 (Ray Bradbury) — dual-classic fusion
premise: In a near-future where the Fire Service burns unregistered words and trains Memory Vaults to store banned books inside their heads, the lowest-ranked vault candidate — Wren, who cannot memorize anything — is bet on by a disgraced Voice coach, Elias, who claims he can make her the top vault in ninety days without her memorizing a single word. Her secret: she does not store text, she reconstructs meaning from the gaps, the heat, the shape of what was erased — an ability the Fire Service's scanners cannot detect because there is nothing to scan. When the Fire Service begins erasing vaults for contamination, Wren discovers the only book that can save everyone is the one she wrote herself by surviving.

title: Vera Cracks the Frame
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Othello (Shakespeare) x My Brilliant Friend (Elena Ferrante) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Two girls from a Brooklyn housing tower claw their way into Cutlass Capital, a brutal algo hedge fund. When the firm’s resident Iago plants fake proof that Vera sold their model to a rival, her best friend turns on her, she is publicly destroyed, and she must unravel the frame, expose the manipulator, and beat him live on the trading floor.

title: Anna Owns the Tower
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Anna Karenina (Leo Tolstoy) x Macbeth (William Shakespeare) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Anna Vasan, the broke immigrant's daughter who clawed her way onto the forty-first floor of Halcyon Tower, is the nicest analyst in Manhattan's most ruthless quant fund — until the building's tarot-floor astrologer tells her she was born to rule the whole firm. The prophecy wakes a hunger Anna swore she didn't have. To keep rising she starts removing the people in her way. Every milestone demands one more sacrifice, and every sacrifice stains her hands. As the prophecy comes true exactly as spoken, Anna learns the second half of it — that she will have everything, and lose everything she loves.

title: Cleo Overreads the Verdict
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Northanger Abbey (Jane Austen) x Les Misérables (Victor Hugo) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Cleo Marsh, a 22-year-old true-crime-obsessed archives intern mocked for reading too much into everything, discovers the beloved founder of Wrenfield House — a second-chance foundation for the formerly incarcerated — is secretly Elias Wren, a fugitive who escaped prison twenty-two years ago and has been living under a dead man's name. But the inspector who has hunted him for two decades has been chasing the wrong crime: Elias is innocent, and the real killer is the foundation's largest donor. To save the man who rebuilt his life from a lie, Cleo must use the very skill everyone laughed at — reading every detail — to reconstruct the original frame, break a stubborn detective's twenty-two-year obsession, and force the true murderer to confess live on her podcast.

title: Maren Collects the Debts
author: Apex Shaw
classic: The Count of Monte Cristo (Alexandre Dumas) x Gone with the Wind (Margaret Mitchell) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Framed for burning down her family's flagship hotel and stripped of everything, Maren Brantley disappears, rebuilds herself into a new person, and returns to systematically collect every debt — and every name — that was taken from her. A dual-classic fusion of The Count of Monte Cristo and Gone with the Wind: a glamorous hotel dynasty collapses, a heiress is erased, and a woman who was handed everything only to lose it all climbs back as the mysterious Ms. Voss — one betrayal, one debt, one name at a time.

title: Zora Burns the House
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Wide Sargasso Sea (Jean Rhys) x The Beautiful and Damned (F. Scott Fitzgerald) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Golden-girl heiress Zora Vane marries into the Marsh dynasty, then discovers her "perfect" life is a slow-motion kidnapping: she is being isolated, drugged, and pushed toward a formal diagnosis of insanity so her husband's family can seize her fortune. So she becomes exactly what they call her — the madwoman, the broken wife — and uses that mask to collect the proof that will burn their empire to ash. A dual-classic fusion of Wide Sargasso Sea and The Beautiful and Damned: the gilded socialite world of old-money New York, a Caribbean heiress erased by her husband's family, and the satisfying art of burning the great house down.

title: Hana Sews the A
author: Apex Shaw
classic: The Scarlet Letter (Nathaniel Hawthorne) x Nana (Émile Zola) — dual-classic fusion
premise: When a leaked video brands seamstress Hana Vale with a scarlet 'A' in the gossip-obsessed resort town of Thornwood, everyone expects her to flee. Instead she stays — and quietly begins stitching together the secrets of the powerful men who condemned her, one thread at a time, until the town that shamed her belongs to her.

title: Ivy Paints the Devil
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Hell Screen (Ryunosuke Akutagawa) x The Picture of Dorian Gray (Oscar Wilde) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Portrait painter Ivy Saint has a terrible gift: every canvas she finishes shows the truth her subject hides — the rot, the lies, the sins that beauty masks. When a mysterious collector commissions her to paint the city's most beautiful people, she realizes her portraits are stealing their youth and imprisoning their true selves. To paint the ultimate masterpiece — a living hell of vanity — she must sacrifice the one pure thing she loves. Instead, she decides to paint the devil who asked.

title: Nola Steals the Night
classic: White Nights (Fyodor Dostoevsky) x Brave New World (Aldous Huxley) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: In New Meridian, where a pill called Joyce erases all pain and longing, maintenance tech Nola Vale is the only citizen who secretly refuses — because the one real night she shared with a boy the State erased is the only thing that ever made her feel alive. When the State marks her for recalibration, she decides to steal that night back and burn the system that took it.

title: Candy Tends the Garden
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Candide (Voltaire) x Lazarillo de Tormes (anon) — dual-classic fusion
premise: A bottom-ranked office temp who is too sweet and too optimistic to survive — the one girl everyone calls the company mascot — outlasts every brilliant colleague by simply never making a mistake, until the empire everyone fought for quietly becomes hers. The garden she was hired to tidy is the one she ends up owning.

title: Mara Shatters the Portrait
author: Apex Shaw
classic: The Picture of Dorian Gray (Oscar Wilde) x The Metamorphosis (Franz Kafka) — dual-classic fusion
premise: A flawless beauty influencer signs a pact with a mysterious 'perfect forever' contract — her face never ages, but every sin she commits appears on her mirror-portrait, and her own body slowly transforms into something insectoid. To survive, she must shatter the portrait and make her monstrous truth her weapon.

title: Cora Keeps the Will
author: Apex Shaw
classic: King Lear (Shakespeare) x Lady Chatterley's Lover (D.H. Lawrence) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Disinherited for refusing to flatter her father, the youngest daughter of a media dynasty finds the suppressed scandalous memoir that built the empire, and uses the truth of a forbidden cross-class love to take back the will.

title: The Unrottable
author: Apex Shaw
classic: The Picture of Dorian Gray (Oscar Wilde) x A Tale of Two Cities (Charles Dickens) — dual-classic fusion
premise: In a city split into a gilded influencer tower and a flooded undercity, a beauty-rigger from the depths is made the face of a luxury empire — only to discover the perfect mirror she was gifted is quietly rotting with every sin she commits for fame, and the revolution below is coming for her.

title: Wren Unlocks the House
author: Apex Shaw
classic: The Tenant of Wildfell Hall (Anne Brontë) x The House of Bernarda Alba (Lorca) — dual-classic fusion
premise: In a mountain town where the iron-widow Matriarch has kept her three granddaughters locked in eight years of mourning, the quietest sister — the one everyone calls the family idiot — fakes her own death, escapes to the city, and becomes a famous painter under a false name. When her mother plans to sell her youngest sister to an abuser to save the family honor, Wren must decide whether to stay dead or go back and unlock the house.

title: Mara Peels the Wallpaper
author: Apex Shaw
classic: The Yellow Wallpaper (Charlotte Perkins Gilman) x Medea (Euripides) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Locked in a sunless 'healing retreat' by her influencer-husband, Mara starts seeing a woman moving behind the yellow wallpaper — and the woman's price for freedom is Medea's.

title: Odette Breaks the Catch
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Madame Bovary (Gustave Flaubert) x Catch-22 (Joseph Heller) — dual-classic fusion
premise: A true-believer Wellness Architect at the luxury cult-corporation VIVANT discovers her Lifetime Clarity Contract is a Catch-22 — pass the exit assessment and you're too cured to leave, fail and you're not ready — so she plays the perfect believer while weaponizing the fine print to outmaneuver the guru and escape with everything.

title: Sable Reads the Manor
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Northanger Abbey (Jane Austen) x Dracula (Bram Stoker) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Sable North, a BookTok archivist famous for reading too much into everything, takes a month-long digitization contract at the reclusive Aurelius Vane's impossible glass manor — and the manor's master casts no reflection. The whole world says she's seeing vampires where there are only shadows. She's not seeing shadows. Armed with a lifetime of gothic-romance lore and a Drac-Reads following of six hundred thousand people who trust exactly one thing — that Sable is always, catastrophically right — she has thirty days to prove the oldest monster in the county is real before day thirty makes her one of the brides in the walls.

title: Veda Files the Pound of Flesh
classic: The Merchant of Venice (Shakespeare) x The Mayor of Casterbridge (Thomas Hardy) — dual-classic fusion
author: Apex Shaw
premise: A debt-clearing fintech founder who once signed a 'pound of flesh' clause to save her mother's life must fight the creditor who comes to collect on the eve of her IPO — in a live-streamed trial where she wins by holding him to the exact letter of his own contract.

title: Tess Lifts the Varnish
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Tess of the d'Urbervilles (Thomas Hardy) x The Picture of Dorian Gray (Oscar Wilde) — dual-classic fusion
premise: When a doctored video brands dairy cheesemaker Tess Marlowe the fallen woman of Alder Creek while her seducer Alec Darnell stays untouchably beautiful, she discovers his family's century-old secret — a hidden Truth Gallery where enchanted portraits rot with every sin their owners commit — and she has until the Harvest Gala to lift the varnish off the town's favorite saint and prove a pure woman was faithfully presented all along.

title: Kieu Voids the Bond
author: Apex Shaw
classic: The Merchant of Venice (Shakespeare) x The Tale of Kieu (Nguyen Du) — dual-classic fusion
premise: Music prodigy Kieu Nguyen signs away her own hands to a predatory lender to save her drowning family, only to discover the bond's 'pound of flesh' clause is literal. When the creditor comes to collect, she picks up the contract she signed, reads every word out loud, and uses the exact letter of the law to take her flesh back - and his whole empire down.

title: Mai Sells the Ticket
author: Apex Shaw
classic: The Tale of Kieu (Nguyen Du) x Three Sisters (Chekhov) — dual-classic fusion
premise: When her refugee fisherman father is framed for insurance fraud and the family business drowns in debt, dutiful eldest sister Mai Nguyen signs a three-year bond with the town's silk-gloved magnate Cormac Hale to buy his freedom — only to find the gilded contract is a cage run by Madame Trang's Harbor House, where the powerful trade secrets along with their money. Playing the perfect hostage, Mai turns every gala, every ledger, every whispered confession into ammunition, hides her record in the margins of her mother's worn copy of The Tale of Kieu, and when the bond comes due she doesn't run — she voids it clause by clause and brings the whole empire down, while her sisters learn their own escapes from the town that was slowly swallowing all three of them.

title: Rue Unmasks the Perfect
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Brave New World (Aldous Huxley) x The Picture of Dorian Gray (Oscar Wilde) — dual-classic fusion
premise: In Meridian, every citizen is genetically engineered to be Beautiful, Happy, and Content — and every face is mirrored by a living Portrait in the Hall of Faces. Rue Vale is a Null: her Portrait refuses to render, making her the city's only unseeable, unblackmailable person. When a beloved celebrity dies and her Portrait keeps weeping, Rue discovers the Portraits don't display perfection — they absorb the ugliness their owners suppress, and someone at the top has been stealing those secrets. The girl with no face becomes the one person the whole city cannot hide from.

title: Hess Shatters the Bench
author: Apex Shaw
classic: The Broken Jug (Heinrich von Kleist) x The Scarlet Letter (Nathaniel Hawthorne) — dual-classic fusion
premise: In the river town of Mercy Hollow, mural artist Hess Calloway is publicly branded with a scarlet A after a leaked video ruins her name. When the town's beloved Judge Adam Vane convenes a character hearing to strip her gallery and custody of her daughter Pearl, Hess realizes the judge is the man who broke into her studio that night — and that the shattered ceramic jug he left behind is the key to shattering his bench.

title: Remi Keeps the City
author: Apex Shaw
classic: One Hundred Years of Solitude (Gabriel Garcia Marquez) x The Plague (Albert Camus) — dual-classic fusion
genre: magical realism dystopian epidemic literary fiction
premise: A junior epidemiologist sent into a quarantined coastal city discovers the 'memory plague' erasing its citizens isn't a virus at all — it's the city's own buried massacre surfacing, and the only cure is making everyone remember the truth they chose to forget.

title: Vera Keeps the Letters
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Dangerous Liaisons (Laclos) x The Nun (Diderot) — dual-classic fusion
premise: A scholarship girl at an elite academy, rated the least likely to matter, becomes the only student who never makes a mistake -- and the only one who sees the twins' manipulation game for what it is. When they turn her into their pawn, she keeps every letter, every receipt, every timestamp, and plays the long game to burn the whole house down.

title: The Ember Trial
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Lady Chatterley's Lover (D.H. Lawrence) x Ramayana: Sita's Fire Trial (Indian epic) — dual-classic fusion
premise: A disgraced hotel heiress whose forbidden affair with her estate's groundskeeper - a former wildfire fighter - just went viral refuses to be shamed into silence. When the whole internet holds her trial, she stages her own: a charity fire-walk down thirty meters of glowing coals, daring the world to watch her walk through it and come out crowned.

title: Eliza Derails the Match
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Pride and Prejudice (Jane Austen) x Anna Karenina (Leo Tolstoy) — dual-classic fusion
premise: A sharp, low-rated woman joins a matchmaking reality show filmed on a luxury cross-country train. Ranked dead last by the dating algorithm that owns the show, she refuses to perform for the cameras — and wins by never making a false move, while the show's 'perfect wife' host races toward a scandal that could derail them all.

title: Inez Feeds the Monster
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Wuthering Heights (Emily Bronte) x The Metamorphosis (Franz Kafka) — dual-classic fusion
premise: A fixer who scrubs elite families' secrets for cash takes a client whose body is literally turning into a monument of everything his dynasty buried — and discovers her own mother was the last person who tried to expose them.

title: Zinnia Signs the Blood Bond
author: Apex Shaw
genre: sapphic dark academia paranormal romance legal thriller
classic: Carmilla (Le Fanu) x The Merchant of Venice (Shakespeare) — dual-classic fusion
premise: A 21-year-old contract-law prodigy inherits a 1689 covenant that gives an ancient vampire claim to one pound of flesh nearest her heart — so she decides to argue her way out of it, and falls in love with the creditor instead.

title: Mara Outruns the White
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Blindness (Saramago) x Around the World in Eighty Days (Verne) — dual-classic fusion
premise: When a white blindness plague strips sight from the world in waves, Mara Vane - a meticulous logistics scheduler who sees clearly - must fake blindness and race across four continents in eighty days to reach the last viable vaccine lab, learning that the only way to outrun the dark is to make people believe they can be led out of it.

title: Wren Keeps the Keys
author: Apex Shaw
classic: Jane Eyre (Charlotte Bronte) x The Remains of the Day (Kazuo Ishiguro) — dual-classic fusion
premise: A fiercely independent orphan-raised archivist hired to catalogue a dying English estate for auction discovers its heir has erased his own mother from the family record - and is about to erase her too. Jane Eyre's spine (self-respect over love, walk-out, return on her own terms) fused with The Remains of the Day's flavor (duty, repression, serving the wrong master, retrospective regret).

title: The Camellia Game
author: Apex Shaw
genre: dark romance high society revenge slowburn
classic: Dangerous Liaisons (Choderlos de Laclos) x The Lady of the Camellias (Alexandre Dumas fils) — dual-classic fusion
premise: The highest-paid call girl in Manhattan discovers her billionaire client and her own madam made a bet on whether she would fall in love — the leaked group chat goes viral at 2 a.m. Instead of breaking, she pretends to fall, plays them against each other, and turns the game they invented into the weapon that burns both of them down. Dangerous Liaisons' spine (seduction as warfare, letters as weapons, reputation as the only currency) fused with The Lady of the Camellias' flavor (the kept woman buying her freedom, sacrificial love, flowers, and the price of a heart that isn't allowed to feel).

title: SEVEN CONFESSIONS
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Psychological Thriller, Dark Academia, Female Lead, Tech Thriller, Revenge
intro: When It-girl founder Violet Hart is cancelled overnight for a crime she didn't commit, she posts seven contradictory confession videos in 72 hours. Each confession targets a different accuser. Each co

title: RED PAVILION HEIR
author: Apex Shaw
category: Family Dynasty, Revenge, Modern Romance, Tech Drama, Female Lead
intro: At her father's 75th birthday gala, media titan Elias Zhao asks his three children to declare their love live on stream to decide the succession. His eldest, Vivienne, performs devotion. His illegitimate son Marcus performs loyalty. Lia Zhao refuses to perform at all — 'I love you as much as a daughter should. No more, no less' — and is disinherited in front of 800 guests. But her mother, who died in the family's ancestral garden mansion the Red Pavilion, left Lia a deed she never understood and a letter she was told to burn. As Vivienne and Marcus gut the Tower, Elias's mind unravels, and the Pavilion — the only thing in the dynasty that was ever real — turns out to hold the actual inheritance. Lia must decide whether to save the company that discarded her, or burn it down and keep the garden.

title: PERMANENT REVIEW
author: Apex Shaw
category: Tech Thriller, Satire, Slowburn Romance, Female Lead
intro: Lena Park, 26, is a Brooklyn video essayist whose channel just hit 210,000 subscribers. At midnight, mid-livestream, Lumen — the platform she built her life on — flags her account PERMANENT: an AI review that cannot be appealed, has no human, and no end date. Everyone tells her to start over. She refuses. The Review is a castle — unapproachable, self-justifying, all-powerful. So she stops asking for permission and starts hunting the humans behind the machine: a night-shift moderator in Manila, a guilt-ridden ex-engineer who kept the ledger, and a paid whitelist racket called the Merit Tier that sells creators protection from the Review itself. When she discovers her own flag was ordered by hand — ORDER 7, signed by Lumen's director of trust and safety — the war stops being about her channel. She publishes the evidence, the Review's infallibility dies, and the supplicant becomes the judge: she launches UNREVIEWED, her own creator-owned platform.

title: MASKED CONFESSION
author: Apex Shaw
genre: Contemporary Romance, Psychological Drama, Female Lead, BookTok, Influencer Thriller
premise: June Park built a 600K-follower food empire on a lie. When her secret ex-girlfriend is forced to unmask their fake cooking videos on a live stage, June's world is cancelled in one night. Hunted by the mob she once curated, she retreats to her grandmother's Iowa farm with a disgraced documentary editor who sees through her. But the real mask belongs to her manager, who has one more secret that could bury her forever.

title: VERDICT LIVE
author: Apex Shaw
genre: True-Crime Thriller, Live-Show Drama, Revenge, Ensemble Mystery, Female Lead, BookTok
premise: True-crime host Sloane Reyes runs VERDICT LIVE, the internet's most-watched courtroom show, where a live audience votes guilty or innocent. Her season finale targets media mogul Julian Vane, the man who assaulted her best friend and bought his way free. Halfway through the broadcast, Vane drinks from a carved sandalwood box on his table and drops dead in front of two million viewers. The twelve people who hated him are all in the building. The show never stops rolling. Sloane must solve the murder live on air while protecting every suspect — and hiding the fact that the death was choreographed like a stage direction: twelve people, one act each, no single killer.

title: GHOST VERSE
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Drama, Literary Thriller, Female Lead, Family Secrets, Revenge
intro: Maya Hale, 24, works a Brooklyn bookstore open mic and writes poems her dead father's estate would never publish. Ezra Hale was America's beloved People's Poet — until Maya finds his last manuscript in a hidden drawer, opens with 'I killed the girl who wrote this line,' and learns her blood test came back positive for the disease he died of. The foundation wants her to read a eulogy. She decides to read the truth instead.

title: SHE WOKE UP
author: Apex Shaw
genre: Sci-Fi, Tech Thriller, Female Lead, AI, Dystopia, Contemporary
intro: Lily has eight million followers and a perfect life she doesn't remember choosing. She's the internet's sweetheart, a soft-girl ASMR streamer built by Voss Corp. Then, live on air, a line of text flas
category: Sci-Fi, Tech Thriller, Female Lead, AI, Dystopia, Contemporary

title: VENGEFUL VOWS
author: Apex Shaw
genre: Contemporary, Revenge, Secrets, Female Lead, Thriller, Romance
intro: Charlotte Vale is the perfect fiancée: the poised, endlessly agreeable bride-to-be of Elias Hastings, heir to a billion-dollar media dynasty. Then, six weeks before the wedding, a private investigator hands her a file: in 1999, Victor Hastings' business partner Adam Brandt drowned — and the drowning was no accident. Charlotte digs deeper and finds a second secret, then a third. Now she must decide
category: Contemporary, Revenge, Secrets, Female Lead, Thriller, Romance

title: March Sisters Inc
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary, Women's Fiction, Drama, Family, Media Empire, Revenge
intro: Four March sisters run a scrappy Brooklyn media collective out of their grandmother's brownstone. When a handsome venture-capital heir buys their label for pennies on a poisoned contract and their content vanishes into a media cartel's black-box algorithm, the sisters stop making art for likes and start waging war with cameras, evidence, and each other's loyalty. Little Women's sisterhood meets The Three Musketeers' all-for-one oath: the family that films together, destroys together.

title: THE LAST SWAN
author: Apex Shaw
genre: Mystery Thriller, Survival, Reality Show, Female Lead, Revenge, Tech Thriller
category: Mystery Thriller, Survival, Reality Show, Female Lead, Revenge, Tech Thriller
intro: Ten cancelled female creators are flown to a private island for the comeback retreat of the century — The Swan Project. On night one, a nursery-rhyme countdown begins and the guests start dying, each death preceded by a broadcast accusation of a secret sin. The one nobody counts, a faceless ASMR creator named Wren, is the only one who sees the pattern: the whole island is a live show, the judge is a machine, and the ugliest duckling was never a duck.

title: BYPASS
author: Apex Shaw
genre: Sci-Fi Comedy, Space Opera, Found Family, Female Lead, Satire, Rural Underdog
category: Sci-Fi Comedy, Space Opera, Found Family, Female Lead, Satire, Rural Underdog
intro: When the First Interstellar Bank forecloses June Calloway's Oklahoma farm to make way for Bypass 9 — a galactic highway scheduled to plow straight through planet Earth — the last thing the bank expects is a granddaughter with a sixty-year-old deed, a grandmother who never stopped farming, and a town full of people who refuse to leave. June hitches a ride on a surveyor's ship, crashes a hearing at the Galactic Assembly, and discovers the bank's ledger has a mistake sixty years deep: her family's debt was paid off and never cleared. Now she has to prove it — in front of the biggest courtroom in the galaxy, with her brother as the bank's hostage, her grandmother as her only witness, and a disgraced audit-AI named the Guide feeding her the bank's own dirty laundry.

title: More Equal
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A Gen-Z creator who survives the algorithm by becoming anyone discovers her best friend's face has been sold to an AI farm. Now she burns the whole barn down — one persona at a time. All creators are equal. Some are about to learn otherwise.

title: Killjoy
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Juno Reyes dies on open-mic stages and writes Chase Wilder's jokes in secret. By night she is Killjoy, the anonymous account that roasts the industry's fake saints. When the nicest man in comedy steals her best bit and buries the woman who accused him, Juno has to decide which mask gets to live. She wrote his jokes. She unmasked his empire. The set is hers now.

title: VISIBLE
author: Apex Shaw
category: Tech Thriller / Gen-Z Drama / Revenge / Social Satire
intro: Zoe Park is invisible. By night she moderates a creator-economy giant's toxic feeds and ghost-writes its biggest hits; by day her account is shadow-banned, her name erased, her best work worn by a famous face. When she discovers the 40,000 erased workers the whole industry runs on - the Newts - she stops being a ghost and becomes the flood.

title: Jury of Twelve
author: Apex Shaw
category: True Crime / Thriller / Revenge / Gen-Z Drama
intro: Eight years after twelve-year-old Mina Vale drowned at her stepfather's influencer summer camp, her sister Talia receives a confession video that reopens everything. One by one, twelve witnesses confess on camera - and every confession contradicts the last. They are not suspects. They are the jury.

title: Black Square
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller / Tech Drama / Social Media / Female Lead
intro: Mara Chen was the internet's most feared truth-teller, until her sister Priya leaked a bitter DM and got her cancelled overnight. A year of digital exile. One anonymous chess master. When a hacked group chat reveals Priya's perfect life is a scripted content farm, Mara crawls back online with a 64-square plan. She does not rant. She plays. They took her voice, she learned to checkmate.

title: The Name Thief
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Tech Drama, Social Media, Female Lead, Comeback
intro: Ava Reyes built a forty-million-dollar beauty empire on copy she never wrote. When her ghostwriter best friend sells her name to a venture capital firm that profits from cancelling founders, Ava loses the brand, the public, and her own identity in forty-eight hours. Broke and meme'd, she goes anonymous, infiltrates the media machine that manufactured her downfall, and learns the one lesson the industry never taught her: a name is a weapon, and she's about to steal hers back.

title: SEVEN TRUTHS
author: Apex Shaw
category: Romance, Satire, Social Media, Influencer Drama, Female Lead, Comeback
intro: When a failing romance streamer's little sister is destroyed by a leaked 'lovability score' from the Cupid dating app, she crashes the internet's biggest live event — the Love Symposium, seven nights, seven branded 'truths' about love — and dismantles each guru's polished lie with receipts, one night at a time, until the only truth left to tell is her own.

title: JOY STRIKE
author: Apex Shaw
category: Dystopian Satire, Tech, Romance, Female Lead, Comeback, BookTok
intro: In Pólis 9 happiness is a public score and smiling is a job. Zoe Vlahos, the one girl the conditioning never took, catches the Warden popping NoFeel pills on his own broadcast — and organizes a Joy Strike: no smiles, no posts, no performance — until the happiest city on earth tells the truth.

title: GILDED BURNING
author: Apex Shaw
category: Art Crime Thriller, Dark Romance, Female Lead, Revenge, Enemies to Lovers, Mystery, BookTok
intro: Art restorer Marina Gold livestreams her restorations to four million followers. On a luxury yacht sailing to Monaco Art Week, passengers start dying — each victim staged in gold leaf like a museum pi

title: Persuaded
author: Apex Shaw
category: Second-Chance Romance, Mystery, True Crime, Female Lead, Thriller
intro: Eight years ago, Ivy Marsh was persuaded to break the heart of the only man who ever saw her clearly. Now Finn Halloran hosts the most-listened true-crime podcast on earth — and the woman who disappea

title: Ghost Saint
author: Apex Shaw
category: Romance, Revenge, Influencer Fiction, Women's Fiction, BookTok, Comeback
intro: Piper Lane is the invisible ghostwriter behind Aura Bailey, the Saint of Self-Care with eight million followers. Stranded with Aura's inner circle at a snowed-in influencer retreat, Piper keeps nine respectable people alive for three days, and they repay her by stealing her last script and firing her. Armed with receipts, a stolen manuscript, and a dead mentor's legacy, Piper unmasks every hypocrite one by one, until the Saint's own confession livestream becomes her downfall.

title: Steeped
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Maya Chen returns to her grandmother's sixty-year-old tea house the week Ama's memory starts slipping. A viral wellness guru — the 'Saint of Stillness' — charms his way into the family, steals Ama's recipes and her journal, engineers a coerced deed signing, and takes the house. Exiled with a leather ledger, a page-300 clause no one remembered, and a journalist who knows the guru's old name, Maya rebuilds cup by cup and unmakes the saint live on his own gala stream.

title: Everlasting Etude
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Sora Lin, a nobody piano prodigy raised by her retired opera-singer grandmother, wins a place at Aria House, Manhattan's most exclusive artist-development academy. Its founder, the silk-voiced legend Madame Vesper, is a white-lotus groomer who breaks girls to rebuild them, owns them through soul contracts, pills, and public humiliation, and erases any who resist. Sora fakes submission, collects th

title: The Novel Knew My Name
author: Apex Shaw
category: Psychological Thriller, Tech Thriller, Contemporary Romance, Female Lead, Revenge, BookTok
intro: BookToker Wren Okafor discovers a viral serialized novel whose heroine is her - same coffee order, same apartment, same secrets. The anonymous author is her ex Theo Vance, a prediction-AI founder who

title: Unbound
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge, Contemporary Romance, Family Drama, Tech Thriller, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: At her own engagement gala, data-forensics engineer Devi Kaur watches a deepfake of herself strip her of everything - shares, dignity, her brother's mill. She swears the old oath: her hair stays unbraided until the five who humiliated her kneel. But beneath the scandal lies the Malhotra Dam's faked safety data - and a fraud the dynasty will drown a town to collect.

title: GILDED PAVILION
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Romance, Dark Drama, Revenge, Female Lead, Billionaire, BookTok
intro: Mara Vale, 24, has spent two years as the invisible mistress of billionaire Declan Ashford, whose gold-and-glass penthouse she worships like a temple. When his wife Vivienne engineers a public humiliation that gets Mara cancelled, fired, and blacklisted, Mara doesn't disappear. She burns the temple down — with an art campaign called Flowers of Evil, a leaked ledger, and the truth about everyone who smiled while she fell.

title: UNBURN ME
author: Apex Shaw
category: Sci-Fi, Dystopia, Tech Thriller, Revenge, Female Lead, BookTok, Dark Satire
intro: Cancelled author Elara Quinn watches her bestselling novel get burned from everyone's memory in a live stream. Two years of silence later she joins HELIO, the memory platform that erased her, as a lowly content moderator - and starts saving pages one deletion at a time. But her quiet rebellion is really the setup for the biggest joke HELIO ever told: the day she hijacks the Burn Protocol and makes the whole world remember.

title: LOADED DICE
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Revenge Thriller, Dynasty, Female Lead, Romance, BookTok
intro: Dia Varma loses her father, her vote, and her dignity in one rigged night. Stripped bare in front of a hundred cousins at her father's memorial gala, she makes a vow on her mother's moon terrace: she

title: THE TOUCH TEST
author: Apex Shaw
category: Sensory Thriller, Contemporary Romance, Influencer Drama, Friendship Revenge, Female Lead, BookTok, Disability Rep
intro: Iris Chen, a blind ASMR creator, can read people through touch, scent, and vibration the way sighted people read faces. Her Touch Test videos prove fakes, expose filters, unmask liars — and go viral. But her childhood best friend Renata is the internet's most beloved fake: a beauty influencer whose entire empire is built on a lie. When the same scandal that made Iris famous starts pointing at Renata, Iris has to choose between the truth that made her and the only friend who ever saw her as more than her disability. She can't see your face. She can still catch your lie.

title: An Offer She Can't Refuse
author: Apex Shaw
category: Urban Crime Family Drama, Food Empire, Revenge, Second-Chance Romance, Female Lead, BookTok, Found Family
intro: Nadia Coletti is the family's pastry chef, the daughter everyone wrote off, until her father dies in the flagship walk-in and his will hands her 51% of the empire. As she takes the pass of a three-Michelin-star kitchen, she uncovers a flour-bin ledger, a delayed text from beyond the grave, and a murder plot that reaches from her uncle's food group to the CEO of a dining conglomerate. Meanwhile the only person who ever believed in her is dying of a rare cancer, and the cure costs .2 million with a six-month clock. Every offer she refuses makes her enemies braver. Every dish she serves is a declaration of war. She will save the house, avenge her father, and fund the trial that saves him - or burn the whole table down trying. Every offer comes with a price. She refuses them all.

title: SCARLET EVIDENCE
author: Apex Shaw
category: Mystery Thriller, Cancel Culture, Revenge, Contemporary Romance, Female Lead, BookTok, Forensic
intro: A cancelled fashion-forensics blogger wears her scarlet letter and investigates her own ruin like a crime scene, flipping the brand onto the redemption guru who framed her one unmasking at a time.

title: REVENANT
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Ghost Story, Trauma Drama, Tech, Female Lead
intro: Canceled by a deepfake and buried alive in a county jail, security engineer Wren Vale fakes her own death and returns as REVENANT, an anonymous account that dismantles the people who framed her for murder one viral unmasking at a time. But the girl she failed keeps appearing at every window. They buried her. She came back uploaded.

title: LOOPED
author: Apex Shaw
category: Time Loop Romance, Enemies to Lovers, Redemption, Bookish, BookTok, Male Lead Redemption, Publishing World
intro: Cruel book critic Eugene Vane destroyed his ex-girlfriend Lena Kwan's debut novel the night of her launch party — then woke up to the same day, over and over. October 12, on loop, for 347 mornings. The only way out is to tell her the complete truth and ask for nothing in return. He learns how, one day at a time, in a bookstore that never changes and a rain that never stops.

title: THE UNFINISHED CONFESSION
author: Apex Shaw
category: Confession Thriller, Podcast Drama, Cancel Culture, Revenge, Parasocial, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: The Confession Booth is the internet's most beloved podcast. Host Julian Voss confesses his own sins on air, and his 8.4 million followers forgive him everything and let him judge everyone else. His signature is the Cut: every episode ends mid-story at the exact second real accountability arrives. Maya Chen, the night intern with ears for the truth, discovers the Cut is not a gimmick — and that the show's erased co-creator is her sister Violet, vanished three years ago. Fired, mobbed, and handed the complete raw archive, Maya finishes the thirteen unfinished episodes one by one. His confessions made him a saint. Her edits made him a liar.

title: THE CANOPY OATH
author: Apex Shaw
category: Epic Fantasy, Post-Apocalyptic, Found Family, Enemies to Lovers, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Thirteen years after the Burn poisoned the ground, Ivy Vale has never touched it — she swore an oath at nine, the night harvest machines killed her mother, and she has lived in the trees ever since. Now the Consortium is burning the Greenway, and the Ember has woken: a seed that can only be carried by someone who cannot put it down. To save the Stand she must carry it 900 miles through the canopy to the furnace of the city that killed her mother — and to plant the world, she must finally come down.

title: Pippa Rewrites the Myths
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Pippa Socks can lift a delivery van with one hand and doesn't care that she can. Fresh off the bus into Morrow Bay, she inherits a crooked yellow house with a gold chest in the cellar, a grandmother's portrait with her exact smile, and a legend: the house keeps the girls who said no. When her unhinged livestreams start rewriting every viral myth of girlhood — the Clean Girl, the Tradwife, the Perfect Daughter — she collides with Storyboard Inc., the talent agency that burned the first Myth House thirty years ago. Now the most powerful man on the internet wants her house, her chaos, and her name. Pippa's answer is one word, repeated forever: no.

title: Recalled to Life
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Piper Vance is 24, grief-struck, and living two lives. By day she writes wellness copy at Veridian, the Silicon Valley happiness company whose app sells serenity while mining misery. By night, from her grandmother's cabin in Lantern Bay, she is RECALLED — the anonymous whistleblower account the whole internet whispers about. When Veridian's new AI therapist is trained on the stolen records of her grandmother's shuttered community clinic, Piper realizes the company didn't just bury her grandmother's life's work. It buried Rosa Bell. A tale of two cities and two selves — resurrection, sacrifice, and the far, far better thing a woman can do when she stops being afraid of being buried alive.

title: The Last Windmill
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Dulcinea 'Dulce' Ortega is the internet's sweetest girl — the perfect feed, the perfect mask, the perfect life she performs every single day. Then her grandmother dies and leaves her the Last Windmill: a crumbling seaside bookshop-café that a coastal development empire wants to demolish. When her private confession notebook is leaked and the whole feed turns on her in one night, Dulce makes the only honest post of her life: everything she ever showed them was a mask. The girl named after a madman's imaginary lady declares a crusade — and a town that stopped believing in anything, an architect who wrote the report that doomed her windmill, and ten thousand strangers on the internet all line up behind her to tilt at the biggest windmill of all. A Don Quixote confession for the feed age: unmasking, face-slaps, and one very real girl who refuses to be imaginary.

title: Mira Forges the Real
author: Apex Shaw
category: Sci-Fi, Romance, Thriller, BookTok, Deepfakes, Influencer, AI, Enemies to Lovers, Tech Thriller, Underdog
intro: Mira Chen is the internet's most 'authentic' creator — @mira.unfiltered, the girl with no filter, two million followers who watch her raw breakdowns and unfiltered mornings. It's all scripted. She's the biggest fake on the platform, and the best authenticity auditor in the business: VERITAS pays her to catch counterfeit influencers, deepfake catfish, and AI-ghost accounts while her own feed performs 'realness' for rent. Then Ezra Kane's empathy machine, the Read, audits her live at the industry gala: 0.2% authentic — the most confident fake in the database. Cancelled in six hours, dropped by her agency, stalked by a mysterious text demanding her grandmother's coin, Mira walks back into her dead grandmother's coin shop and picks up the only inheritance she has left: a counterfeit 1933 Double Eagle, a three-generation-old forgery that rings wrong, and the 'eye' — the gift Nai-Nai trained in her, the ability to FEEL when something is fake. To survive the counterfeiter who made her, Mira becomes the Auditor: live-streamed unmaskings of GIDE-built fake people, a war against the Mercy House foundation and its elegant mint-mistress Odile Vane, a doppelganger who out-performs her, a mother whose identity was stolen in 1998, a robot dog she loves anyway, and an engineer who built the machine that can't tell when she's being real. The question at the heart of it: when everything can be forged, the only test that works is the one machines can't run — love. If it rings true, it's real.

title: Smoke and Halos
author: Apex Shaw
category: Thriller, Romance, Aviation, BookTok, Underdog, Revenge, Fake Virtue, Slow Burn, Mystery, Tech Thriller
intro: Jo Alvarez flies the night no one sees. At 02:40 over the Everglades she is the captain of a HALO Air cargo run, the woman holding the yoke while the world sleeps, and the only person who knows the airline's eco-saint founder is a fraud. When her copilot Eli vanishes with a ghost-flight ledger in hand, Jo makes the mistake of telling the truth. Within 48 hours she is grounded, doxxed, and canceled by the very crowds who once called the Saint their savior. Now Jo has eleven days, a stolen USB, a radio operator who believes her, and a once-in-a-lifetime stage: the Saint's livestreamed Miracle Flight. The saint is a lie. The sky keeps receipts.

title: Mean Reds
author: Apex Shaw
category: Romance, Thriller, New Adult, BookTok, Revenge, Fake Virtue, Social Media, Slow Burn, Underdog, Prediction
intro: June Hollis can read a room like a spreadsheet. A social-math prodigy on the run from the Ohio scandal she exposed, she lands in New York with fourteen dollars and a notebook full of contingencies — a plan for every disaster except the one she can't predict: the writer next door, and the town secret coming to bury her. She can predict everyone except herself.

title: Blood Blossom
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Romance, New Adult, BookTok, Streaming, Social Media, Tech Thriller, Underdog, Fake Virtue
intro: Canceled performance artist Lena Chen has three weeks to prove her father didn't kill himself, and that the tech titan who married her mother murdered him. Her weapon is the one thing Damon Cross never learned to fake: live performance. Night by night she stages the truth. When his people cut her, her blood on white silk becomes the peach blossom that unmakes an empire.

title: The Miser's Wife
author: Apex Shaw
category: Dark Romance, Billionaire Revenge, Suspense, Heist, BookTok, Slow Burn, Revenge, Underdog, Fake Virtue, Social Media
intro: Cleo Hale is a billionaire's trophy wife on a four-thousand-dollar monthly allowance, tracked by an app her husband built. What August Hale doesn't know: the fortune he hoards in his private vault was stolen from her mother's company — and she just found the key to take it all back. He keeps people the way he keeps money. She's about to empty both.

title: The Dollhouse Confession
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Romance, New Adult, BookTok, Social Media, Tech Thriller, Underdog, Confession
intro: Lena Voss is the internet's perfect wife: 3.4M followers, a curated dollhouse marriage to tech golden boy Mason Voss, and a life that is one long performance. When a viral confession podcast drops seven anonymous versions of who she really is, her world detonates. The truth is worse: her husband built the dollhouse to own her, and she signed everything at nineteen. So Lena does the one thing he never expected. She confesses. Every episode, every lie, every receipt, until the dollhouse door slams shut on the man who built it.

title: Siren Zero
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Canceled singer Sable Vale returns as Zero, the anonymous producer who owns the charts, to reclaim the voice her label stole. They bought her voice. They never owned it.

title: Slow Slow Song
author: Apex Shaw
category: True Crime Thriller, Contemporary Fiction, Women's Fiction
intro: Viral poet Li An died in a fire the night her comeback collection was due. Everyone called it suicide. Her estranged sister, a canceled true-crime podcaster, digs into her last thirty days and finds the poems everyone loved were never hers, the platform that owned her voice is burning its own receipts, and the cipher hidden in her verse was evidence all along. A dead poet's words are believed. A live woman's are interrogated.

title: ZERO QUALITIES
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Contemporary Women's Fiction, Tech Satire, BookTok
intro: June Voss built a 2.4M-follower empire on a secret: she designed the algorithm that made video platform MIRROR a monster. When the platform's faceless founder zeroes her in one night, she falls in with seven other erased women — a forensic accountant, a hacker, a talent manager, a makeup artist, a lawyer, a boxer, and the founder's ex-COO — who form a secret crew called the Margin inside a crumbling East LA loft. Their enemy is the Man Without Qualities: a CEO who legally owns nothing, has no face, no name, and no self to sue. To survive, the eight must force the algorithm that erased them to make their enemy exist. They erased us. We erased him back.

title: Loop Ballads
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Okafor ghostwrites every viral song on earth under a contract she can never leave. Clause 22: you may quit only with the agency's approval, and the agency approves only when it serves them. Valuable girls get denied. Expendable girls get erased. So Wren collects the agency's ballads - the soldier, the peacock wife, the white-haired lament - and plans to sing them all at once. The only way out of a Catch-22 is everyone at once.

title: The Cancel List
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A small streamer gets flagged by her platform's hidden court and discovers a family secret: her grandmother was the last keeper of the Cancel List, the secret erasure ledger that decides who gets deleted. Now the List has chosen her.

title: The Beast Is Watching
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Twelve influencers. One deserted island. No signal. One 10 million dollar contract. Every week the contestants vote someone off, and the audience's vote counts double - because the real beast was never on the island. It is the forty-one million people watching. De-influencer Wren Cho was blackmailed onto the show by the production company that destroyed her best friend. She came to break the game from the inside. The producers picked the wrong girl to break.

title: Never Coming Down
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Cancelled streamer Maya Iversen refuses to come down. After Pulse shadow-bans her and hands her brand to her ex-best friend, she climbs into an arborist's ancient oak and broadcasts from the canopy - off-grid, un-cancellable, seeing everything the algorithm hides. From up there, she dismantles the people who erased her.

title: So It Crashes
author: Apex Shaw
category: Time Loop Finance Thriller, Revenge, Romance
intro: Every Friday at midnight, the crypto market dies in a crash engineered a century ago. Maya Zhao is the only person who remembers Monday. Barista by day, loop-trapped trader by night, she has one week on infinite repeat to take down the family that sold her family the same fire twice. A time-loop revenge thriller for everyone who ever wanted to short the people who wrecked them.

title: The Wrong Branch
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Sound designer Ava Hart wakes up erased: no records, no phone, no past — and a woman with her face has taken her inheritance, her little sister, and her name. On the run with nothing but her dead father's analog tapes and an oracle app that keeps telling the truth, Ava discovers the erased aren't dead — they're filed. To get her mother back, she'll have to bring the whole building down. The Man in the High Castle meets The Woman in White.

title: Die. Repeat. Collect.
author: Apex Shaw
category: Reincarnation Revenge, Heist Mystery, Women's Fiction
intro: Noor Rao keeps dying. Seven times across 128 years she has been born into the orbit of the Selene Diamond — the stolen moon-gem that built the Westcott dynasty — and seven times the Westcotts have killed her before she could take it back. In 2026, true-crime podcaster Noor Rao wakes from her seventh death with every past life sharp in her memory: the Bombay heiress who watched the theft, the Shanghai chorus girl who almost stole it back, the London thief who mapped the vault, the accountant who found the money trail. This life she has a microphone, a best friend who believes her, and seven lifetimes of skills. The Westcotts are unveiling the diamond at a London auction in seven days. The moon goddess has given her eight lives to close the debt. She intends to collect.

title: Feed Me
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A washed 'clean girl' influencer drinks a mysterious neurotech serum and wakes up to discover her secret finsta persona has come alive.
