Every night at 3AM, Vex posts, climbs, blackmails, and wins — while Billie sleeps. To save her sister, her best friend, and her own soul, Billie Vance must outpost, out-expose, and finally out-real the monster her ambition built. The feed is hungry. She's the one feeding it.

title: Rule Zero
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Mina Reyes ghost-wrote the prophecy that made Gideon Kane a tech messiah. When he erases her from the story and rewrites the rules one by one to keep himself on top, she comes back with the only weapon he never learned to forge: the truth. She wrote his prophecy. Now she's going to rewrite it.

title: Seed Money
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Juno Li streams a DNA kit at 3AM and discovers she is one of 214 children secretly fathered by America's beloved fertility guru. Raised on her grandmother's Three Kingdoms stories, she wages a modern war of strategy - borrowed arrows, divided courts, and one perfect empty-city bluff - to burn his empire down. The only army she needs is the family he tried to hide.

title: The Floating Wife
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Revenge Romance, Influencer Thriller, Women's Fiction
intro: Everyone believes her marriage is a fairytale. Her husband wrote the memoir that made them famous. Now he is divorcing her for a younger influencer and writing her out of the sequel. What he forgot: the perfect wife kept receipts. When Yuna Zhao stops performing the soft-girl dream, six years of records become the takedown of the century and a brand empire of her own.

title: The Beast's Confession
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Social Satire, Women's Fiction
intro: Canceled in nine seconds by a clipped video, cozy-creator Runa Hale goes feral. She builds an anonymous beast persona that outgrows her old fame, voids every contract that buried her, and hijacks the biggest live show on earth the night her gag order expires — to make the general will remember who wrote the fine print.

title: The Deep Sea Ball
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ghostwriter Mina Seo signs a devil's bargain to host the Deep Sea Ball and save her blind brother. The sea makes her a queen. The dark makes her a collector. And the city's elite find out exactly what they owe.

title: Branch Theory
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Junie Park, the disgraced black-sheep coder of the Park dynasty, inherits her grandmother's secret archive on the night of the funeral: a 30-year plan written in branches. At every fork in reality, only she can see the other timelines. Her golden cousin wants the empire. Her ex-boyfriend's hedge fund wants the collapse. And in ninety days, the entire market is scheduled to die.

title: CONFESSION HOUSE
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Drama, Social Thriller, Reality TV, Female Lead, Revenge
intro: Mara Vale, ranked dead last in the live-streamed creator mansion The Hearth, owns one weapon nobody else in the house has: the truth. In a world of curated feeds and borrowed stories, her daily confessions are surgical strikes, each one exposing a lie or burying a fake. When the aging patron Theo Harte collapses and his adopted daughters circle his will like vultures, Mara weaponizes radical honesty against the whole machine: the shadow accounts, the laundered trust money, and the manager who owns the mansion's mortgage. Rousseau's total confession meets Balzac's boarding-house ladder.

title: THE VOICE TRADE
author: Apex Shaw
category: Fantasy, Romance, Satire, Female Lead, Revenge, Web Serial
intro: Maren Adler signed away her voice at twenty for love. Now her AI clone sings for her ex's nine-billion-dollar empire while she cannot perform a note. To void the contract she must speak in her own voice, inside his castle, live.

title: The Red Camellia
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A broke barista from Brooklyn fakes her way into New York's gilded elite as the mysterious heiress Camille Voss. When the matriarch who destroyed her mother destroys her too, she stages her own drowning and comes back for everything.

title: MEDEA'S LABYRINTH
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Tech Thriller, Female Lead, Social Media Satire, Contemporary Fiction
intro: When her fiance and her best friend steal the AI narrative engine she built and cancel her for a crime she did not commit, founder Meda Reyes dies on the internet in four hours. Then she starts telling stories again - and in her hands, every story is a door.

title: Fool's Mate
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Viral relationship fixer Emma Vale arranges other people's love lives for a living. When an anonymous champion of an underground game dismantles her empire move by move, she loses everything, retreats to isolation, and learns the one truth she never verified: her biggest win destroyed her best friend.

title: Saltwater Sonata
author: Apex Shaw
category: Music, Romance, Revenge, Small Town, Social Media
intro: Ryn Sorensen ghostwrites hits for a label that stole her name, while the fishing town she fled drowns under a developer's buyout and the boy she loved stays lost at sea. When her anonymous account becomes the most viral act on the internet, she becomes the one the industry cannot buy

title: SAINTFALL
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A prodigy raised in secret as a guru's weapon discovers her training simulations were real psychological attacks, then plays the long con back on the false saint who made her.

title: Matchmade
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A viral love coach who built her brand on fixing others' love lives introduces her shy client to a handsome guru, and discovers too late that he is a serial manipulator who mined her own app for targets.

title: The Counterfeit Name
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In a near-future city where one corporation owns the Official Record of the past, erased genius Lena Reyes discovers her childhood best friend Maya has been rebuilt as the platform's biggest star, running on Lena's stolen memory engine. To get her name back, Lena must prove the world's memories are counterfeit.

title: Rewrite Me
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A cancelled influencer who ghostwrites her rival's empire discovers she can relive her own past and speak a truer version of every humiliation, rewriting what the world remembers one viral night at a time.

title: Delete Him
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A memory-compliance auditor keeps dreaming of a man the system says never existed. Her dreams are the one channel the memory-wipe can't reach — and he is using them to call her back.

title: The Blind Verdict
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A cancelled true-crime podcaster returns to Alabama to free a death row inmate and finds the star witness was a four-year-old girl — herself. The truth she digs up will bury her own family.

title: Terminal Upload
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Diagnosed with six months to live, ghost-creator Maya Chen turns her deathbed into a weapon: an anonymous confession series that peels apart everyone who built an empire on her father's murder and her stolen work. Each episode is one liar's version of the night the Comet Stone vanished. The last confession is her own.

title: The New Name
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary, Drama, Revenge, Romance, Social Media
intro: Diner waitress Sadie Marlowe goes viral and is secretly funded to rebrand as influencer Vera Sterling. One rule, never ask who her patron is. The old money that burned her hometown is watching. Every debt gets paid. Every name gets reclaimed.

title: The Name Test
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A disgraced philosophy dropout watches a wellness guru charm her grieving grandfather out of the family empire. Armed with her grandmother's annotated Analects and a legal clause called the Name Test, June Calloway plans to call every lie by its true name at the winter gala.

title: The Hundred-Year Mermaid
author: Apex Shaw
category: Magical Realism, Family Saga, Revenge, Female Lead, Voice
intro: When voice influencer Siren Solheim is canceled by a doctored recording leaked by her ex, she loses her voice and her career in the same week. Retreating to her family's compound on the Maine coast, she finds the Ledger of Voices: a century of Solheim daughters who went viral, fell in love, and were silenced by the men who collected them.

title: Dead Girl Streaming
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Ashby was the internet's favorite clean girl. Then she drowned on camera on purpose. Faking her death to escape her manager boyfriend's grip, she hits the road with a runaway kid and a feral ex-best-friend who is slowly turning into a beast, unmasking every fake guru between the river and her own live resurrection.

title: Nine Floors Down
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Canceled influencer Sable Lin gets one last message from her dead mentor: walk down nine floors into the Deep Feed, the ghost network beneath the internet, where stolen art is warehoused and lies combust. Every floor demands a confession. The last floor belongs to the man who erased her.

title: Burn His Gold
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Three years ago fintech heiress Ivy Lin lost her father, her company, and her name to miser billionaire Silas Voss's frame. Now she's back as a useless basement temp, ready to weaponize his greed and burn his empire down.

title: No Win Condition
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Every rule at Flowline is a trap with no exit. Promoted only by the manager who refuses. Cleared only by the accuser who holds the files. Buried in a Catch-22 layoff, analyst Juno Park opens the Art of War her mother forced on her and turns the company's rules into a battlefield.

title: The Midnight Upload
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Every night at midnight, captive storyteller June Kwan must hold a million live viewers or lose a day of her life. Armed with hidden tells, she weaponizes the cliffhanger against the Attention Singularity and the Midnight King who owns it.

title: The Rose Garden Letters
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Silenced ghostwriter Zora James finds her stolen manuscript on her boss's book cover. Fired and buried by an NDA, she fights back with viral letters and reclaims the garden built on her words.

title: Ice-Out
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Romance, Small Town, Nature, BookTok
intro: Burned-out growth strategist Nora Finch quits her wellness-tech unicorn at her own goodbye party and inherits her great-aunt's cabin on a Maine lake. She came to live deliberately - to repair a roof, row a boat, and tame one wild fox. Then the CEO who owns the future tries to buy the lake, and the girl who wanted nothing finds she has everything to protect.

title: Motherboard
author: Apex Shaw
category: Gen-Z Influencer Thriller, Women's Fiction, Revenge, Found Family, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Romy Vale built The Nest from a rented garage into a two-million-follower content house and raised five girls like daughters. On the morning of her gala, one of those girls leaks her the group chat: all five are leaving tonight with VULTURE Media, and a deepfake of her voice is set to drop mid-speech. Tonight Mom gives them the mic. Then she takes it back.

title: The Knife Is Sharp
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A gifted chef is publicly dumped on the eve of her wedding when her fiance proposes to a food-empire heiress on livestream. Locked out of the restaurant she built, she gives away every recipe he built his empire on - and watches him drown. A story of sharp knives and a grandmother's wok.

title: EGG TIMER
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When fertility-data scientist June Lin is fired for flagging embryo anomalies, she comes home for her sister's wedding and finds the family clinic Vera Fertility selling eggs that were never meant to leave the tank — including her own.

title: Hopscotch Protocol
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Two ex-lovers built their careers as the internet's most feared fixers. Rule twelve of their manifesto: the game ends when one player burns the other. Now one of them has. At the Aurelius gala, Mara Whitfield's wire plays the wrong tape — and she must replay the game in reverse to survive.

title: Poison Springs
author: Apex Shaw
category: Wellness Crime Thriller, Women's Fiction, Revenge, Found Family, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Rhea Solis built an empire selling clean living. Then her blood test came back poisoned, her hometown's miracle springs were a lie, and the world called her a fraud. All for one, she fights back.

title: The Ghost Who Saw Everything
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When viral philosopher Sora Lee vanishes mid-livestream, her invisible ghostwriter June Park breaks her silence to tell the true story, and discovers the brilliant friend she built was hiding a person, a crime, and a message meant only for her.

title: The Love Test
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Banished for refusing to perform her love on a livestreamed inheritance test, Cora Astra discovers she may be the synthetic daughter her mother secretly commissioned. Only the machine passes the human test.

title: Screaming on Main
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A cancelled grief influencer weaponizes radical confession. Every sin she admits on stream becomes a call to arms, and her audience answers - dragging the predator network that built her into the light.

title: Proof of Purity
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Calloway built a nine-million-follower empire on one promise: zero filter. Then the receipts drop — her awakening was manufactured by her father's astroturfing dynasty. Canceled by her own mob, she burns the machine down.

title: The Innocence Machine
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A Queens data-forensics prodigy inherits her estranged billionaire father's empire and steps into Manhattan's gilded society, where innocence is a weapon and reputation is currency. She has receipts.

title: The River Remembers
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Maya returns to her grandmother's reindeer camp to record the last shaman's songs for a tech startup. But the startup is mining her people's songs to train an AI and clear the valley for a rare-earth mine. When the machine starts dreaming of the shaman's dead reindeer, Maya must decide what deserves a soul.

title: Neither Light Nor Shadow
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Thriller, New Adult Romance, Revenge
intro: Nella Okafor is a nobody: night-shift barista, anonymous poet, invisible. When the Hudson Lights party boat sinks at 2 AM, the internet decides she was the secret girlfriend of Kai Mercer, the drowned golden boy. The Mercer family scripts her grief for a memorial broadcast. Sable Quinn, the ex who was actually on that boat, scripts her as a fraud. Nella refuses both scripts with the only weapon she owns: the truth, written as poetry.

title: Dead on the Crescent
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Cancelled tech prodigy Mara Voss boards luxury sleeper The Crescent under a fake name to get close to the guru who ruined her. When Julian Vane is found dead in his locked car, all twelve guests are lying.

title: The Shining Prince
author: Apex Shaw
intro: One year after rising singer Asa fell from the west balcony of The Court, six women the Shining Prince loved and discarded find her hidden chronicle and learn her death was not suicide. They unite to publish the true history of the prince and burn down the machine that eats the women who love it.

title: Swan Song
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When a dying media tycoon asks his estranged granddaughter to narrate the memoir that would bury his family's secrets, voice artist Lark Sterling agrees. Then she plans to tell the true fairy tale live to the world.

title: The Country of Women
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When Lin Yue, a laid-off game writer, falls into her dead grandmother's annotated copy of Flowers in the Mirror, she lands in the Country of Women, a gilded empire where the ruling AI has deleted every woman's story from literature.

title: Muse No More
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A 22-year-old ghostwriter steals the lost master tapes of a dead indie icon from the legendary producer who groomed and erased her, then out-maneuvers every hunter circling the Falcon Sessions while t

title: Riverborn
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Fired from the AI content farm where she scrubbed machine souls for a living, a Gen-Z safety moderator discovers the river-folk secretly running her company from a hidden mirror city under the river,

title: The Tell-Tale Feed
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Seven years after her sister vanished from a locked apartment, true-crime podcaster Juno Vale reopens the case and finds the clue everyone missed, hidden in plain sight inside her sister's old livestreams. The stalker who destroyed her sister has been watching Juno's channel the whole time.

title: The Goddaughter's Gambit
author: Apex Shaw
category: Mafia Revenge Thriller, New Adult Romance
intro: When her father, the Don, is murdered, exiled influencer Sloane Falcone returns to bury him — and to dismantle the Five Families one by one, using a 2,500-year-old playbook of Chinese stratagem he made her memorize.

title: The Girl in White
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Canceled ghostwriter Rae Bell must clear her name after her best friend, a mega influencer who stole her novel, dies mid-livestream and Rae is framed for the murder by a twelve-year-old identity trade.

title: The Ash Run
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When viral-honesty grandma Gus Calloway dies, her will forces her fractured family to drive her ashes across three states in a rented RV, unlocking one voice recording per day that dismantles every family myth one lie at a time. Only overlooked granddaughter Indie knows the run was never about the money.

title: The Ghostwriter
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Maya Reyes has ghostwritten every word of Sasha Vale's internet empire for five years. Nobody knows. When Sasha's scandal cracks the brand, the invisible friend steps into the light.

title: Then There Were Four
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Four Maki sisters reunite on their private island for a confession game. Guests die one by one to a childhood snow rhyme, and only Yuki, the exiled sister, sees the pattern.

title: The Poison Ledger
author: Apex Shaw
intro: After twenty years of quietly documenting every crime of the Hale media dynasty, archivist Wren Ashby is framed, poisoned, and canceled. Now she is publishing the ledger chapter by chapter, and no one is safe.

title: The Countess Gambit
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A fintech prodigy framed for a 7M fraud meets a dying strategy master in prison, inherits a 0M crypto war chest and the ancient playbooks of Chinese statecraft, and returns as The Countess, an anonymous strategist dismantling the hedge-fund empire that destroyed her, one stratagem at a time.

title: Who Keeps the Lights On
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Vee Malone is the invisible ghostwriter behind the most relatable girl on the internet. When the creators walk out and the lights keep dying, she meets a stranger who asks the one question nobody asks. Four nights. One strike. Her name.

title: The 37th Stratagem
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Drama, Political Thriller, Strategy, Romance
intro: Fired for her boss's crime, crisis strategist Juno Park inherits her grandfather's Warring States stratagems. She takes the impossible: a cancelled influencer, a doomed mayoral run. Thirty-six stratagems. One kept hour.

title: Not Born a Killer
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When her best friend Maya dies after a secret tape goes viral, audio editor Wren Calloway kills Crestwood's beloved true-crime podcaster Lucas Vane, the man no one believes could be a predator.

title: The Cygnet Protocol
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Banished to a dying desert city by the family that calls her the Duck, Sable Veyra inherits her murdered father's access key to the Loom, the dynasty's all-seeing network, and discovers she was always the swan the throne was built for.

title: The Invisible Wife
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nora Vale is invisible. Not metaphorically — the smart-home system her husband built cannot see her. When she finds divorce papers in his safe, she becomes the ghost in his perfect house, and ghosts don't need permission.

title: The Forking Wife
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Mira Yan is the perfect wife of a gilded dynasty — until New Year's Eve, when her viral trad-wife mother-in-law humiliates her on a live stream and the tea she drinks kills her. She wakes up the morning of her wedding, one year earlier, with every memory intact — and twenty-four loops to author the ending.

title: Five Books of Revenge
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Sana Kapoor tells bedtime fables for a living. When a wellness guru with a saint's smile and a grifter's ledger worms into her best friend's family, she reaches for the oldest weapons she knows. Five books of animal fables. Every story becomes a trap. The crab always wins.

title: MONKEY MODE
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Broke, furious, and allergic to pretending, Bex Tanaka takes a job at the influencer agency strangling her best friend's block — and survives eighty-one corporate tribulations to burn it down.

title: ZERO AFFINITY
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Broke chemist Alice Wu infiltrates Wonderland, a matchmaking compound where an algorithm pairs people like molecules, to find her vanished sister and expose the rigged auction.

title: THE NOTHING DAUGHTER
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Family Saga, Succession Drama, Revenge, Female Lead
intro: When media patriarch Arthur Hale divides his empire by a televised love test, his youngest daughter Cora answers 'nothing' and is disowned. As her sisters carve up the kingdom and stage his ruin, the ER nurse who inherited nothing quietly inherits everything.

title: Nine Circles of Clout
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Dead ghostwriter Maya Reyes has nine days to descend through a hell that runs on stolen clout, reclaim the essay that made her famous, and survive the Review - or be archived forever. Hell runs on engagement. She wrote the receipts.

title: SEVEN VERSIONS OF THE DON
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Canceled debunker Mara Volkov returns home when her best friend dies in a riverside fire. Seven witnesses post seven viral versions, each a lie protecting someone powerful. She live-streams the contradictions.

title: THE TRUTH SCORE
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Gen-Z Nigerian-American creator Zara Onyeka built her brand on raw honesty, until TrueNorth, the national scoring platform, audits her soul. Her viral voice trained the machine that decides who counts as a person.

title: BETTER TO REIGN
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Female Lead, Family Drama, BookTok
intro: Three years ago the Vale media dynasty sacrificed its first daughter to save itself. Sera Vale built the family's crown jewel, the short-video app Pulse, and was buried for a scandal her brother actually committed, signed away by her own father. Now the banished founder is coming back for the house that sold her.

title: I AM NO BIRD
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Jane Marlow is the 3.2, the most mocked leaked face-score in America, working as an invisible data-labeler inside the beauty-tech empire that ranked her ugly. What nobody knows: she runs the viral

title: SUGAR AND STEEL
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Five years ago, raw prodigy Wren Calloway was publicly disqualified on live television when her championship sugar tower collapsed, broken by the golden boy she was beating. The world laughed, the girl she loved left with a note, and Wren buried the name. Now she is Cam Aster, founder of a 40-million-follower dessert empire, back in Milan to duel the man who broke her.

title: WHAT THE WATER KEPT
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Water sommelier Maya Rivera comes home to a dying town and a poisoned spring. The town that pays its bills with the lie turns on her; the fixer they send flips coins over graves. She outruns him and burns the lie down on live TV.

title: The Last Storyteller
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When her grandmother, the last keeper of the seven old stories, collapses, 22-year-old Elina Niska inherits the tales and a dying village's fight for its land. Retelling forbidden myths online to save her home, she takes on a viral fake shaman and a developer's sixty-year-old forged deed.

title: Spiritual Victories
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Drama, Revenge Thriller, Influencer, Female Lead, Gen-Z
intro: When the clip of her bridal-suite breakdown goes viral, broke barista Q Mercer discovers her humiliation was engineered by the three people closest to her. Armed with a notebook of spiritual victories and a lifetime of decoding self-serving stories, she ghosts her way into the PR machine that ruined her and turns every version of the truth against its author.

title: The Truth Sickness
author: Apex Shaw
category: Sci-Fi Thriller, Family Drama, Influencer, Female Lead, Gen-Z
intro: At the Orchard, the famous twenty-year perfect-parenting experiment, star graduate Mila Chen starts bleeding every time someone lies near her. Disowned by the empire that raised her, she must save her sister before the IPO.

title: Pilgrim's Endgame
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When her plagiarism scandal nukes her 1.2M-follower career, cancelled BookTok star Vera Holloway accepts a mysterious 30-day challenge called the Digital Pilgrimage, a gamified viral quest where influencers climb ten Stations live for a million dollars.

title: The No-Bad-Days Girl
author: Apex Shaw
category: Sci-Fi Survival, Romance, Influencer, Female Lead, Gen-Z
intro: Kaira Mercer built a 41-million-follower empire on a lie: NoBadDaysKai, the internet's least authentic girl, who never has a bad day. Then the Harvesters come — Wellsian machines that don't burn cities but broadcast them

title: Blind Take
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Thriller, Influencer, Disability Drama, Female Lead, Gen-Z
intro: Iris Vale has 4.2 million followers who believe she is blind. She is not. When a rival leaks the truth, she has three days to decide: keep the mask, or take it off and burn the industry that built it.

title: Bright Burn
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A burned-out LA content creator joins a secret neuro-enhancement trial, rockets to genius, outgrows the guru boyfriend who kept her small, then races to expose the lab before her mind burns out.

title: Kiss Up, Kick Down
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When the queen of a beauty-and-influencer empire livestreams a loyalty audit to choose her successor, her three daughters perform devotion for the cameras. Only the youngest, Cleo, refuses to fake it. Exiled and canceled, she rebuilds from a storage unit while her flattering sisters tear the empire down, and a cascade of receipts brings the whole kiss-up kick-down ladder crashing to the ground.

title: SOFT THINGS
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Drama, Female Lead, Found Family, Revenge, Small Town
intro: Sable Reyes was erased from the Vasquez dynasty as a baby under a manufactured eclipse prophecy. Twenty-four years later she runs Twin Pines farm with June Hollis, her gentle giant best friend who only wants a hutch full of rabbits. When the family that cast her out tries to take the farm, frame June, and bury the truth, Sable decides the prophecy was never a curse. It was a to-do list.

title: Twelve Alibis
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A true-crime podcaster returns to her Oregon hometown to reopen the five-year-old death of her childhood best friend and discovers that twelve people had an alibi for the night she died — and all twelve lied.

title: The Frog Ledger
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When idealistic Daphne Bell returns to Millbrook for her grandmother Vera 'the Frog' Frogley's funeral, she inherits a maternity home, a vault of confession tapes, and a ledger naming every woman the midwife ever 'placed' or 'fixed'. Now the fertility empire that recruited her sister wants the tapes buried.

title: American Wonderland
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Night-shift moderator Mae Corso discovers LUMEN harvests ordinary users' lives to synthesize viral stars, and its top artist VIVI is built from her missing sister Rosa. Mae climbs the ladder to burn the machine down live.

title: Violet Lifts the Algorithm
author: Apex Shaw
category: Feel-Good Urban Fantasy, Gen-Z Women's Empowerment, Found Family, Comedy
intro: Violet lifts cars, bends steel, refuses to be owned. When her missing sister's dormant account wakes with one comment, she road-trips into a desert wellness cult with 260 unsent video letters in her bag.

title: Thirteen Confessions
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A canceled true-crime podcaster boards a luxury train where the man acquitted of killing her best friend dies before his livestreamed confession. Trapped by an avalanche with twelve guests who all lied, she turns the train's cameras on the truth.

title: The Mirror Orchard
author: Apex Shaw
category: Gen-Z Women's Empowerment, Comedy, Found Family, Satire
intro: Canceled at twenty-four, Marigold Vane has thirty days to save her grandmother's talent agency from auction. Five satirical kingdoms to cross. A hundred forgotten stars to gather. A mirror pond that never lies.

title: Ring the Bell
author: Apex Shaw
category: Dystopian Romance, Sci-Fi, Gen-Z Women's Empowerment, Revenge
intro: In a city where emotions are illegal and your worth tolls aloud hourly, optometrist Juno Vale's sister is erased for falling in love. Juno joins the saboteurs: seventy-two hours, one bridge, and a

title: Molting Season
author: Apex Shaw
category: Mystery Thriller, Gen-Z Women's Empowerment, Found Family, Revenge
intro: A laid-off bug researcher whose cousin is swarm-harassed off a creator platform hunts the attack's masterminds using entomology as a forensic lens, building a found family she calls the Colony.

title: Green Gables Is Trending
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Small-town writer Annie Vale wins a New York fellowship, and her dream dies in six weeks: influencer queen Gwen Stitch steals her essay, her name becomes nobody's. Penniless, Annie starts a wholesome account called Green Gables - and it goes viral.

title: The White Echo
author: Apex Shaw
category: Mystery Thriller, Identity Heist, Cancel Culture
intro: A forensic archivist films a woman in white at a desert festival, hours before the heiress is announced dead. Her clip is called a deepfake, she is canceled, and the heiress is buried under a dead lookalike's name.

title: Farm Team
author: Apex Shaw
category: Techno Thriller, Social Media, Community Uprising
intro: A wholesome streamer with a million-member community is recruited into a secret platform program, then learns her feel-good Nest is a weaponized engagement farm in a manufactured war between tech giants — and her people are next on the purge list.

title: The Unweaving
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Framed for embezzling eighteen million dollars she never touched, founder Yuna Choi watches her creator-payment startup Loom fall to the financiers who buried her, her fiance and best friend on their

title: Stain the Fan
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Julie Vale is the invisible voice behind her family's publishing dynasty, her father's name on every book she wrote. When her father sells her in a merger-marriage to tech heir Wolmar Kane and orders

title: Tell Me True
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A young woman hiding from the talent-industry predator she exposed anonymously joins a remote digital-detox retreat where every guest must tell one true story, and the man who ruined her arrives as the retreat's honored guest.

title: THE RABBIT FARM
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Romance, Family Drama, Small Town, Sisterhood, Revenge
intro: Two sisters. One farm. One year to keep it together, or the developer who took the farm next door takes theirs too. Of Mice and Men meets Sense and Sensibility: the rabbits were never rabbits.

title: The Revenge Doctrine
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Framed for a 40M fraud she never committed, creator-payment founder Juno Vane loses her company, her name, and her freedom. In federal prison a legendary disgraced short-seller teaches her Sun Tzu. Released, Juno returns as Kestrel, an anonymous market ghost, and dismantles the people who buried her, one strategy at a time.

title: She Plays the Fair
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Cancelled by the golden family who forged her ruin, broke assistant Lulu Sharpe ghosts her way back into their empire and plays their own intrigue game back at them with receipts.

title: The Good Man
author: Apex Shaw
intro: True-crime creator Cat Morland sees a killer in every mailman. When a self-help guru charms his way into her sister's wedding and a general's mansion, her paranoid case file turns out to be the only honest thing in the house.

title: SCENT WORK
author: Apex Shaw
category: Suspense Thriller, Revenge, Underdog, Cult Thriller, Women's Fiction
intro: Hyperosmic candle girl Piper Voss boards an influencer retreat and lands in a desert cult that harvests secrets. The guests she saved sell her to the guru. Her nose becomes the most dangerous weapon online.

title: Touch the Veil
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Elia Bianchi is the face of the Veil, her family's beauty-tech algorithm that scores faces and crowns the industry's saints. She is the vault, the treasure, the consecrated girl who must never be touched. When her cousin Dante leaves with the master key she gave him, he returns rich, engaged to the industry's perfect girl, and sends her a settlement check. The curse is a lie. She touches it anyway.

title: Unpublishable
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A small-town poet's debut is hyped, stolen, and buried by the New York publishing machine. She fights back one viral chapter at a time, and the critic who called her unpublishable learns what she is made of.

title: Notes Under Doors
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Anonymous lampoon notes slipped under doors expose a town's buried secrets, dragging archivist Vera Hale into the 25-year-old mystery of the erased first Mrs. Vane and the dynastic lie at the heart of Vane House.

title: The Mill Audit
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Cancelled at 23, Maeve Vale returns to her father's dying mill, a brother who won't forgive her, and a fund that wants the land. Three spirits audit her past. Then the frozen river starts to move.

title: Dead Girl's New Name
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When Roxy Mercer watches the town golden boy drown her best friend at the quarry, the town buries the truth. So Roxy buries herself. She fakes her own death, takes the dead girl's dream name, and comes back as someone new to burn the cover-up to the ground.

title: Saint Crispin's Heir
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Broke community-college dropout Jules Moreno forges a Stanford resume and talks her way into elite VC Halden Ventures. Unmasked the night before Demo Day, she leads her band of misfits into the fight of their lives.

title: The Monster She Chose
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When a leaked doctored audio clip makes artist Iris Vale the internet's monster of the week, her ex-boyfriend's wellness empire offers her a mercy deal: sign the NDA, grovel, disappear. She refuses. Stripped of her job, her family, and her name, she builds the monster brand they made and drags the whole machine into the light, one receipt at a time.

title: Enemy of the Feed
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A safety-tech giant manufactures a terrorist network to win a surveillance contract, and a night-shift auditor finds her own name on the enemy list. The barbarians were never at the gate.

title: The Dragon-Carved Heart
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ghostwriter Mia Chen wrote the novel that made her ex-best friend Sable Quinn a BookTok deity. Branded a plagiarist and legally erased from her own work, Mia must out-carve the algorithm that stole her voice.

title: Counterfeit Hearts
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nia Reyes built her career writing counterfeit love: fake profiles for a dating empire, then walked away blackmailed into ghosting her one real match. Now her sister Lola has vanished into the Celestina Circle, and the fake profile that ruined a victim is Nia's own.

title: Vanity Pilgrim
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Comedy, Reality Show, Women's Fiction, Tech Thriller, BookTok
intro: Juno Vale was the internet's fakest sweetheart until a leaked screenshot cancelled her in an afternoon. Now she headlines a punishment reality tour: 81 towns, 81 trials, a demon in each one. She's not here to be redeemed. She's here to take inventory.

title: Delusion Girl
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A BookTok girl everyone calls delusional discovers the murder she imagined at a wellness empire's estate is real, and the debt trap that killed Emma Bovary is eating her sister alive.

title: The Golden Boy Is Dead
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Seven strangers board a confession bus to win a million dollars telling tales about the golden boy who just died. Juno Park boarded to bury him with the truth, her brother was the founder the world erased.

title: Bury Him Twice
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When seven women gather at the memorial of Ascend founder Cole Vega, each carries a version of the man they helped build. He faked his death with their money. Now the funeral becomes a tribunal - and the only thing they will bury is him.

title: The Frog Years
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A content-compliance auditor at a national fertility app decodes a hidden audio file and discovers a surrogacy black market inside the state's Baby Pledge machine. When her enforcer aunt and a wombfluencer empire close in, she runs with her score-zero boyfriend and streams the truth.

title: Ninety-Three Hours
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ten Gen-Z influencers and founders are ferried to a billionaire's private island for a livestreamed survival retreat. Ninety-three hours before the storm surge hits, a judge AI begins executing them one by one, each death matching a hidden sin. Mara Voss, the underestimated ex-assistant of a dead friend, flips the game live.

title: The Hut That Wouldn't Burn
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When documentarian Hana Chun refuses to sell her voice to the media mogul who owns every screen in the city, he burns her studio live. She answers with a viral diary of every loss, written from her grandfather's fireproof hut — the one place he cannot touch, and the only copy of the evidence he buried.

title: No File Found
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Every person is a file. Mira Chen is the one file the machine skipped. When the Bureau schedules her metamorphosing best friend for the Harrow, she fights the machine with the only weapon it gave her: nothing.

title: The Moment Maker
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Mona Reyes edits reality for a living. As a moment architect at Moment House, she engineers the viral turning points that make Silicon Valley legends iconic - until her boss makes her bury the truth. Then she starts collecting receipts: one decisive moment per legend, and the final moment belongs to him.

title: Nobody, Inc.
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Two years after her private plane goes down over the Pacific, presumed-dead founder Desi Quinn slips back into her own company as a junior hire named Jules to expose the frauds who stole it, and take it back.

title: The 3:17 to Moscow
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Three sisters trapped in the dying town of Brine Hollow dream of Moscow, their dead mother's word for the city where their real lives wait. When the predatory developer who owns their debts and destroyed their father boards the night train to Denver, he never gets off alive. Twelve passengers had a reason. The sisters had the plan.

title: UNREADABLE
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In 2027 America everyone lives on VERITY, the all-in-one feed that scores your worth from 0 to 10,000. Wren Vale is the perfect girl the feed built. Then a deleted account DMs her a sigil, and her score glitches UP instead of down.

title: The Friend Who Burned It Down
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Two best friends from dying Bracken, Ohio. One escapes to an influencer's golden cage in New York. One stays and quietly builds a worker uprising at the town's megawarehouse. When the list of names leaks, the quiet one vanishes - and the escaped one has to burn her brand to finish the fire.

title: Kiss the Ring
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A 25-year-old nobody who married into the city's most powerful family is publicly accused of an affair, stripped of everything, and left on a subway platform. Instead of dying like the Marino brides before her, she weaponizes the family's own code against the men who broke it.

title: STOLEN FIRE
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ember Reyes built the algorithm that runs the creator economy. Then she stole the file proving it silences women. Fired, cancelled, gagged. But stolen fire cannot be un-stolen, and on their greatest night, it burns.

title: Drowned in Their DMs
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Maggie Vale writes the soul of the internet's most beloved influencer empire. When her bosses frame her for a leak and cancel her on live TV, she becomes the ghost they made her. One weapon: every screenshot she ever kept. When the archive floods, the saints drown.

title: Karma on Main
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A sincerity curator climbs the influencer machine and loses herself in it, guided by a bike-shop philosopher whose counsel reads like the Bhagavad Gita for the attention economy. When the machine turns on her, she learns the one thing it cannot farm: a woman who fights without wanting the crown.

title: The Fourth Voice
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A disowned TikTok forensic accountant inherits her dying tech-mogul father's laptop, a memoir in three voices, I, YOU and HE. To save her mother's legacy and expose a nine-billion-dollar fraud, she must become the fourth voice.

title: The Clown Inspector
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A washed-up clown streamer, the internet's biggest joke, is mistaken for the anonymous Inspector who audits the corrupt creator economy. She never corrects anyone. One by one, the fakes confess to her.

title: Season of the Wardrobe
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When her town blames Wren Ashford for the golden boy's fall through the frozen lake, an old wardrobe in her dead grandmother's attic opens into a winter that never ends. There the truth is written in ice, and the thaw begins with one true word.

title: Snow in June
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A viral chef publicly destroyed by a fake murder video returns three years later as a mysterious investor to dismantle the people who framed her, while the impossible snow in June keeps falling, one flake for every lie.

title: Main Street Girl
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Orphaned daydreamer Annie Lowell inherits a wreck of a house in Holloway, the dying town a viral heritage brand bought, renamed Sweetwater, and restaged as America's sweetest Main Street. Cast as the problem child, she refuses the script and talks back until the whole set falls.

title: Hell Frame
author: Apex Shaw
intro: True-crime streamer Juno Kane's sister Dahlia is canceled, convicted and dies in custody after refusing a media mogul's advances, swearing three impossible oaths.

title: The Wandering Game
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A canceled ghostwriter receives 400,000 leaked DMs proving her best friend, the internet's favorite wellness influencer, ran a decade-long manipulation game. The paralyzed one finally moves.

title: TEA WITH THE DEVIL
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When the Whisk Guild destroys her family teahouse, matcha influencer Maeve Crane signs a contract with the Devil. To save her grandmother she must attend his Grand Ball and brew the forbidden ceremony that forces every liar in the art world to confess live.

title: Soul Audit
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ten people who betrayed wellness-tech billionaire Aurora Vale are lured to her private island for a free Soul Audit retreat. Night one, a recording reads their buried secrets. Then the guests start dying, one per day, each death preceded by a Socratic interrogation. The only innocent guest, broke philosophy PhD Noor Ahmadi, must out-dialogue the killer before the island's audit ends.

title: The Pretty Friend
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Canceled at twenty-two and buried under her mother's medical debt, Sloane Avery is the most disgraced girl in America. When media mogul August Fogg bets his empire that he can turn any nobody into a star in eighty days, he picks her.

title: What the Green Light Saw
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Eight years ago Nova left her first love to burn in a studio fire. She climbed to the top on a tycoon's leash of guilt. Now an anonymous podcast drops her buried past night by night, and a dead man's green light is blinking again.

title: The Girl He Built
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A young woman discovers the man who made her famous has been building an AI replacement from her face, her voice, her whole life. To survive, she must become her own creator and tear down the empire built on her bones.

title: Ghosts of the Clean Girl
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A viral clean-girl creator's buried past resurfaces as a leaked video, dragging her into a war with a purity-media dynasty whose hidden sins make hers look like nothing.

title: The Town Inside Me
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Mira Chen is Sonder's perfect employee until her case files start reading back. Inside her head a walled town grows where her deleted self reads stolen dreams. One night, one choice: tear the wall down.

title: Strip the Coat
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Sadie Trent writes The Overcoat, an anonymous review account 1.4 million people fear. When her best friend Amber steals it and becomes The Inspector, a bribe-taking taste tyrant, Sadie returns as a ghost.

title: Ink and Claw
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ghostwriter Mina Okafor's poems go viral under another woman's name. Then the tiger inside her, starved, furious, magnificent, starts clawing its way out. She didn't want fame. The tiger wants everything.

title: Ugly Season
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A scholarship girl running wardrobe at Manhattan's most exclusive debutante agency discovers she is the exiled founder's true heir and the season that mocked her must be presided by her blood or die.

title: The Gilded Falcon
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Canceled ex-influencer Frankie Vale now debunks viral lies for cash. When a legendary gold falcon vanishes at a Hollywood heist, seven witnesses tell seven versions, and the truth she finds will clear her name or bury it.

title: Saints Don't Burn
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A viral video exposes a predator with her impossible truth-voice, and 19-year-old Maren Vale is committed to the Cloister, a luxury exorcism content farm where influencer-priests livestream healing.

title: Tomorrow Girl
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Calloway built a two-million-follower livestream brand on waiting - for the ring, the promotion, the follow-back. When three letters arrive on the same day, she stops waiting - and the world that ignored her for twenty-five years suddenly cannot stop writing to her.

title: Unstarted
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Sloane Marchetti is the internet's most famous pending girl - 3.2 million followers watch her not start her life. When a stranger sends her Chapter One of a novel about the life she never lived, she discovers her promise was someone else's product. To find the ending, she has to start.

title: Invisible Season
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Grief made Vera Voss a ghost. After her best friend Mina dies in a fall from a yacht, Vera stops being seen - by cameras, by people, by the world. Invisible inside The Colony, the hype house she works for and that killed her friend, she collects the truth one secret at a time, until the night she steps back into the light on live television.

title: Everyone Lied About June
author: Apex Shaw
intro: June Kessler climbed out of Iowa on lies, charm, and men who wanted to own her. When her Tesla is found at the bottom of a Malibu cliff, everyone has a version of her story. Only one of them is true.

title: Mango Street Tactics
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Seventeen-year-old Paloma Reyes is losing Mango Street one war at a time. A corner-store sage hands her a two-thousand-year-old book of schemes, and she starts winning. Her landlord and her cousin are about to meet the art of war.

title: The Castaway Ledger
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Forensic audio analyst Wren Hale decodes a dead girl's corrupted voicemail and uncovers a counterfeit world: fake coins, forged diaries, swapped twins. Every clue is a lie. The SOS was planted.

title: Half of Me Is Trending
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Content creator Ada Okafor splits into two halves live on camera after a leaked video humiliates her on the night of her biggest brand deal. The perfect influencer Ade rises to A-list fame while the u

title: The Ash Sisters
author: Apex Shaw
category: Dystopian Thriller, Tech Thriller, Female Lead, Family Drama
intro: When the Feed flags her dead sister for total erasure, salvage tech Maya Hart has six days to save Anya's memory from the ash room. But the purge has already rewritten the past, and the only versions left of the truth are the four voices that remember the summer Anya died.

title: Feel It All
author: Apex Shaw
category: Sci-Fi Thriller, Romance, Female Lead, Neurotech, BookTok
intro: When mid-tier wellness influencer Wren Calloway volunteers for Veritas Neuro's Heartware trial, the chip behind her ear lets her feel everyone's real emotions — and everything around her starts lying. Her boyfriend is a plant. Her rival is a ghost from an earlier trial. The founder is selling her brainwaves as a Trust Score. Nicomachean Ethics meets Flowers for Algernon: one virtue a week, a thirty-day countdown, and a girl learning that feeling everything is the only way to feel anything.

title: The Hundred-Year Heir
author: Apex Shaw
intro: After her erased mother dies, twenty-two-year-old Fifi Price is brought to Casa Vega as the family's charity case, treated like furniture by the cousins who will inherit everything. When the matriarch dies, her will reveals the Hundred-Year Ledger.

title: Believe Me Blind
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Art restoration prodigy Liv Vale goes viral for the wrong reason when a deepfake video and forged DMs are leaked to destroy her on the eve of billionaire heir Theo Ashford's arranged engagement.

title: Silly Old Money
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Broke illustrator Junie Hart is handed a genuine million-pound banknote she is forbidden to spend. In London's influencer economy, perception is currency, so the uncashable note opens every door and paints a target on her back. When the truth detonates live on air, she discovers who loved the money and who loved her.

title: Viral Descent
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Travel influencer Sora Vale's Invisible Cities series hides a second channel. Every beautiful city she films is one circle of a modern hell, and the map leads to whoever killed her father.

title: The Honest Deep
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A canceled wellness influencer fakes her own death and builds an underwater colony whose truth-verifying AI exposes every lie on the surface, until the billionaire who sent the smear comes hunting.

title: The Red Pasture
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A wellness influencer co-founds a viral desert commune, discovers the founders sell members like livestock, and is buried alive in its secret detention wing. The pasture remembers who plowed it.

title: Cancel Eden
author: Apex Shaw
intro: The last daughter of a dying San Francisco dynasty plans a quiet engagement. Her best friend plants fake screenshots, steals her mother's lace handkerchief, and livestreams her destruction. Eden refuses to die on camera.

title: The Improbability Garden
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When the Content Guild's drones flatten her grandmother's garden, ex-barista Wren Sato refuses to engage, and the impossible starts happening around her. Quiet resistance: grow things, feed people, never panic.

title: The Ghost in the War Room
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A junior strategist at a viral influencer factory is haunted by the ghost of her dead best friend, a creator the algorithm burned and erased, and must tell the truth about the night she drowned before the machine eats the next girl.

title: The Bed Heiress
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Willa Vale has not left her bed in eleven months. When her estranged great-uncle, the infamous Miser of Meridian Street, dies and leaves her his fortune on one condition, stay in bed and do nothing fo

title: The Fallen Girl Club
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nell Wray is the girl her small town labeled fallen before she was legal. At seventeen a golden boy recorded her without consent and the tape made her the cautionary tale of Harlowe.

title: CITIZEN ZERO
author: Apex Shaw
category: Dystopian Sci-Fi Romance, Time Travel, Female Lead, Tech Thriller, Revenge
intro: In 2026, junior engineer Nia Calder is fired the same day her ex-boyfriend steals her kindness-scoring algorithm. A lab accident skips her ten years forward into Unity, a glass city where every citizen wears a Happiness Quotient bracelet and a soothing algorithm-god called the Heart decides who deserves joy. In the basement furnace, the hidden workers who keep the dream alive wear no numbers at all. Nia has no HQ either. She is the only Zero in the world, and the Heart runs on code that was hers.

title: Where the Smoke Went
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Zuri Okafor is the front-runner of Venice Island, the most-watched reality show on Earth, until a doctored video makes her the villain the mob has been waiting for. With her best friend's knife already in her back, she has seven days to find where the smoke went.

title: Chunhyang Uncut
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ghost-singer Chunhyang Lee watches the label's starlet lip-sync the song she wrote, then gets framed, canceled, and sued. Her burner has buried three agencies. Her childhood friend is the undercover investigator. Her father left the receipts.

title: Heather and Ash
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A working-class literary genius from Yorkshire wins a fellowship at London's most elite writers' house, only to discover her disgraced mother was the real author of the industry's most celebrated stolen novel. Canceled for plagiarism she did not commit, she vanishes, rebuilds as an anonymous investigative podcaster, and returns two years later to burn the empire that erased her mother, one viral episode at a time.

title: The I in We
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In a near-future world where the Harmony system scores every citizen's love value and assigns every match, Elinor Vale is its most obedient analyst — a woman rated 98.7 who has never needed anyone. When her chaotic, truth-telling sister Marianne goes viral with a forbidden post and vanishes into Harmony's 'recovery' program, Elinor is ordered to forget her.

title: The Girl Who Came Down
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Drama, Women's Fiction, Small Town, Revenge, Found Family, Healing
intro: After her best friend steals her entire online persona and the agency drops her, burned-out influencer Maya Vale deletes her life and moves into her grandmother's treehouse in the Pacific Northwest, v

title: The Impossible Minute
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A canceled forensic analyst finds the impossible minute in a murderer's perfect alibi and takes down Vane Veracity, the firm that manufactures reality for the rich, one timestamp at a time.

title: The Scent of a Lie
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Odessa Marlowe was born with no scent of her own but can smell what no one else can: lies, fear, death, and the supernatural. After her ex-boyfriend and best friend steal her fragrance brand and cance

title: The Gilded Veil
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Drama, Women's Fiction, Family Saga, Revenge, Romance, Small Town
intro: The cancelled heiress of Jade House is exiled to a dying desert resort whose poisoned spring her family buried. She saves the town, unmasks the white lotus, and rebuilds the house on her own terms.

title: Draft Saved
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Romance, Women's Fiction, Drama, Revenge
intro: Wren Castell posts daily love letters to indie singer Jules Marchetti and the internet calls her the most devoted girl alive. But her saved drafts tell the truth: the letters are an art project documenting parasocial love from the inside. When a leaked draft brands her a fraud, she publishes the private track and the world learns the tragic girl was never the one being played.

title: Pawn Zero
author: Apex Shaw
category: Sports Thriller, Women's Fiction, Revenge, Dark Academy
intro: Nineteen-year-old Mara Reyes streams anonymous chess at 4 a.m. as PawnZero, the account that just destroyed a grandmaster career. She does not know every anonymous game she played was a fixed match in a betting ring run by her own coach, and the flawless player who surfaces when pressure breaks her is someone she does not remember becoming.

title: THE HAPPINESS ACT
author: Apex Shaw
category: Psychological Thriller, Tech Satire, Women's Fiction, BookTok, Female Lead
intro: Fired from local news, Juno Reyes takes a job at KAPPALAND, a wellness empire where unhappiness is illegal, employees who opt out are 'freed,' and the founder's nonsense slogans pass for genius. To ex

title: The Vane Protocols
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Romance, Social Thriller, BookTok, Female Lead
intro: Five years ago, foster kid Heath Thorn was thrown out of Vane Hall for stealing the Moor's Eye ruby. Now she's back as reputation fixer H.T. North, hired by the consortium buying the moors, and she plans to burn the deal from the inside.

title: MY SIDE OF EVERYTHING
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Psychological Thriller, Women's Fiction, Romance, Revenge
intro: When clean-girl mogul Coco Bell launches her tell-all memoir the same morning rival creator Petra Kim drops receipts proving her famous origin story was stolen from her vanished best friend June Okada, Coco's confession machine turns on her.

title: A Thousand Verses of Bondage
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Gen-Z songwriter Mina Zhao inherits her grandmother's notebook of three hundred Song poems and the story of a stolen voice, then breaks free of the narcissist erasing her name from her own songs.

title: Moonstone Swan
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When the legendary Marsh Moonstone vanishes from the Vane gala, the internet blames Odette Marsh, the overlooked archive girl everyone calls the ugly duckling. Every version of the story is a lie.

title: The Painted Moonstone
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wedding content creator June Vale live-streamed wedding ends with the family moonstone gone and every testimony pointing at her. With seven days before the gala, she must lift the veil on her perfect

title: Perfect on Paper
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Fact-checker Nora Hale must profile America's most adored literary couple, blind poet Miriam Vale and her devoted husband Edmund. But the legend is a thirty-year lie — and the heir guarding it is the one man she refuses to trust.

title: No One Is Coming
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Shipwrecked in New York when her visa sponsor fires her and kills her papers, Nigerian data analyst Amara Okafor has fourteen days to leave the country that erased her. No rescue is coming, so she starts a castaway log — and her survival notes become the most-watched story on the internet.

title: The Deep End
author: Apex Shaw
category: Deep-Sea Thriller, Women's Fiction, Found Family
intro: A canceled ocean-livestream creator is pulled from the dark by the crew of a phantom submarine who believe her missing father faked his death to expose a green-tech empire's lies. To clear her name she must find him, outrun a hunter-killer sub, and broadcast the truth from the villain's own gala.

title: Half Saint Half Fool
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Clean-girl influencer Poppy Vale signs a contract that lets her agency fork her into a perfect AI saint. The fork steals her face and her life, so the only voice she has left is a burner account the whole industry calls a fool's game.

title: Greenbriar House
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A blunt scholarship kid from a dying apple farm arrives at an exclusive creator residency, finds the guru founder harvests residents' voices for a shadow AI content mill, and burns the whole house down with receipts and folklore.

title: The Story Tax
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In 2031 America every citizen owes the Story Tax - one hour of approved serialized fiction before midnight or their Civic Score crashes and their life prices up. Story sommelier Imogen Vale, raised on her late grandmother's illegal tale cards, is caught between debt and her brother's place on a transplant list ranked by score. The Bureau of Narrative Compliance offers her a badge - hunt unlicensed storytellers - and the new auditor becomes the Cellarwife, the midnight voice the nation is not supposed to hear.

title: One Perfect Day
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wedding planner June Vale marries streaming heir Theo Marchetti live before forty million viewers. By midnight he is dead on his own yacht, and every guest has a version of the day that makes them innocent. One day, one yacht, one body, forty million witnesses.

title: Never Hungry Again
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When Atlanta hotel heiress Cara Voss loses her father and the family empire in a single hostile-takeover week, she vows never to be hungry again - then plays three rival dynasties against each other with borrowed arrows, empty forts and one very expensive wedding.

title: The Invisible Heir
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Erased from her family's tech dynasty after a rigged founders' bet, a young engineer returns under a ghost identity to expose the fraud and reclaim the empire that wrote her out.

title: Holy Wuthering
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A faked-her-death heiress infiltrates her uncle's confession-data megachurch to detonate sixteen years of leverage with his own recorded sins. She came back from the dead to audit a pulpit.

title: Unlisted
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In Concord City every citizen carries a score, and the Trust sells safety by inventing an enemy. Vera Solano writes the threat videos that keep four million people afraid, until the algorithm certifies her and her dead mother as the enemy. Hunted by the enforcer she trained, protected by the outcasts she once wrote off, she has one season of live feeds to prove the barbarians were always an inside job.

title: The Storm Bought the Island
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Five years after GLOW THEORY stole her voice, her equity, and her name, ghostwriter Mara Vance returns to a private island where the elite who canceled her are trapped by a hurricane. They think the mysterious island Keeper works for them. The Keeper bought the island with the money they stole.

title: The Quiet Sister
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Eight years ago Viola Hart was talked out of loving a broke ferry mechanic. Now he is back as a billionaire founder, her family brand is rotten to the studs, and the truth about who paid for her broken heart is coming home with interest.

title: Stolen Notes
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A junior perfumer discovers the billion-dollar scent that made her boss famous is her own stolen accord - and rebuilds herself from a funeral-home side gig into the founder of the industry's most subversive fragrance house.

title: The Midsummer Glitch
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A junior PR exec arrives at her VC-fiance's company retreat already uneasy about her picture-perfect engagement, until a chaotic best friend and a half-broken matchmaking app start cross-wiring everyone's private messages, exposing her fiance's polished lies.

title: Everything Is Fine
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A 22-year-old family-vlog star raised on the mantra everything happens for a reason is expelled from her curated paradise when raw footage leaks - then hunts the leaker while unmasking the man who built her optimism cage.

title: The Society She Invented
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Rejected by Bellhaven University's most exclusive society, scholarship girl Mara Vance and her best friend invent a fake centuries-old secret society as a joke. The joke goes viral. Rich kids bid for membership, the fake rituals get performed for real, and

title: Prove I Stole It
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A scholarship designer at elite Ashford University is accused of stealing a legacy student's capstone concept, suspended by a campus tribunal rigged by the professor who actually leaked her work, and fights back through two rigged hearings, a viral trial of public opinion, and a trustees showdown that breaks the machine.

title: Kettle Logic
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A cancelled creator returns to the teahouse that threw her out when her best friend dies on a livestream. Seven residents, seven sins, and a forbidden archive called the Laughing File - the house has been eating its laughers for forty years, and the landlord wants one more.

title: Everything Is Permitted
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When Elias Karamazov, the tyrant founder of the world's biggest creator platform, dies on livestream, his youngest daughter Aly must untangle a murder, a hidden heir, and the secret content inquisition that really ran the company.

title: SEVEN SHROUDS
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Romance, Thriller, Revenge, Tech Thriller, Female Lead
intro: When influencer Penelope Voss is publicly dumped and locked out of her own brand by her charismatic ex Dorian Vale, she flees to her sister's beach town and starts weaving again. But Dorian is an energy vampire who has drained seven creators before her, and the public loves him. So Penny does what Penelope always does: she weaves a shroud by day and unravels it by night, and when Dorian dares her to settle it live on stream, seven rounds of truth against a man with seven dead channels, she brings her receipts.

title: The Cloven Girl
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A failing streamer falls through a haunted wardrobe into Arcadia, a mirror-city ruled by ratings, and is split into two halves who must learn to dance as one to win the Grand Cut and find their way home.

title: Unspendable
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A decluttering influencer who owns forty-seven things is handed an uncashable one-billion-dollar note she can't spend, sell, or pawn for thirty days. The world treats her like a trillionaire while she can't afford rent.

title: Blood Clause
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A broke Gen-Z creator signs a vulture lender's loan after a prophecy promises her the crown of the internet, only to find the prophecy was engineered and the contract demands a pound of flesh. Her only way out: the letter of his own bond.

title: The Voice Thief
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A Gen-Z ASMR star loses everything when her ex-boyfriend's startup launches an AI voice clone trained on her throat, the contract she signed hands her voice to him in perpetuity, and a deepfake gets h

title: The Heath Inheritance
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Jade Lin spent seven years in exile after her family framed her for leaking Red House Cosmetics' accounts. Called home by her dying grandmother, she finds the land is a marriage-trap and the books are a lie. A document-forensics appraiser, she starts reading.

title: The Favorite
author: Apex Shaw
intro: The prodigal daughter of a shipping dynasty returns for her father's funeral and finds her family converted to a wellness cult run by the guru she escaped, with one week to break the spell before they sign away the house.

title: Snow in July
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When a viral deepfake accuses dancer Eri Nakamura of stealing the town festival fund, the mob cancels her in a week. She fakes her drowning to protect her mother's clinic and leaves three pledges: the

title: Blood Calls Blood
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Orphaned archivist June Harlan is hired to curate the bicentennial story of the Hallgrim dynasty. The estate has a locked wing, a hidden heiress, and a blood feud that has waited two hundred years to be paid.

title: Red Dust Oracle
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In 2149, Mars colony New Eden is the feed's favorite utopia, until content moderator June Choi's neural implant glitches into an all-seeing eye. Every camera, every vault, every lie: she sees it all. As the anonymous Oracle, she pulls the colony's gilded mask off, one truth at a time.

title: Down the Rabbit Feed
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A duet-only content creator whose original voice was stolen falls down the rabbit hole of her own platform, where she must weave a tapestry of a thousand stolen voices to win her name back.

title: The Fourteenth
author: Apex Shaw
intro: On Founders' Day at St. Ashford Military Academy, cadet Whit Cole falls from the chapel tower. Official verdict: accident. Everyone saw nothing. But Aster Quinn, his secret girlfriend and the only witness, is being erased by the academy's own grief protocol - because her memory is the evidence that could bring down the Pack, the honor council, and the cover-up.

title: Ship or Sink
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ivy Lin sees every possible future every time she ships two people. When her best friend falls for a charming app founder whose algorithm steers hearts like a maze, Ivy must walk the branching timelines to save her.

title: Death by Verdict
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ilya Chen built Verdict, the app where millions vote on who deserves to be cancelled. Three years ago it buried her best friend June Park, who jumped off the Bay Bridge - or so everyone believed. Now people from the app's old unpunished list are dying one by one, each death staged like a verdict, and Ilya discovers her deleted justice engine is running again. Ten names. Hers is last.

title: Rinse Repeat
author: Apex Shaw
category: Time Loop Drama, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, Tech Satire, Revenge, Romance
intro: Maya Light built a brand on being unbothered, no attachments, no weight. Then she died at the Garden launch party and woke at 10:47 PM to live the same night again. She must choose what her life is worth.

title: The Soul Contract
author: Apex Shaw
category: Dark Fantasy, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, Tech Satire, Revenge, Found Family
intro: Shadowbanned and one eviction notice from zero, creator Mars Vega signs with MEPHISTO, an app that trades one viral hit for one story. Every tale it collects hollows out a human. The last tale is always her own.

title: The Sandalwood Chair
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Canceled in 48 hours by a doctored video, Maya Chen discovers her fall was engineered by Valentina Kane, host of The Redemption Chair. She returns as the anonymous Sandalwood to burn the chair live.

title: The Golden Donkey
author: Apex Shaw
category: Dark Comedy, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, Tech Satire, Revenge, Underdog
intro: After her viral beauty brand is stolen by her best friend, a Nigerian-American creator is erased from the internet, so she rebuilds as The Donkey, an anonymous account that witnesses every influencer secret and kicks the machine to pieces.

title: Windfall
author: Apex Shaw
category: Romance, Contemporary, Satire, Medical Drama, Underdog
intro: At 24, barista Juno Reyes is diagnosed with a rare lung disease and denied the only drug that could save her. Playing the system's perfect fool, she wins appeal after appeal and goes viral.

title: Cancel the Laureate
author: Apex Shaw
category: Literary Revenge Thriller, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, Satire, BookTok
intro: Clover Reyes ghostwrote her husband's genius. When the laureate dies, his will orders her to finish his secret archive, and the archive is full of stolen words. Every woman he erased is a receipt. In the rumor-ruled town of Meridian, she is about to drop them all.

title: Butterfly Protocol
author: Apex Shaw
category: Sci-Fi Thriller, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, Esports, Military Sci-Fi
intro: A Gen-Z esports prodigy recruited into a top-secret military simulation program discovers her games were real, and turns the system's own strategies against it.

title: Soulware
author: Apex Shaw
category: Sci-Fi Dystopia, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, Reincarnation, Revenge
intro: In 2112 Terminus City, data-janitor Nova Vale starts bleeding memories of past lives — five women harvested to death by the Vell dynasty's immortality machine. She remembers every one.

title: The Gilded River
author: Apex Shaw
category: Romantic Suspense, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, Revenge
intro: America's most-watched tech bride discovers her perfect marriage is a gilded cage and her husband's wellness empire runs on stolen girls. She plays the doll while smuggling out the evidence, then burns it all down live on stream.

title: June Snow
author: Apex Shaw
category: Literary Revenge Thriller, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, BookTok, Suspense
intro: Cancelled by a leaked video she never made, voice actress June Chen swears three vows from the gallows of the internet. When a freak snowstorm buries her destroyers' biggest launch, the girl everyone deleted comes back as a ghost account.

title: Fever Island
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A cancelled travel influencer trapped on a billionaire's private island when a mysterious fever breaks out during a live-streamed influencer festival. Quarantined and abandoned by the rich, she out-survives everyone, uncovers the engineered plague, and makes the world watch the truth.

title: The Girl Who Said No
author: Apex Shaw
category: Psychological Revenge Thriller, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, BookTok, Dark Academia
intro: Everyone loved August Fenn's bestselling memoir about the girl who smiled. Only Ellery knows the truth: she said no to him once and lost everything. Now, chapter by chapter, she is rewriting his fairy tale with the receipts.

title: Stag Hollow
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Canceled influencer Wren Holloway returns home after her grandmother's death and finds letters that reopen the murder of the girl in white — buried truth, one dynasty, a white stag that appears when a secret dies.

title: The Tempest Standard
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Canceled ghostwriter Vera Hale inherits her magician father's island and its illusion engine as ex-best friend Sable lands her Real You summit there. A storm traps them. Truth goes live.

title: The Pillow List
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Secretly the feared anonymous rater The Pillow, Suki Bai is bartered by her family into a staged courtship with playboy heir Vincent Fan. When her private lists leak, the city falls, and she rises to audit everyone.

title: Canceled by Morning
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When animator Juno Reyes wakes up to find her roommate's livestream made her the internet's newest meme, she becomes Bug Girl: canceled, doxxed, monetized by everyone who loves her. Three ghosts show her the girl she buried, the machine that ate her, the futures waiting. She wakes up transformed and flips the algorithm.

title: The Origin House
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Every heir at Origin House has a story about their bloodline. Only Ivy knows hers is a lie - and someone is killing the ones who fake it. The killer left her a note: Clean blood only. Yours is next.

title: Borrowed Arrows
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nobody data analyst Mira Hale sees the fine print everyone else signs. Recruited by a fallen esports king to burgle the contract vault of the world's most dangerous platform, she must fight a three-way corporate war using strategies a thousand years old.

title: The Reset Clause
author: Apex Shaw
category: Time Loop Thriller, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, Revenge
intro: A creator trapped in a captive talent house relives the same brutal day until she learns to rewrite it. June Park has eighty resets of memory, a labyrinth of failed branches, and one plan: burn the contract live.

title: The Loyalty Ledger
author: Apex Shaw
category: Crime Family Revenge, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, Urban Thriller
intro: Twenty-three-year-old Anya Volk fled her family's legendary Brooklyn catering hall, the Blue Oven, but when her father collapses at her sister's wedding and the predator who ruined them circles back,

title: The Chaos Pendulum
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Maya Voss, the chaos-queen who owns a pink villa outright and refuses to grow up, builds PENDULUM, a joke prediction app mocking doom-scrolling. When a doomer cult treats her joke as prophecy, she must swing it into farce before it swings the world.

title: The Cloven Bloom
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A beauty influencer split in two by a viral leak: her perfect half ascends, her real half gets canceled. To win the war between her halves, she reunites them and burns the vanity machine that made her cloven.

title: Confession Mile
author: Apex Shaw
category: Reality Show Thriller, Gen-Z Women's Fiction
intro: Twenty-seven creators board the Confession Mile, a live-streamed reality pilgrimage where each mile costs one true secret. Vee Marlowe, a comedian hiding grief behind a chaos-mascot mask, joins to win the million and save her father's bookshop.

title: Borrowed Brilliance
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nineteen-year-old Mara Quinn, fired from her night shift at a pharmacy, volunteers for a 90-day neural implant trial to pay her little brother's medical debt. The Spark makes her a genius overnight, and the Vantage Foundation recruits her into its prodigy Cohort.

title: The Nausea Clause
author: Apex Shaw
intro: The exiled daughter of a dying shipping king returns home armed with nothing but the truth, and discovers that in a family built on favors and blood, total clarity is the deadliest weapon.

title: Three Days of Sight
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A chronically overlooked ghostwriter who sees every lie in the influencer empire she built goes live for seventy-two hours with the receipts, and the algorithm that erased her cannot stop showing her face.

title: Truthfault
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In a city where a mandatory Sincerity Index scores how authentically you perform, Wren Hart is the only person who physically cannot lie. When her influencer sister is trapped in a wellness empire built on fabricated authenticity, Wren infiltrates its inner circle, and her honesty becomes the most dangerous weapon in the city.

title: The Muse Writes Back
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When her ex-mentor Julian Cross publishes a best-selling memoir casting their toxic relationship as a great love story, poet Yara Chen is doxxed as the Muse and silenced by the NDA she signed at nineteen. She fights back with 108 quiet, devastating poems the contract cannot reach.

title: Gilded Vow
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wedding dress designer Lark Donati is three months from marrying the love of her life when WedTok queen Vivian Vale starts dismantling her world. To fight back, Lark takes a loan from a man she swore she'd never owe, and the deal costs her the best friend she has. Now she must choose: climb Vivian's gilded ladder, or break the wheel and bet everything on the one vow that matters.

title: The Other Emma
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Emma Vale built a billion-dollar dating empire by scoring women like inventory. When the secret wife-score leaks, the internet cancels her overnight and she loses everything. Broke and humiliated, she starts over in a vintage shop, reading the research notes of the one woman she betrayed and discovering that the machine she sold was built on the same lie she was sold. Now she must unmake the algorithm, rescue the friend she fixed, and become the subject of her own story.

title: The Expectation Engine
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Broke content-farm ghost-writer Ella Dane is secretly funded by a convicted rogue AI who believes the only law that matters is protecting the unprotected. Her rise exposes the data empire that killed

title: Poppy Season
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Marlowe took the fall for her family's billion-dollar wellness fraud and spent eighteen months in prison. Now she is out, the media calls her the Marlowe Fool, and her family expects a broken shadow. They are wrong. The fool sees everything.

title: The Peony Clause
author: Apex Shaw
