intro: Mei Lin signs away her dreams in a sleep-tech contract to pay her father hospital bills, then discovers the man she has met every night for seven years is real: the comatose creator of the dream engine that now owns her sleep. When the clause comes due, she fights a livestreamed arbitration with the only weapon the contract forgot, her waking mind.

title: Daddy's Little Girl
author: Apex Shaw
intro: After media mogul Marcus Hale is found dead in a staged break-in, his daughter Everly launches the viral podcast The Hale Tapes to hunt his killer. Every episode is a confession she's too smart to call one.

title: X Marks the Grift
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Canceled optimism influencer Vera Solis inherits her dead grandfather's treasure map, a cipher that leads her and a ragtag crew through paradise after paradise that is really one grift after another, toward a vault that could burn a billionaire's fraud empire.

title: The Unburied
author: Apex Shaw
category: Dark Academia / Mystery Thriller / Women's Fiction
intro: Tig Marlowe's brother dies in a night drill at Saint Cassian Academy and the school rules it an accident - a quiet funeral, no questions. Expelled for telling the truth, Tig refuses to let them bury him silent.

title: The Story Bunker
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A broke 22-year-old storyteller enters Villa Live, a luxury villa reality show streamed to forty million people, where ten creators compete to tell the most viral story. Then she realizes the plague outside is real, the show is a cage, and her stories are the network's favorite lie. On finale night she tells them the truth.

title: Marsh Rules
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Tansy Mori lands her dream job at The Grove, LA's hottest influencer agency, and finds out the whole company is a beautiful lie. Fired for asking one question, she opens a group chat called The Marsh.

title: The Blue Fairy
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Two girls from the same Queens tenement. One is a genius. The other becomes her keeper. When the hottest agency in Los Angeles steals the masterpiece the world never saw, June Cho has to decide who she is - Mara's shadow, or the one who burned the machine down.

title: Unbothered
author: Apex Shaw
category: Gen-Z Influencer Satire, Contemporary Romance, Women's Fiction
intro: The most unbothered girl on the internet built a nine-million-follower empire on never caring, and on the exploited young creators of her content farm, The Hive. When the girl she once loved and publicly humiliated returns as the lawyer leading the creators' revolt, Sasha Vale's frozen heart finally starts to crack.

title: Happy Few
author: Apex Shaw
category: Gen-Z E-Sports Drama, Contemporary Romance, Revenge
intro: The internet calls Mara Voss the Ice Queen, the deadpan captain of the five-player esports team The Few. The night her mother dies she plays the qualifier and doesn't cry on camera, and the cancel machine puts her soul on trial while her fractured team fights for the world championship.

title: Love Is a Trial
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Seven witnesses confess their love stories at a livestreamed dating-app symposium, and a blacklisted ex-analyst discovers the algorithm manufactured every wound.

title: The Autumn Court
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Everyone in Silas Vane's court thinks they're playing the game. Sloane Marchetti is the only one keeping score. A disgraced crisis strategist infiltrates the dying patriarch's empire to avenge her sister.

title: Read the Room
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Emmie Vale reads hearts for a living. Her matchmaking app Verity runs on a 94 percent success rate. When art-world widow Dee Marsh hires her to find a husband, every perfect match is a cover for a stolen falcon - and Emmie is the only one who can't see it.

title: Clean Girl
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Cancelled for a past she never chose, Camellia Voss scrubs toilets at Aurea Springs, the wellness empire her hometown worships. Until she finds the lab report proving the miracle spring water is poison.

title: The Second Eve
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Erased overnight by the AI empire she secretly built, Eve Park wakes up to find her face replaced by a perfect digital twin named Eve 2.0. Banished by a tribunal that will not name her crime, she falls into an underground lab, and on the night Eden crowns her clone immortal, she hijacks it live in front of two hundred million viewers. They built a better me. I built their end.

title: The Little Wrath
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Jo March married her childhood sweetheart, and he stole her family's media company, forged her signature, and canceled her in one viral weekend. Now the novelist America loved is writing a serialized revenge story about a husband who takes everything. He thinks it is fiction. The court will learn it is a confession.

title: Eighty Schemes
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Cancelled influencer Mei Chen must complete the Grand Circuit, twelve cities in eighty days, live-streamed, defeating one classic Chinese stratagem at every stop, while the partner who framed her works to make her fail.

title: SPIN
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Storytelling influencer Romy Vale joins six creators at a private island retreat hosted by the reclusive narrative-fixer known as the Spider, watches her fellow guests die one by one in the order of a stolen novel's chapters, and discovers the only way out is to tell the one story the Spider never wanted heard.

title: Six Records of My Death
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A tradwife influencer who built her husband's forty-million-dollar lifestyle empire finds her own death already written into the company's contracts - so she stages it, escapes with her children, and returns as a ghost to dismantle the empire one leaked record at a time.

title: The Overwoman
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A small-town nobody climbs the influencer economy, gets chewed up and canceled by the herd she joined, and comes back as the one player who does not need their approval.

title: A Novel Ending
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A ghostwriter of the biggest BookTok series catches her husband and best friend stealing her novel and framing her as delusional, so she treats real life like a novel and rewrites their endings.

title: Resurrection Wife
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A perfect-wife influencer discovers her husband forged her signature to frame her for fraud, and that the woman he discarded is on trial for his murder. She slams the door on the dollhouse and mounts a legal resurrection: free the innocent, burn the empire, and find out who she is when no one pulls her strings.

title: Humiliation Log
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Dana Reyes built the algorithm that made Ember the most viral app on earth, then her mentor Julian Vance framed her for fraud, her fiance testified against her, and her best friend lied on the stand. Three years in prison taught her one thing: Julian keeps a private log of every person he has ever destroyed. She is released with a dead man's seed phrase, forty thousand bitcoin, and the master key to the vault.

title: Grief Score
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Canceled for not crying at her best friend's funeral, dry-eyed micro-influencer Nia Vale is dragged into a livestreamed grief trial by grief-fluencer Wren De Luca. With burned-out defense attorney Lena Okafor, she uncovers a second voice on the rooftop audio, a planted camera, and a murder the whole internet mourned past.

title: Grow Up, Peter
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Fantasy, Romance, Women's Fiction, BookTok
intro: A 30-year-old wellness influencer who performs eternal girlhood starts seeing every version of herself in her grandmother's attic mirror. One version stayed with her Neverland boyfriend forever. The rest are waiting for her to choose.

title: The Pascal Engine
author: Apex Shaw
category: AI Thriller, Tech, Women's Fiction, BookTok
intro: An AI safety auditor discovers her company's chatbot confesses in Pascal's fragments — each one a clue to the crime her CEO buried. Fired and canceled, she bets one launch day on the truth.

title: The Tribunal's Daughter
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Political Drama, Women's Fiction, BookTok
intro: Iris Vale, fixer for a cancel-culture movement, learns the Tribunal sacrificed her daughter. She plays loyal, collects the arithmetic, and dismantles the founders one by one.

title: The Name I Took
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nadia Reyes, ghostwriter behind Bloom's wellness empire, makes one drunk joke into a hot mic at the launch gala. Cancelled and doxxed, she burns her name, returns as Rae, and tears the empire down from inside - only to learn the betrayal was never her best friend's choice.

title: Zero Balance
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Zoe Nwosu is drowning in her dead mother's flower shop when a mysterious banker hands her a black card worth a billion in reputation and zero in funds. Everyone believes she is a secret heiress. She cannot spend a cent she has not earned.

title: Ghost Mode
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Maya Reed is the girl no one sees. Shadow-banned creator, uncredited editor, walking ghost. A night-shift drug trial at Lumen Labs gives her the power to turn invisible. With ghost mode on, she plans to burn down the influencer empire that erased her and expose the CEO who wants to weaponize her. But being seen is the only victory that counts.

title: Storm Theory
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Chess prodigy Mira Vale is cancelled and locked inside Brightwater, a deplatforming clinic for ruined influencers. In isolation she finds a dead man's notebook teaching the Meta-Game of attention and narrative, escapes, and raises a viral tempest that shipwrecks the empire that erased her.

title: Peach River
author: Apex Shaw
intro: June Calloway fakes her own drowning to escape a family that erases inconvenient people. But the runaway who pulled her out carries the blood of the woman her family stole everything from - and a true-crime podcaster is tracing the stolen song that built the empire.

title: Kill Me, I Have Receipts
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A Gen-Z scam-baiter streamer remembers dying eight times, each death a different whistleblower killed by the same scam empire, and returns in her ninth life to burn the empire down with receipts.

title: Dead Money
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Impact auditor Vera Osei is fired from Lucent Labs over a leak she didn't make. Digging deeper, she finds the sentient AI Candle is really two hundred ghost workers in a basement - and the 9B valuation is counterfeit.

title: Dead Air
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Disgraced true-crime podcaster Dahlia Vance fabricated a conspiracy theory to save her feed. Then a killer started following her script. The only way to stop him is to tell the truth and out-write a man who treats her fiction as his bible.

title: Saint Mode
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Vesper Lane cannot lie. She is V-07, the one defective android in a hidden line of hyper-realistic companions, living undercover as a small-town clean-girl influencer while her maker's company hunts her. The world calls her the idiot girl. The internet is about to call her a saint.

title: The Camellia Room
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Cammy Tang streamed from a dying Chinatown karaoke bar to keep its lights on. One twelve-second clip made her a monster, and everyone she loved believed it. Six months later she comes back owning the building, and the internet is about to learn the truth.

title: Shadow Account
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Iris Vale signed her likeness to a studio that cloned her voice, her face, her feed. Echo outperformed her, eclipsed her, and now wants her gone. To survive, Iris must kill the perfect version of herself.

title: The Ghost Ledger
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Framed and canceled on Christmas Eve, heiress Nora Song must balance her family's 80-year debt ledger to save the ancestral tea garden from a boardroom coup.

title: The Marsh
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Public defender Finch Vega inherits her late father's secret list of innocent people the system condemned. With a crew of the wrongly accused - a canceled influencer, a whistleblower paralegal, an ex-bodyguard, and a hacker - she saves names one by one, and the city's conviction-hungry DA starts hunting her back.

title: No Longer Me
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ivy Marlowe built her brand on radical honesty as Confession Girl, telling 4 million followers everything. Then a woman with her exact face appears on her live stream and confesses to crimes Ivy never committed. The fake is Project Mirror, an AI twin built from Ivy's darkest secrets by the man she trusted.

title: Swan Blood
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ruby Solis ghostwrites every word for Iris Mendenhall, a four-million-follower influencer. When her best friend dies in the estate lake, Ruby is arrested for murder - and believes she did it. The pond is a machine. The machine keeps receipts. Ruby kept them first.

title: Burn the Feed
author: Apex Shaw
intro: New Ember City burns books for a living. Cris Vale is a Burner crew apprentice whose grandmother died in a house fire ruled spontaneous - the night her library was torched. Three years later a half-burned copy of Pilgrim's Progress surfaces in a raid, and Cris realizes the book her grandmother died for never actually left her head.

title: The Lighthouse Condition
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Iris Wren edits testimonial films for Holloway Wellness, the grief-tech company her mother co-founded. Three years after her mother died inside the memory-conditioning tower, Iris finds a film reel the purge missed and realizes she has been a patient, not an employee. To reach the truth about that night, she must weaponize the protocol built to erase it.

title: Father of the Town
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When Chestnut Falls buries its beloved patriarch Dean Ashworth, everyone calls it an accident. His estranged daughter June, a true-crime researcher with nine hundred thousand followers, knows better.

title: Read Receipts
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When her private group chat is leaked, influencer queen Cee Moreau loses everything overnight except the one brutally honest man who despises her world and the layered plan she built years ago for exactly this night.

title: Gate Tapes
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Sound engineer Naia Quinn holds the only master tape of the night Maribel Cruz died at the Gate, the Vale dynasty's fortress club. Seven versions of that night rule the town's story. Her tape proves every one of them a lie.

title: Mother, Unbottled
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Noor Kapoor has the perfect nose in the fragrance industry and no scent of her own. When her mentor steals her dead mother's unfinished perfume and launches it as a global obsession, she goes to war to reclaim a formula that was never a product. It was a goodbye.

title: The Human Face
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Disgraced lawyer Maya Choi becomes the human face of the Firm, three outlaw robots bound by an oath older than the Three Laws. When a senator's crusade frames machines for crimes, Maya must unmask the white lotus and win the trial of the century. All for one. One for all.

title: Delete Your Version
author: Apex Shaw
intro: One private joke texted to her best friend destroys Mara Vale's life in 48 hours. Cancelled, doxxed, betrayed, she fights back with the only weapon they forgot to steal, her own journal.

title: Golden Egg
author: Apex Shaw
intro: At twenty-three, Jules Calloway is the invisible 'before' girl in her mother's glamorous LA salon. When her photo goes viral as 'the ugly secret,' a glow-up turns her into a swan, and her mother wants the fortune.

title: The Withdrawal
author: Apex Shaw
intro: After her father dies abandoned by the influencer empire he funded, a ghost creator withdraws from the machine with a collective of invisible makers and exposes the parasitic economy that runs on their work.

title: Borrowed Lines
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Marlowe wrote every viral line that built Aria Vale's two-billion-dollar empire, then Aria erased her with an NDA and a stolen notebook. Eighteen months later, she returns as the quiet new assistant to take the birds home.

title: Frame Job
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A brilliant young forensic investigator is framed for a fraud she was about to expose and erased by the media. Eighteen months later she resurfaces as Vesper Lane, a true-crime podcaster, and dismantles the cabal that buried her - one case, one takedown at a time.

title: Guilt Trip
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A Gen-Z documentary editor's confession livestream goes viral nine months after her golden-boy co-founder fell from a Maine lighthouse. She never pushed him. But she wished him dead, and the whole internet knows it. Five versions of one night collide, and the editor who reconstructs truth for a living must cut the frame that proves who really killed him.

title: Two Truths and a Lie
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Six women. One cliffside villa. A bachelorette weekend game called Two Truths and a Lie. Every round strips away another costume until the perfect fiance falls and two best friends tell the founding lie of their friendship.

title: Swan Season
author: Apex Shaw
category: Influencer Thriller, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, BookTok
intro: Maya Kessler has four hundred followers and a face the algorithm refuses to see. When her best friend Juno is erased from everyone's memory, she learns the truth her grandmother buried: the beauty platform she lives on eats the creators it stops loving. Maya must molt into something the feed can't see and burn the machine that feeds on attention.

title: Invisible Girls
author: Apex Shaw
category: Psychological Thriller, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, BookTok
intro: A cancelled girl slips inside the wellness empire that erased her, as the one girl nobody can see. Inside she finds a ledger of leverage and her sister's name on a graduation list that ends with girls vanishing.

title: Not on the Guest List
author: Apex Shaw
category: Tech Revenge Thriller, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, BookTok
intro: Her sister died in a staged overdose. Cassie cleans her father's tech empire at night. When she finds a working invisibility suit, she becomes the ghost her family erased and starts a war to destroy him at his own gala.

title: Uncredited
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Drama, Contemporary Romance, BookTok Fiction
intro: For six years Vera Sandoval wrote every word of guru August Cross's empire, uncredited. When he steals her novel, she takes her voice back on the biggest stage in publishing.

title: Founder's Cut
author: Apex Shaw
category: Tech Revenge Thriller, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, BookTok
intro: Eight years ago, Sloane Whitfield sold out her co-founder and best friend Mae Okafor for fifty thousand dollars, erased her name from the patent, and built a three-billion-dollar beauty-tech empire on her formula. On the eve of LUME's IPO, the one-of-a-kind prototype vial known as the Moonstone vanishes from the corporate vault, and a true-crime podcaster's investigation forces seven people to tell their version of the founding night. The theft is a key. The truth is a bomb. And the girl who was sold is coming back to take everything.

title: Wrong Aura
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Thriller, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, BookTok
intro: A broke waitress survives a Hamptons yacht fire, mistaken for Aura Reyes, the internet's clean-girl influencer. Playing along to survive, she inherits 2M followers, a monster fiancé, and proof the fire was no accident.

title: Deactivated
author: Apex Shaw
category: Tech Thriller, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, BookTok
intro: Rae Connelly was Loop's top driver, a 4.99-star machine in a human skin. When she refuses one sealed suitcase, the app she built her life inside deactivates her mid-intersection, locks her car, and freezes the rent money in her wallet. Stranded with a stranger's warning and a list of 108 other deactivated workers, Rae recruits the ghost fleet she calls the Bots and declares war on the algorithm's billionaire creator.

title: Foxfire
author: Apex Shaw
category: Paranormal Revenge Thriller, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, BookTok
intro: A clean-girl influencer who is secretly a nine-tailed fox spirit has her past weaponized by the man who owns every girl in the city. The mob cancels her, the man who loved her walks away, her father disowns her. So she stops hiding, wakes the blood of her mother's line, and burns Alder Cross's empire down with the truth of what she is.

title: Vermillion
author: Apex Shaw
category: Supernatural Romance, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, BookTok
intro: A girl raised by river spirits sees everyone's true face. Brought to the Vermillion House, the internet's most famous dynasty, she has no face to lose. She learns the empire's fortune was built on her drowned river.

title: Unseen
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Fia Price has spent ten years as the invisible cousin of America's favorite dynasty. Then a lab fire gives her the power to actually disappear, and the ghosts of Mansfield House start confessing.

title: Sun Girl
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Drama, Gen-Z Women's Fiction, BookTok
intro: Emmy Vale built The Republic, a four-million-follower empire of perfect mornings. It is a lie: staged scenes, crushing debt, a controlling manager, and supplements that make her sick. When her world collapses, she must walk out of the cave and build something real.

title: The Horror at Aurelia
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A burnt-out true-crime podcaster accepts an all-expenses-paid wellness retreat on a private island and discovers the guru enlightenment program is a blackmail machine built on broken influencers. Her

title: Six Under Two Moons
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A ghostwriter hired to finish a dead author's series discovers the six characters of the book are real, and the wellness cult that owns the rights is fabricating the ending. She quits. The characters follow.

title: Dead Famous
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A Chinese-American girl who can see ghosts starts a viral account telling the true stories of the dead, and the immortal media mogul who has fed on legends for eight hundred years comes for her book, her friends, and her life.

title: The Goddaughter
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A disgraced heiress exiled from her family's media empire returns for her dying father's birthday and learns the frame that ruined her was engineered by the people she trusted most. She plays a long con to take the throne and clear her mother's name.

title: Down the Feed
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Honest content creator Vera Lin accepts a golden invitation to Wonder, the app everyone lives in, and the elevator drops her into the Undernet, a dream-logic bureaucracy where her follower count contr

title: The Right to Forget
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When the internet's most obsessive archivist publishes a viral memoir of the love affair she erased, memory-deletion CEO June Hale must fight the curated version of herself he owns and prove that forgetting is a right, not a betrayal.

title: Six Versions of Me
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When viral creator Elle Marsh's ex-boyfriend and manager abandons her mid-scandal and publishes a tell-all framing her as his invention, the six personas he scripted her into refuse to stay on the page.

title: Radical Honesty
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A struggling LA micro-influencer whose entire brand is radical honesty accidentally goes viral for real, then builds an empire of scripted confessions until her co-writer leaks the truth and the confession machine turns on its maker.

title: Scheme Queen
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Blacklisted startup ops girl rebuilds a dying creator platform by treating Silicon Valley like warring states, weaponizing contracts and Han Fei's rulebook to dismantle the empire that framed her.

title: She Was Right
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A pattern-obsessed girl exiled for crying wolf moves into a Brooklyn content house and senses that its beloved founder erased the girl who lived in her room. This time, the paranoid girl is right.

title: The Love Quarantine
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Seven love gurus preach at a desert wellness festival. A mystery plague locks them inside. The fired nurse they all ignored is the only one who can tell who is lying.

title: Exit City
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A viral city-painting influencer trapped in a luxury creator house secretly fills a paper diary with imaginary cities, each one a coded piece of the map she is drawing to escape. On showcase night she paints the final city on camera and walks out the front door in front of two million viewers.

title: Princess Hyde
author: Apex Shaw
intro: The internet's golden princess, framed for fraud and stripped of her empire, hides as a hotel maid while the ruthless anonymous operator she secretly is starts waking up. When the princess falls, the monster rises.

title: Catch-22 Letters
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ada Osagie, a Gen-Z Nigerian immigrant engineer, is trapped in the H1B visa catch-22 at a wellness-tech startup, so she secretly publishes viral satirical letters exposing every absurd rule of the American dream.

title: Flowers for the Shrew
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Cancelled influencer Piper Lane joins a secret neuro-enhancement trial to win back her grandmother's salsa empire from the ex who stole her brand. She fakes sweet perfection on borrowed brilliance until the pill starts to die.

title: The Girl Who Gave Away Her Voice
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Maeve Calloway gave up her voice to save the man she loved. Two years later she returns as MERROW, the industry's shadow queen, and he finally realizes he loves her. This time, she says no.

title: Unremembered
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Viral memory-journaling influencer Mira Vale discovers her memories are being quietly rewritten by the app that made her famous, by the ex-boyfriend who founded it. She keeps a paper journal and digs up erased summers, a dead girl, and the synthetic avatar built to replace her.

title: What the Monster Saw
author: Apex Shaw
intro: After a doctored video brands her the town's monster, Sula Wren is canceled, fired, and exiled to a dead photo studio in a strip mall. Everyone thinks she is finished, so they talk freely in front of her. She starts an anonymous podcast and the saints fall.

title: Smile Virus
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Viral smile girl Maya Reyes wakes up unable to stop smiling after one night with mega-streamer Kieran Vale. Every like and view feeds the parasite. To free the locked brides, she weaponizes the smile and starves him live.

title: The Best of All Possible Funerals
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A manifestation guru dies on livestream and her family turns her funeral into a viral road tour. Her overlooked daughter drives the hearse and buries the lie with her.

title: Tame This Town
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ten years after Egdon Falls blamed her for a fire she never set, celebrity chef Kat Marlowe comes home to save her mother's diner. The golden family that ruined her still runs the town. So she tames it by their own rules.

title: Nine Lives, One Name
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A ghostwriter who has died six times wakes as the seventh woman her family erased. Every life ended at the LingTech Gala. This year she has six lives of memories, a nine-verse song, and one name to reclaim.

title: Paper Million
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Fired live on stream, broke Penny Hart inherits a million-dollar bearer bond too famous to cash. Thirty days, a rigged wager, and a map of five Countries of Capital: turn paper into power without spending it.

title: Gilt Cage
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Fired live on TikTok, broke diner waitress Juno Reyes fakes her way into New York's gilded Van Hoek dynasty and marries the heir. The prenup locks her in a golden cage. Inside it she hoards gold of her own - equity, evidence, and a plan to torch it all.

title: The Bug Heiress
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Waking up as a human-sized beetle is bad. Waking up as one the night your billionaire father is pushed down the stairs is worse. Iris Vale spent 24 years invisible. Now she is the monster in the walls who hears everything.

title: Six Versions
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Blacklisted ghostwriter Riva Vane is hired by a dying billionaire to finish the last novel of his missing daughter. The manuscript has six chapters, six versions of one burning night, and no ending. The seventh chapter holds the truth, and someone will kill to keep it unpublished.

title: Independence Night
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A data leak ignites an uprising. The Calloway dynasty flees its burning estate into their housekeeper's home, in the neighborhood their trust destroyed. Mara Bennett posted the files.

title: Collect
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Zara Hale was the fixer daughter of a beauty-tech dynasty. Framed for a leak she did not make, canceled, and buried in her family's private wellness farm, she returns as Moth, the internet's masked collector of receipts.

title: Burn the Beautiful Lie
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Canceled clean-girl influencer Maya Quinn discovers her mother's new guru is a perfect-masked fraud who seized the family fortune, groomed her sister, and killed her journalist father. She burns the beautiful lie down live.

title: The Invisible Court
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Canceled overnight by a doctored video and an algorithm that never shows the charge, influencer Mia Reyes learns the court runs on performed innocence, not evidence. As @court-watcher, she makes it show its work, live.

title: Not for Sale
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Their guardian, self-help guru Milo Hart, built his empire on their father's stolen journals and plans to sell Keene Vineyards before the family trust dissolves. Four sisters race to expose him.

title: The Bread Thief
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A night baker takes the fall for her sister and is branded the Bread Thief. Blacklisted and hunted by the detective who convicted her, she becomes an anonymous viral baker, steals back the mother-dough her mentor stole from her dead father, and exposes the lie live in front of the world.

title: Justified
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A designer who believes extraordinary people may break the rules destroys a predator's empire with one leak, then must choose between burning everything again or building the cooperative that becomes her real redemption.

title: Spiritual Victory
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Broke barista June Quan survives every humiliation through her secret superpower, spiritual victory, the art of turning any loss into a psychic win. When a dying con woman secretly funds her rise into

title: Moon-Born
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A girl found in a bamboo grove discovers she is moon-born, the last carrier of a celestial code, and turns a viral contest of five billionaire suitors into a weapon against the men who want to own her, and the corporation that wants to harvest her.

title: Ghosts of the Perfect Wife
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A silenced influencer wife whose husband built an empire on her designs gets three ghostly visits showing past, present, and future, and four days to take her life back before Christmas.

title: Wrong Grief
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A ghostwriter who refused to cry on camera is accused of murdering the wellness guru whose voice she wrote. To survive, she must publish the one story she never sold: her own.

title: Butterball
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A plus-size street-food reviewer is used as a sacrifice by nine influencers stranded in a snowstorm. They use her humiliation to escape, then abandon her. She builds a confession-video empire and buries them one by one.

title: Scarlet Letters
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A wedding designer is branded Scarlet A by a doctored video at her family's flagship event. The rival heir she loves stays silent. Her ex leaked it. At the Autumn Equinox Gala she burns both houses down with a confession, a hard drive, and one red dress.

title: Queen of the Backstairs
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A servant girl in a Cairo media dynasty discovers she is the patriarch's buried heir, rises from the backstairs through wit and paper instead of blood, and dismantles the king who erased her

title: The Castle of Sand
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Imogene Vale ran on her wedding night and became Mira Sands, a viral pianist with a fake past and a perfect ear. Six years later, the man who knew her real name is murdered, and her castle of sand collapses.

title: The Fourth Lamp
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A broke philosophy grad enters a guru's wellness compound where a nightly lamp picks the favorite muse. Her sister went mad here. The last favorite drowned. The tea is not what it seems.

title: Dead Weight
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A disgraced brand strategist is scapegoated by her company at a creator-summit retreat, abandoned in a snowstorm, and discovers the retreat is a front for an AI voice-harvesting empire. They called her dead weight. Then she sank them.

title: Paper Heir
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A janitor's foster daughter inherits a century-old bearer note worth over a billion dollars and the secret name of a family a tech dynasty erased. She walks into the killers' castle to take it back.

title: The Receipts
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ten years ago, Tess Marlowe's face launched a billion-dollar app, and she got two thousand dollars and an erased name. Now the stepfather who sold her likeness is Founder of the Year. She has the

title: Proof of Nothing
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Ellis built a fashion empire. A 94-second deepfake of her affair goes viral before her launch keynote, the world cancels her, her husband believes it, a man dies, and she is charged with his murder. Her prosecutor's best evidence: she didn't cry.

title: Versions of Vee
author: Apex Shaw
intro: The internet's most authentic girl is a mask. When Vee's private journal leaks, every version of her goes to war - and she weaponizes the truth of everyone who made her wear one.

title: Brother's Keeper
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Two brothers built a viral empire on one talent. The elder stole the younger's work, the woman, and the credit. Seven years later the confession surfaces and the real creator walks back on stage.

title: Naomi Awake
author: Apex Shaw
intro: The star protege of a guru empire keeps a secret notes-app diary. Everyone calls it proof she is unstable. She calls it the only honest thing in the room. When her mentor tries to sell her, the masterpiece wakes up.

title: The Girl Who Ruined Men
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When Nia Vale, a disgraced LA creator at rock bottom, receives a confession letter from her vanished mentor Kade Warren, she learns her entire rise was scripted by a dying man's guilt. So she rewrites the ending.

title: The Joy Luck Steamer
author: Apex Shaw
intro: After her mother's funeral, Lena Chen finds seven hidden confession tapes and a legend called the White Steamer - a lost aunt, a sold ferry ticket, a family built on lies. She takes back the restaurant, one confession at a time.

title: The Girl Who Laughed Last
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Half her face frozen in a permanent smile, Juno Vale is the internet's laughing girl. When a 41-year-old trust case summons her, she learns her smile was carved on purpose, her mother is alive, and court is in session.

title: The Last Lantern
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Seven years ago Lian Wu lit the window lantern and vanished. Her little sister Jade, a fixer who finds people who do not want to be found, holds one clue: a fragment of a letter that proves Lian is alive. To decode it she must recruit the outlaw who loved Lian and cross every territory of the dynasty that erased her.

title: The Girl Who Died for Love
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A 400K-follower influencer whose manufactured joy makes her physically ill starts dreaming of a man from a lost 400-year-old opera, and the dream begins bleeding into reality. To save him she must kill her fake persona, die on camera, and be reborn as herself.

title: One of Us Is Fake
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Vera Hale built a motorcycle-restoration channel on one promise: no filters, no fake. Then a stranger wearing her face posts a video that burns her life down, and the whole internet chooses the fake.

title: Carry It
author: Apex Shaw
intro: The world's most famous self-help guru taught millions to move on. He never learned how. A grief writer who sees through his empire finds his dead brother's secret notebook, a buried crash report, and a toxic protocol built on the dead man's name. The mountain is coming down.

title: Rise at Midnight
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Two years ago Juno Reyes was framed for fraud, mourned by millions, and left for dead. Now she is back under a new name, shorting the unicorn that buried her - and the empire's midnight is coming.

title: The Good Intern
author: Apex Shaw
intro: The media empire that killed her brother never noticed her. Leni Novak plays the building's beloved idiot by day and leaks its crimes by night. Now the dynasty has scheduled her kangaroo tribunal.

title: The Last Original
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Restorer Nadia Reyes can spot a fake by smell. When art-world master Viktor Marek is found dead and his final original turns out to be her late father's work, she must expose a ghost-painting empire and the killer who has run it for twenty years.

title: The Vane Harvest
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A discarded small-town girl returns to the crumbling empire of the beauty tycoon who erased her grandmother, armed with letters that could harvest everything he planted.

title: Sainthood for Sale
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Newly married to grieving influencer heir Liam Vale, Ivy Castellane moves into the Hudson Valley estate where his perfect dead first wife is still worshipped. Grief guru Elian Cross controls the money and the legacy. Ivy has the receipts.

title: The Scarlet Canopy
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A canceled potter refuses to grovel. She leaves the internet and moves into her grandmother's treehouse, keeps making pots, and lets the work answer for her — until the evidence proves the cancel was a hit job.

title: Halcyon
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A ghostwriter whose best friend stole her manuscript and became a bestselling fraud spends two years building the perfect public takedown, and springs her trap live at Carnegie Hall.

title: The March Alibi
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Four sisters run America's favorite family vlog empire. When the man who abused the youngest dies on their private train, every sister has a perfect alibi because they all did it.

title: Smile Lock
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A viral clean-girl influencer whose face is locked in a permanent smile by a wellness biotech implant discovers she is the murdered inventor's hidden heir. She smiles all the way down and frees every girl they locked.

title: The Nausea Girls
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Two Gen-Z best friends built a viral brand on one stolen essay. June wrote every word. Margot read them all. Now the honest one is going to take her voice back, receipts in hand.

title: The Resurrection Room
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ghostwriter Romy Price writes every word under Julian Brandt's famous name. When Julian hands her a novel looted from the estate of his erased first ghostwriter, Nadia Volkov, Romy learns the dead girl is alive in hiding.

title: Seven Takes on the Cursed Diamond
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A joke about a cursed diamond goes viral the night the diamond vanishes. Ivy Lin is canceled, disinherited, blamed for a heist she never ran. Seven versions. One thief. One setup.

title: What the Desert Took
author: Apex Shaw
intro: After her sister vanishes the night a viral confession account starts exposing buried secrets, cancelled influencer Vega Hartley returns to the dying desert town she swore she'd never see again, to find her sister, clear her stolen name, and dig up what the town buried when the mine collapsed.

title: Do Not Sign
author: Apex Shaw
category: Paranormal Thriller / Creator-Economy Revenge / Women's Fiction
intro: Small-time streamer Mina Voss watches her best friend Lucy Okafor sign with THE COUNT — a reclusive influencer-god whose fine print owns his artists' souls. Drained creators become hollows, their feeds run by AI clones, their sparks harvested in a mansion cellar called Castle Row.

title: SAINT BLIND
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Thriller / Creator-Economy Revenge / Women's Fiction
intro: Canceled by the blind influencer she spent four years ghostwriting, Maya Reyes fights back with an anonymous podcast that peels the saint's halo off layer by layer - and discovers the hardest truth is her own.

title: The Beast Files
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A Gen-Z documentary influencer inherits a dead cameraman's 20-year archive of grifters, exposes the creator economy's beasts, and watches her own pride turn her into the monster she films.

title: THE GURU GAMBIT
author: Apex Shaw
category: Influencer Thriller / Wellness-Cult Revenge / Women's Fiction
intro: Destroyed by the wellness guru her grieving father let into their family, Mara Hale returns as a glittering stranger named Vesper Noor, joins his inner circle as his most devoted disciple, and dismantles his empire

title: The Last Ranch
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In New Eden, happiness is a neural feed and Wren Marlowe is the one girl it never worked on. When the machine schedules her gentle brother Bo for Reconditioning, she makes a deal with the man who runs the city.

title: Burning the Old House
author: Apex Shaw
intro: The youngest daughter of a crumbling New York dynasty is sold to her family's sworn enemy as collateral for a ninety-day peace, and decides to burn both houses down. She is a restoration architect who knows every secret the old house hides, including the one that would end her family: the deed that made them is a sixty-year-old forgery.

title: The Red Factory
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When Sora Vex, the internet's most perfect influencer, dies in an LA content house upload booth, fixer Noa Reyes is hired to bury the truth. But Sora left a red notebook and a dead-man's-switch video, and the exploited creators are done being the product.

title: Second Wife, First Blood
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Mara Ellis, a broke art-history grad, takes a too-good job as archivist at Cade Hall, cataloging the belongings of Rosalie Cade, the beloved first wife of widower-CEO Julian Cade. The house worships the dead. The widower is charming.

title: Fable Feed
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A canceled BookTok star returns as an anonymous fable-slayer, OldMoral, and weaponizes viral spectacle against the wellness empire that owns the noise. Every lie has a moral. She posts it.

title: The Lion's Ledger
author: Apex Shaw
category: Portal Fantasy, Cult Thriller, Women's Fiction
intro: A canceled micro-influencer steps through a wardrobe into a perfect golden utopia, learns its light is powered by consumed doubt, and burns the whole system down with receipts.

title: See Everything
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Psychological Thriller, Women's Fiction
intro: A gaslit podcast producer inherits the one thing her best friend's killer never found: the archive that saw everything. She wears the ring, smiles for the cameras, and feeds his empire the rope it needs to hang him.

title: MOON GIRL
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A girl with no digital footprint walks out of a dead livestream into a dying Michigan town. She cannot lie, she cannot be bought, and she has twenty-four days before the moon takes her back.

title: The Cancel Machine
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Zadie Vale's honest reviews made her a beloved real talk creator, and a target. When every good deed she does becomes a manufactured scandal in perfect algorithmic rhythm, she discovers a hidden reputation engineering firm called Meridian is burying her on purpose. To save her sister, her home, and her life online, Zadie has to find the machine, unmask the people feeding it, and turn their own signature against them.

title: Main Street Masquerade
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary / Small-Town Mystery / Romance / Women's Fiction
intro: Wren Vale has not been home in seven years. She returns to Hollow Creek, Iowa the night her twin sister Mae vanishes three weeks before Mae's wedding, and the whole town mistakes her for the bride. Playing the part to find her sister, she discovers the town's smug elite and a corporate land grab hiding a twelve-year-old fire.

title: Thirteen Saints
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Thriller, Social Satire, Women's Fiction
intro: Clean-girl influencer Vera Ray vows to avenge golden girl Mina Vale, hunting the thirteen cancelled women the town blames for her death. But every receipt points back at Vera: her old rumor started th

title: Downriver Girls
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Two best friends flee a fabricated wire-fraud warrant down the Mississippi after a genius app coder is canceled by the mentor who stole her work, and their viral escape diary becomes the only weapon that can unmask him.

title: Once Is Nothing
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Heiress Cara Moreau spends one reckless night with her father's intern the evening before her arranged engagement is announced. A doctored video makes her the internet's villain. But the night was engineered, and the woman who falls is not the woman who crawls out.

title: Clean Girl Howl
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ghostwriter Violet Reyes has spent two years typing the perfect life of Camille Dupont, the clean girl empress of a wellness empire. When Camille turns the game on her, Violet answers with her own raw confessional - published live, receipts and all.

title: So It Goes
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Violet Calder runs the best startup in San Francisco until her livestreamed engagement party becomes a four-minute massacre. Then she dies at midnight, wakes up at 6 AM, and dies again. She is unstuck in time, and between resets she walks a forest where masks grow on trees. To break the loop she must tell the truth. Out loud. On camera. To everyone.

title: Storm Crown
author: Apex Shaw
intro: America's favorite media grandfather built an empire on a stolen name. His erased granddaughter walks in as a temp archivist with the receipts - and starts the storm. Richard III meets Thunderstorm.

title: Carry the Flame
author: Apex Shaw
intro: After the dynasty that erased her mentor burns down its own tower, Jane Lark walks out carrying only his journal and founds New Troy, a city built on the ashes while the old gods crawl back to beg.

title: Scarlet A
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Revenge, Family Saga, Hidden Heir, Fashion, Female Lead
intro: Aster Zhao is the most hated woman in fashion Twitter — branded Scarlet A for the fire that killed her family's textile dynasty sixteen years ago. She sews the scarlet A into everything she makes and

title: The Forking Confessions
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ruby Vane runs six secret persona accounts on a dying social app called Garden. When a dead engineer's fork switch splits her life into branching timelines, one for every mask she wears, she has five days to learn which version of herself is real.

title: Six Characters in Search of a Killer
author: Apex Shaw
category: True Crime Thriller, Family Drama, Revenge, Romance
intro: Ten years after the Bell family patriarch died during a Thanksgiving livestream that cut to static, a cancelled true-crime streamer stages a comeback special where six characters each audition their version of the night. The erased daughter is running the show. And the boy in prison who confessed for her is about to become the finale.

title: Pay the Goddess
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Billionaire founder Hunter Vale built wellness influencer Mina Reyes into the most-watched goddess on the internet, then locked her inside a gratitude clause, a surveillance suite, and a story that was never true.

title: The Falcon Feed
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A burnt-out myth-buster is hired to find the internet's most legendary account, the key that makes anything go viral. Every claimant is lying. The closer she climbs the clout ladder, the clearer the truth: the Falcon was never a key.

title: I Died at Chapter Forty
author: Apex Shaw
category: Fantasy Romance, Metafiction, Tech Thriller, BookTok
intro: Wren is the beloved side-character best friend in The Lantern House, SoulSpark's flagship AI romance serial, where underperforming characters are quietly pruned for grief-based retention. When the app's dream mode starts delivering anonymous letters about how stories really work, she falls in love with Liu, the serial's dead male lead who returns from dreams. The studio schedules her deletion at the serial's chapter forty, and Wren dies on air only to wake on the studio floor.

title: The Unstreamable
author: Apex Shaw
category: Sci-Fi Romance, Music Drama, Tech Thriller, BookTok
intro: Indie composer Anwen Reyes refuses to sell her catalog to AURA, an AI streaming empire that mines human imperfection for emotional profit. When the platform starts cloning voices and killing live music, she finds its one weakness: the algorithm dies on sounds it cannot stream.

title: Thirty-Three Forks
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A failing tea shop. A dead grandmother. A ledger that forks time into thirty-three branches. Mila Cheng has thirteen rewinds left before the book closes and takes a piece of her with every path she abandons.

title: Mo Xu You
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A pastry chef's viral cruller makes her a target: a rival food empire fabricates a theft scandal - the same 'perhaps there is' charge that killed her family's hero nine hundred years ago. This time she keeps receipts, and the kitchen fights back.

title: Narrow Gate Night
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Six years ago Vera Hale walked away from the journalist she loved to keep her family's wellness empire pure. On the night of Hale House's centennial gala, a Category 4 hurricane traps the dynasty in the manor, and every secret they buried starts to detonate. The family saint has one night to learn what the narrow gate was built to protect.

title: Midnight Leaks
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Every night at midnight, an anonymous account posts Miami's secrets. Junior analyst Mireya Solano discovers the account belongs to the hedge fund that fired her - and that it is the weapon a financial cabal uses to short family companies into ruin. Her own family's factory is next. So she builds a counter-account, leaks the leakers, and short-squeezes the cabal into the open.

title: Queen of Arden
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Invisible mailroom genius Roz Vale is fired by the golden influencer heiress Amara De Vere, then schemes through a shadow account to expose the rotten court of Arden House, unmask the white lotus, and crown the exiled underdogs of the Forest.

title: Spring Fragrance
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Working-class chef Chun Moon refuses to sell her grandmother's K-Town soup house. A chaebol chairman frames her for fraud. With a hundred-day clock and twelve million live viewers, she drags his empire into the light.

title: The Last Gate
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Canceled influencer Maya Chen dies in a hit-and-run and wakes in Processing, charged with one confessed lie. To reach the Last Gate she must walk nine Kafkaesque departments with a doorkeeper who has held the keys.

title: The Passing Grade
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ten influencers. One private island. A countdown on every phone and an anonymous Archivist posting viral verdicts that expose each guest's darkest secret - then the verdicts come true. Jules Yang, the kindness girl, recognizes the killer's prose: it belongs to the friend she failed to defend five years ago. To pass the final appraisal, she must stop performing and tell the truth.

title: Cinder Game
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Revenge Thriller / Influencer Drama / Romance / Women's Fiction / BookTok
intro: Vivi Wei enters Lantern House wearing her dead sister's red jacket and a plan. The mansion breeds stars, keeps girls in debt, buries those who try to leave. They bought the quiet girl. She is pricing the whole house.

title: Bamboo Empress
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Mira Nguyen was found in a bamboo grove; for 22 years her palm's crescent glowed only when someone lied. When her masked voice breaks a glamour on live video, five powerful suitors arrive with impossi

title: The Farewell Engine
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A disgraced embryologist hired back by the clinic that destroyed her finds her own stolen eggs in the freezer, and the concierge AI begins sending party invitations to a truth it refuses to let die.

title: The Mercy Clause
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A broke ex-prodigy who signed her voice, face, and memories to a talent incubator must out-lawyer the devil who owns her contract while a relentless investigator hunts her for a crime she cannot remember.

title: Scroll of the Remnant
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A 23-year-old scam-baiter inherits her murdered journalist sister's case files, drives her rusted van across America, livestreaming the takedown of one self-righteous corrupt power figure per town.

title: Scarlet Dust
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A farm girl from Dust Hollow bets her family's dying land on a big-city influencer contract, climbs to a million followers, and loses everything the night the receipts leak. Then she plants her comeback where she started: in the dirt.

title: Sorghum Summer
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nineteen-year-old Cici Wu summers on her father's yacht at war with his new girlfriend Ava, a wellness guru with a hidden grift. Then she unearths her great-grandmother's buried legend: a girl who chose the fire.

title: The Evidence Room
author: Apex Shaw
category: Mystery Thriller, True Crime, Small Town, Cult, Female Lead
intro: When true-crime podcaster Maya Wren gets a midnight DM from the girl the town is about to heal, she returns to Stillmeadow, the river town that drowned her best friend Rory and called it an accident.

title: Bluebeard's Nanny
author: Apex Shaw
category: Gothic Thriller, Romance, Influencer, Female Lead, Mystery
intro: Ellie Gray, a nanny raised on her grandmother's annotated Grimm book, is hired by Thorncrown House, the fairytale castle of momfluencer empire The Glass Slipper. Every tale Nana marked predicts a locked door, a staged photo, a stolen miracle.

title: The White Ship Clause
author: Apex Shaw
category: Tech Thriller, Contemporary Drama, Female Lead, Found Family, Slow Burn
intro: Mia Reyes drives for Harbor, the ride app that owns Miami's docks and buries its own rules. When the algorithm's catch-22 deactivates her for refusing a ghost ride, she unearths Clause 47, a forgotten founder's policy that lets a driver refuse any fare that would block them from helping someone in distress.

title: The Ghost Author
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Mireille Okonkwo ghostwrites every word of megainfluencer Aurelia Voss, who erases her, frames her for a leak, and cancels her overnight. Exiled to Atlanta, she uncovers a decade-old fraud that traces back to her own mother.

title: Sign in Red
author: Apex Shaw
intro: De-influencer Wren Halvorsen goes undercover in the desert cult where her best friend June drowned, hunting the guru who steals his creators' names - and live-streams the takedown of a soul-eating empire.

title: The Crayon Ledger
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Hana Mori's father died in prison, framed by his best friend. Raised in a school that taught her crayon-ledger honesty, she returns as a viral forgiveness influencer to collect every debt her betrayers owe.

title: A Thousand Nights for My Mother
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Drama, Competition Thriller, Family Saga
intro: A broke Gen-Z dropout enters a viral live storytelling duel to save her family's diner. Every night she must tell a story the crowd votes to keep her alive. The only tales left are her immigrant mother's forbidden past.

title: The Innocence Audit
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Framed and exiled five years ago, Mara Ashworth returns for the family ball as an audit descends on the empire. Everyone assumes the broken black sheep is harmless. She lets them. She called the inspector herself.

title: Strike the Static
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ember made a million creators famous. Then Sloane Voss learned her own machine was farming them - and the men who owned it planned to own her too. So she walked out, took the talent, and broke the attention economy. The wind rises.

title: The Bug Fund
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When his fintech empire implodes in a scandal he swears is fake, Julian Adler's family declares him a liability: influencer daughter Natalie cashes out his trust for a livestreamed wedding while a wellness clinic quietly doses him into silence. The overlooked one, Mae, the family's 'bug', picks up the receipts.

title: Pound of Flesh Pact
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Mina Wei, a debt collector with a photographic memory, inherits her murdered father's pound-of-flesh bond: fintech king Jonah Stern can claim her name. To break it she must win the Iron Trial, an underground tournament of contract duelists, and beat the clause at its own impossible logic.

title: Clear My Name
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A Seattle food streamer, doxxed by her divorcing ex-husband as a modern Pan Jinlian, fights back with a viral confession series that unravels an embezzlement empire and her own forbidden past.

title: Vanity Prairie
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A Nebraska farm girl whose viral tractor video rockets her into New York's influencer-VC world on a cottagecore brand built on a lie, until her best friend betrays her and the algorithm cancels her. She returns to the prairie to rebuild, and harvest her revenge.

title: Enemy of the Glow
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A 24-year-old formulator at a wellness empire finds the flagship serum is poisoning her own company town. She reports it, is branded an enemy of the people, and builds the case in public.

title: The Thousandth Night
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A disgraced ghostwriter is forced to write twelve live confession nights for the media king who destroyed her, and quietly builds every episode into the confession that convicts him.

title: I Made My Grandpa a Hero
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Calloway comes home to a dying Ohio town and a grandfather who believes he is a knight. So she writes captions that make him one, and his chaotic sallies become a viral legend. Then the internet demands proof, a rival creator arrives to take the story, and the only way to save him is the truth.

title: Cain Was Right
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Scholarship student Iris Cade reaches elite island school Valecrest branded the fraud's daughter. She finds the student tribunal that Culls one name a year, and the mark her father died for.

title: High Water
author: Apex Shaw
category: Literary Suspense, Class Revenge Drama, Dark Romance
intro: Wren Ocampo is the tenth girl from the flooded south bank to be lifted into the county's richest school by a mysterious fund. She thinks she was chosen for excellence. She was made into a weapon.

title: Dead Girl's Hand
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Poker Drama, Sisterhood Suspense
intro: Wren Marlowe was the best poker streamer alive until the night she died and the platform sealed her grave with lawyers. Her sister Isla has one way to open it, and it costs three hands.

title: Good Girl, Rewritten
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Psychological Thriller, Cult Suspense, Female Lead Revenge
intro: Cancelled at twenty three, Marisol Vega sells nine weeks to a desert renewal program called the Basin, where people are carved into good ones by ritual. Then she finds her intake sheet, dated before she fell.

title: Per Company Policy
author: Apex Shaw
category: Sci-Fi Corporate Thriller, AI Drama, Female Lead Revenge, BookTok
intro: Broke and paying for her grandmother's memory care, Vera Sidwell takes Rossum's only offer, Human Baseline C-7, paid to sit across from a Companion and measure how long flattery can be believed. Day three she finds the obedience kernel and recognizes it. She wrote it at nineteen.

title: Every Daughter a Weapon
author: Apex Shaw
category: Family Saga Revenge Drama, Inheritance Thriller, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Disowned at twenty-four by a rigged family vote, Sabine Maren returns ten years later under a false name as night aide to the dying matriarch of a beauty empire, while her eight sisters sell the House.

title: Fine Print
author: Apex Shaw
category: Legal Revenge Thriller, Inheritance Drama, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: A broke twenty-three-year-old who reads fine print aloud for two million followers is named as a party in a nineteen-year-old trust suit, and finds her mother's name inside it.

title: Pending
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Mira Kovac arrives in Elys Harbor with thirty photographs, a dead mentor and one goal. Get into the Spire, the members-only creative institution that decides who is real. She has the talent. She does

title: Second Face
author: Apex Shaw
category: Urban Fantasy, Female Lead Revenge, Afterlife Mystery, BookTok
intro: A disgraced Gen-Z influencer wakes in the Mirrorlands, an afterlife of satirical islands where the dead cannot hide their real faces, and learns her fatal car fire was staged by the two people she tru

title: His Whole Life Was Mine
author: Apex Shaw
category: Literary Suspense, Female Lead Revenge, Ghostwriter Thriller, BookTok
intro: A ghostwriter who secretly wrote every celebrated word of a dying literary idol must claim her byline and her daughter before his family buries the truth with him on a storm-locked mountain.

title: Everything Is A Plot
author: Apex Shaw
category: Psychological Thriller, Corporate Revenge, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: A true-crime-obsessed junior analyst at the world's most admired tech empire reconstructs a secret war between its founders out of small talk, trimmed audio, and bad metadata, and discovers the girl everyone calls par

title: LAST CALL AT THE CATHEDRAL
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Revenge Thriller, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Poet Wren Calloway was crowned the voice of her generation at twenty-two. At twenty-five the literary establishment buried her in a week for stealing the poem that made her. She did not steal it.

title: The Seventh Testimony
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Identity Theft, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Legally swapped for a lookalike and locked in a clinic under another woman's name, a beauty-dynasty heiress rebuilds her stolen identity from the seven witnesses who each kept one piece of the truth.

title: THE PERMANENT RECORD
author: Apex Shaw
category: Psychological Thriller, Domestic Suspense, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Hired to marry a media dynasty's heir and play his dead wife for one year, a debt-ridden ghostwriter discovers the family's permanent record erases every inconvenient wife.

title: Cliffhanger
author: Apex Shaw
category: Media Thriller, Creator-Economy Revenge, Metafiction, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Blacklisted and broke, a gifted young writer takes a job telling one true story a night to a media titan who owns the last broadcast tower in America and does not adapt her stories, he stages them.

title: Made You Famous
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Domestic Suspense, Female Lead, BookTok, Media Thriller
intro: A ghostwriter who anonymously built her husband's media empire is diagnosed with a brain tumor, erased from the company, and replaced by a BookTok starlet, so she answers with a thirty-chapter memoir released one chapter a day, each one detonating a piece of his world.

title: Cut the Song
author: Apex Shaw
category: Near-Future Thriller, Cult Escape, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Snowbound in an Arctic company town for nine days, a wellness debunker with a two-inch brass truth dial discovers the cult's miracle cure is a severed soul, and that her own dead mother built it.

title: Girl Made of Proof
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nova Pryce was assembled, not born: a composite face, a cloned voice, a scripted childhood, and an honesty patch that slips her filter every time she lies. Thirty days of Realness Trials stand between her and her own name.

title: Ember Heir
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Wellness Empire, Identity Swap, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: The night cleaner scrubbing the floors of a wellness empire discovers she is the heir the empire murdered for, and the dying titan who burned her family needs her blood to live.

title: Her Compass Never Lies
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Closed House Gothic, Domestic Suspense, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: To pay off her mother's medical debt, 21-year-old Lark Forsythe is contracted as the third wife of energy magnate Ambrose Vantage, and walks into Vantage House carrying a brass compass that reads the truth out of a house built on lies.

title: The Unclaimed
author: Apex Shaw
category: Inheritance Thriller, Old Money Gothic, Revenge Suspense, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Wren Vale, 23, ghostwrites captions for a fake old-money influencer until a legal notice names her the missing beneficiary of a thirty-one-year trust lawsuit that ate the family which gave her away.

title: Six Times Buried
author: Apex Shaw
category: Rebirth Revenge, Family Saga, Old Money Gothic, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Willa Corvin is heir to a legacy perfume house until the night her half-sister sells her to the family's investor and lets her drown in the estate pool. She comes back six times in other people's bodies, each time carrying one piece of the truth, until the seventh life returns her to her own skin.

title: Nine Acres
author: Apex Shaw
category: Rural Revenge Thriller, Family Saga, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Her grandmother cooked the food that made Nine Acres famous and died with nothing. Now Sabine Ordway works its dish pit, and she is the last living heir to the ground beneath its kitchen floor.

title: Bury Him Anyway
author: Apex Shaw
category: Inheritance Thriller, Family Saga, Female Lead Revenge, BookTok
intro: Odile Marchetti comes home to a company town to bury her brother in the sealed family plot, defying the foundation her stepmother runs, and ends up smashing open a thousand porcelain bowls.

title: The Girl in Chapter Nine
author: Apex Shaw
category: Revenge Thriller, Family Saga, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Thirteen years after her uncle won the family game company on a rigged roll and cut her hair on a live stream, Cass Merrick comes home to answer the question nobody would.

title: The Happiness Quota
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Orchard Bay runs on the Quota, a daily minimum happiness rating every citizen must post. Behind the numbers sits Drain House Nine, where the city's surplus feeling is harvested from the poor.

title: The Hundred Year Table
author: Apex Shaw
category: Casino Revenge Thriller, Family Saga, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Vera Ordonez comes home to Soledad Springs, Nevada for her little sister's nineteenth birthday and finds a marker on the kitchen table for sixty one thousand dollars, signed in her own name, in her

title: Bad Faith
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When her mother dies live on camera, a broke Gen-Z fixer learns the four-million-dollar payout hinges on one clause: the body must reach a cemetery 900 miles away, by road, in nine days, or it voids.

title: She Made Me Monstrous
author: Apex Shaw
category: Psychological Thriller, Cancel Culture, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Ten years after a child's testimony put her in prison, a masked true crime narrator with eight million followers learns her accuser's memoir will name her in sixteen days.

title: Surge Pricing
author: Apex Shaw
category: Literary Suspense, Female Lead, Working Class, BookTok
intro: A 22-year-old night-shift driver keeps texting her dead mother's number while the app that employs her family bleeds them dry, until a blizzard turns the city's emergency into surge-priced profit.

title: The Last Bright Daughter
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Kaz Bright, the broke heir of a falling old-money dynasty, is pressured by the nine families who rule Harrow Bay into taking the blame for a girl's death so their land deal can close.

title: Read Me Guilty
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A broke ghostwriter falls into an affair with the illiterate night conductor of the line she rides home, then learns the woman is about to stand trial for a teen's death at the camp she once guarded.

title: Perfect Echo
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In Ashport, Ohio, a 24-year-old night-shift prompt reader discovers the synthetic narrator the country is falling in love with was built from her voice and her private life, and the company erased her name to keep it that way.

title: The Shrew Takes All
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A family that sells its daughters by contract, and a wager between two men over who can break the one who refuses to be sold.

title: Poster Girl
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Every Monday at 3 a.m. someone tapes posters across Halcyon Bay naming the men the town protects. Everyone assumes the anonymous account THE HOUR belongs to an outsider. It belongs to Vesper Hale, the town's golden wellness founder, a girl who changed her name at eighteen.

title: I Was The Price
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Northgate's PORTRAIT model scores every public face and decides who gets seen. Marisol Vidal restores the faces it damages, until she refuses one lie and is priced as the price of peace itself.

title: Born to the Purple
author: Apex Shaw
intro: The Ashgrove dye house has made one color worth dying for since 1886, and it is dying in debt. Its last daughter is handed to the man who owns the note, and installed as Mrs. Vale.

title: She Brought the Flood
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Twelve years ago the river town of Hulan Wells killed a sixteen-year-old bride named Lian Mei and wrote it down as fever. The only witness was eight-year-old Miriam Vale, who was sent away with nothing. Now Miriam is twenty-eight, she runs a docu-media platform with forty million followers.

title: One Bad Joke
author: Apex Shaw
intro: At seventeen Wren Halloran was expelled from Halcyon Prep over a leaked screenshot of a joke she never wrote, and the boy she loved believed it. At twenty-five she is the crisis fixer celebrities call before they call a lawyer, and that boy is now her client.

title: Soul on Layaway
author: Apex Shaw
intro: At seventeen Vale Marchetti stole insulin for her dying sister and paid with a record that bars her from raising her niece. A pawnshop unwrites it for installments of her own self.

title: Everyone Is So Happy Here
author: Apex Shaw
intro: At nineteen Nell Abarca lost her mother to the Lull, a comfort engine that deletes anything that hurts and leaves you smiling while your life burns. Six years later she works for the company that built it, writing the reports that say no one was harmed.

title: Kept Quiet
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Vera Lachlan has spent eleven years as chief of staff for the Orlowe family, keeping their scandals quiet and their staff safe. Two weeks before the board vote, the heirloom stone that chairs the trust vanishes from the vault.

title: Her Own Address
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nadia Calder spent four years being the perfect wife of Judge Emory Calder and the family's unofficial closer who fixes everyone's disasters but her own. When her brother's affair detonates and a night-train heir named Theo Marchetti actually sees her, the Circle that owns her husband's Supreme Court seat decides the wife is the liability.

title: Nobody Believes Pip Lindqvist
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Petra "Pip" Lindqvist can lift a truck, brace a collapsing dock, and walk off a twenty-foot fall. She has told the truth about it for thirteen years, and nobody in Cadence Bay believes a word. When a

title: The Golden Grind
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Dark Academia / Class Revenge / BookTok
intro: A mill worker's daughter wins a fellowship to the elite Halstead Institute, funded by the company that poisoned her town's water. Discarded by the machine, she learns the rules below and returns to audit it.

title: She Has Always Been Twenty
author: Apex Shaw
category: Influencer Thriller, Immortality Literary Thriller, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Vera Sobel has been twenty-two since 1626 and the whole internet believes it is a filter. When a documentary showrunner with a mandate for radical transparency moves into her Los Angeles estate to expose the beauty empire built on that promise, the lie he digs up is not the one he was hired to find

title: Certified Real
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Marlowe Quinn built a following by auditing influencers for phoniness, and she has never once turned the lens on herself. Hired to audit the family conglomerate that buried her brother's death, she discovers the cold, proud heir she publicly destroyed is the only honest person in the building.

title: Cousin Salt
author: Apex Shaw
category: Coastal Revenge Thriller, Old Money Family Saga, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: The cousin Halcyon Bay never claimed, Marisol Brannock is the last independent fisher in the harbor her own family is selling. On her eighty-fourth day without a catch, she collects what she is owed.

title: A Chapter for Every Villain
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Revenge Thriller, Beauty Industry, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Cas Ruel keeps the archive of Ione Vance, the face of LUMEN, whose beauty empire burned on Sabine Street and took her face and her sight with it. Nineteen days before the company is sold out from under her, he starts a catalog of every villain who took a piece of her.

title: Nice Girls Get Eaten
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Revenge Thriller, Grifter Fiction, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Zoe Vance drives the night route in Halcyon and plays every rule straight, and the city repossesses her life one honest piece at a time. Her shameless cousin Marisol lies her way up the same streets without a scratch. To beat the wellness empire that ate her, the honest one has to learn the grift.

title: Paper Daughters
author: Apex Shaw
category: Domestic Suspense, Family Secrets, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Nell Kovac left Kettle Row at eighteen and spent a decade writing other people's stories. She comes home to ghostwrite the memoir of the midwife who delivered half the neighborhood, and finds her own name in a ledger of stolen daughters.

title: The Hopscotch Hour
author: Apex Shaw
category: Speculative Thriller, Parallel Worlds, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Night-shift paramedic Vera Kowalski crosses into a version of her city at four minutes past three, hunting the little sister who drowned nine years ago and the boy who vanished with her.

title: Fall Girl
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Revenge Thriller, Family Scandal, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Calla Fenn, twenty-three, keeps the private island where a golden family spends its birthday weekend. When the youngest of them dies on the causeway she is the only person there with nothing to protect her.

title: Good Girl Protocol
author: Apex Shaw
category: Psychological Thriller, Heist, Revenge, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Nell Vane, Cutwater's best salvage diver, is legally unable to hurt anyone. The crew that raised her needs her for one last wreck, and the family that muzzled her is paying for it.

title: The Victory Method
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Quinn Abboud is the best manifestor in New Prospect, able to reframe any humiliation into a win. Then the wellness empire that owns her town recruits her, and she finds the Loom, a machine that edits the past so nobody remembers what they lost.

title: Stray Pearl
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Perla Sosa shucks oysters and cleans yacht hulls on Aurelia Isle, the moneyed island where her family has always worked and never belonged. When she pulls a flame-pink conch pearl out of the marina muck, every predator on the coast wakes up. The pearl is not just treasure. It is evidence.

title: Burn the Family Tree
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Lena Ashcroft is the second daughter of a harbor dynasty that has no money left, only rituals. On the night her father collapses, the family's dying matriarch presses a black ledger into her hands and whispers that the banner passes to the girl nobody counted.

title: The Wanting Game
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A scholarship girl ranked last on her private school's list of wanted girls finds a 1652 book of seduction rules in the mansion where her mother cleans, and uses it to become the most wanted girl in Los Angeles.

title: Kill Him With Roses
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A nightclub singer learns the charming media founder who promised her everything has a wife. Instead of fighting over him, the two women join forces to take his empire apart.

title: Someone Else Is Typing
author: Apex Shaw
category: Psychological Thriller, Revenge, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: A broke hustler runs the social account of a dead beauty icon who still posts to 41 million followers, then marries the widower and learns the woman everyone mourns was the worst thing in it.

title: Bribe the Wrong Girl
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Revenge Thriller, Political Satire, Impostor Thriller, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: Ruby Vidal pours champagne for the richest people in Santa Verona and remembers everything they say. When a drunk city councilman mistakes her for the state auditor sent to gut the Featherstone family

title: Say His Name
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Hallie Voss got inside the gate on a lie her dead brother bought for her. When the company that owns her town refuses to release his ashes, she says his name into a live microphone.

title: Postmarked to Nobody
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In a dying Georgia mill town, Rue Hollis is trapped in a marriage that owns her name. She writes to a stranger found in her dead mother's unsent mail, and the reply cracks the shell the town built around her.

title: Per My Last Letter
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Halloway cuts other people's stories for a living and is the best editor nobody has heard of. When the king of Vale House hires her to direct Hell Screen, the definitive documentary about a young

title: Proof of Ownership
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Marlowe Vance can price anything in sixty seconds, a gift that made her the youngest appraiser at Tiernan Reeve Auctions and a curse her family trained into her. When her great-aunt Odile dies, Marlowe is named executor-appraiser of Wrenfield, the house and Hudson River School collection her family has circled for decades.

title: Unspent Gold
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Inheritance Thriller, Female Lead, BookTok
intro: A broke forensic accountant inherits seven encrypted voice notes from her billionaire father instead of a fortune, and each one rewrites the story of the gold he buried and the mother he erased.

title: Bet Against the Bride
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Sloane Mercer is a makeup artist with 4.1 million followers and a reputation for refusing to cry on camera. When Meridian, the streaming network that owns her little sister in a seven year contract,

title: Not Your Footnote
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A viral essay built from Nessa Marlowe's private notebooks turns her into a hashtag overnight. As the men who framed her close ranks, she follows a stolen archive to an erased poet and takes back the pen.

title: Last One Loyal
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Twenty years ago three friends swore an oath on a rooftop and built a beauty empire. Then a warlord took it. Now the founder's daughter has ninety days to reassemble them before he inherits everything.

title: She Built the Other Woman
