author: Apex Shaw
intro: Mira Halloran invented the residue, the kernel that makes every Aurel machine an individual. Her husband Julian took the credit and the company, then replaced her with an influencer.

title: You Should Be Grateful
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A broke niece taken in as unpaid help by the family that quietly erased her mother discovers the older poor cousin who has spent thirty-one years counting every dollar the Rylands stole.

title: Every Word Was Mine
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A ghostwriter named Nell Faraday has eleven weeks of health left and nine years of erased authorship behind her. She sets out to prove that every book the famous novelist Julian Vale published was written by her, before his memoir launches and makes the lie permanent.

title: Marry the House
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nell Corvi catalogs other people's houses for a living, until she is hired to inventory Wyrmwood Hall, the estate of the Meridian empire, built on the worship of a dead woman. Inside its sealed archive she finds her own mother's name on a list of forty-seven women the founder bought and discarded. To clear her mother's name she marries the heir and becomes Bride of the House, and learns the vow that binds her was invented to hide a murder.

title: Kill Your Darlings
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A broke literary assistant finds a manuscript-prediction AI that writes the future, and starts editing her rivals out of the story, until she learns she is a character in someone else's book.

title: Unsolicited Advice
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Eight years ago her mentor and her father talked Maren Sloane out of Julian Ash. Now he is the biggest novelist in the country, and his new book is their love story with someone else's name on the cover.

title: Scarlet Receipts
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Noa Whittaker was the first success story of the Vale Method until Adrian Vale put a scarlet A on her chest and streamed it to four million people. Three hundred and eighty days later she comes home with a healed heart, an anonymous account called Scarlet Receipts, and a folder of evidence nobody has ever seen.

title: The Good Witch
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When a toxic haze buries her Kansas town, Dot Gale is bused to Emerald, a desert wellness empire run by the radiant Good Witch, Glinda Vance. Under the green lenses, nothing is what it looks like.

title: He Stole the Moon
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nell Marchetti, 24, lands a prep-assistant job at the Vesper Museum on the eve of the biggest art retrospective of the decade, honoring the reclusive genius Ambrose Kell.

title: Queen of the Bonfire
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Broke storyteller Mars Quinn wins a wildcard spot at a phone-free influencer residency on Hollow Cay, then has to survive the feral court that crowns the wrong queen when the retreat collapses.

title: Nobody Drowns Here
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ines Marlow takes a three-month water survey on Kell Island, the company town where her mother drowned six years ago. The wells are poisoned and the founder in the wheelchair may not be who he says he is.

title: The Half She Buried
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nell Vale, 26, was the public face of her mother's wellness empire and never knew it had a second face. Fourteen months after Vivienne Vale dies, the estate is still frozen by Vale v. Vale, a nine-year lawsuit that has eaten forty-one million dollars, and the partner who runs it unveils an AI replica of her mother to sign whatever he wants. Then a night-shift hospital tech named June Alcott shows up at the gate with the second key.

title: Own Blood
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Marisol Vance, 23, is the bay-side girl who walked into Cliff House to film the golden family's wedding and walked out blamed for the golden son's death. To clear her name she digs into the forty minutes the security cameras lost on Bonfire Night, and every clue loops back to her own blood.

title: They Buried Me as Her
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A river-town ferry girl is declared drowned and buried under a dead heiress's name while she wakes locked in a private rest home registered as that dead woman. To get her own name back she has to prove, in front of the whole town, which girl is really in the grave.

title: Say Amen Louder
author: Apex Shaw
intro: The daughter who runs the camera at her father's eight-thousand-member megachurch finds the second ledger, the one that proves the ministry and the family name were built on a girl who died in a fire in Lagos.

title: House Rules for Wolves
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nineteen-year-old Nell has spent her whole life as the youngest daughter of Elmswood, the Ridgely estate on Heron Bluff, while the woman who really raised her works the back stairs as the housekeeper. The night the family pins $2.4 million of charity fraud on her and walks her across the causeway with one bag, she stops being the girl in the house.

title: Everyone Belongs to Everyone
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In Halcyon Fields, the world's first engineered happiness city, no one is sad, no one is alone, and no one remembers their mother. Mara Osei was raised outside the walls, in the Mud.

title: Quiet Title
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Ashcombe inherits her aunt's failing coastal vineyard on Gull Point, plus its debts, its cellarmaster and a locked upstairs room nobody has opened in forty years. Three men circle the property before the will is even read, and the room holds a ledger of every woman whose hands built Ashcombe.

title: Everyone Here Deserves It
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nell Rydell talks her way onto Vesper Island for the anniversary session of Stillpoint, the retreat where her sister June drowned fourteen months ago. Ten guests, one locked island, and a voice that knows what each of them did. Nobody checks out.

title: Cut Direct
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A soft-voiced stranger with a silver dollar starts collecting on a ten-year-old cover-up, and the overlooked woman who writes the islands society column holds the only record of what really happened the night the boathouse burned.

title: The Responsible Party
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Calloway is the fixer at Halcyon Health, a Los Angeles concierge clinic whose compliance manual makes whoever reports an adverse event the responsible party. When a nineteen-year-old influencer dies on her watch, Wren must choose between one more polished lie and using the clinic's own rules to break it open.

title: For the Record
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Vera Hollis is the flawless wife of San Verano's golden dynasty and the family's unpaid fixer, the woman who buries every scandal before it surfaces. She also keeps a private archive she calls the Record, and when the Vaughns need a scapegoat to save Adrian's Senate run they hand the federal investigators the one crime she truly committed, for love.

title: Water Always Wins
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A young textile conservator marries into a legendary American beauty dynasty and discovers that every room is ruled by the memory of the dead first wife, an icon whose perfect image was stitched together from lies.

title: Walking on Knives
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A small-town singer trades her voice, her name and her songs to marry the heir who owns the town, and finds that his family's lakeside wellness ranch cures the girls who will not obey. Declared dead in a staged accident, she comes back to take every word of it back.

title: Burn Rate
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ren Calloway built Hearth, a home for first-generation women founders. One anonymous file burns it down in a single night, and the arsonist is the friend she loves most.

title: The Noble Lie
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Sabine Rook is the fastest content burner on Lumen's Integrity Desk, paid to delete what the platform calls dangerous. When a purge list carries her dead mother's name, she finds an archive hidden under a shuttered library and learns the story her employer tells about the night four people died is a lie she helped keep.

title: No Encores
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Mara Voss, nineteen, wins the last slot at The Cadence, the most-watched piano fellowship in the world. The rankings are not about music. The scores measure how breakable a girl is.

title: Last Seen Online
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A grief-tech engineer secretly resurrects her dead influencer sister from her digital traces, and the revenant starts naming everyone who let her burn, one name at a time.

title: Never Kiss the Ring
author: Apex Shaw
intro: After the Vale family patriarch dies, the granddaughter no one acknowledged is offered a deal she cannot refuse: sign away her dead mother's claim, run the family foundation, and never ask about the locked room on the third floor. Nedra Vale refuses to kneel.

title: She Didn't Cry
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Raised by the founder of Ferris House, Vera Sloane never learned to cry on cue. When Constance Ferris falls from the Wrenmoor cliff path, a clipped video of Vera laughing goes viral, and a town decides her coldness is proof of murder.

title: Rewrite the Girl
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A cancelled wellness influencer hires a ghostwriter to pin her scandal on a scapegoated junior publicist, but the people inside the book start refusing the script and fighting for their own true story.

title: All Her Gold Was Fake
author: Apex Shaw
intro: She returns to the island that ran her mother off in disgrace, hired to serve the wedding of the dynasty that ruined her. Their sacred heirloom is a forgery, and the island lives on the lie.

title: Bitter Bloom
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Four years after the fire that killed her grandmother, a young botanist reopens the legendary walled garden and invites the six wellness moguls who stole her work and let her die to a retreat.

title: The Understudy
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A Chicago dance company calls itself a family, then blames the girl who covers every role for a scandal she did not create. Cast out, she returns home to build a company that takes the stage.

title: Every Body She Wore
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Her partner pushed her off a ledge and took the company they built together. Vera Ellison refuses to stay dead. Six times she wakes inside the girls Meridian owns, climbing the same ladder to the top.

title: Everything Gold Must Burn
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A stuttering night cleaner inside the world's most worshipped beauty empire discovers its flawless golden glow is powered by draining the lives of the girls who feed it, and decides to burn it all down.

title: Die Again, Babe
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A ghostwriter dies at midnight at the launch of the memoir she secretly wrote, then wakes at six p.m. to the same party and the same smile. A broker offers her fifty nights to find her killer, if she signs away one memory a night.

title: My Mother Waited Here
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Framed at twenty-two and buried alive in a twenty-two year sentence, Ilse Vance returns eleven years later under a stranger's name to dismantle the three people who took her life, only to learn the mother who kept a vigil at the same park gate died waiting for her.

title: Disciple of Nothing
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A grieving sound engineer infiltrates the wellness empire that is draining her family dry, and learns that to beat a master she has to become one. Tartuffe meets the Book of Five Rings.

title: Write Me Innocent
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A young ghostwriter is hired to write the official book about her town's most famous fire and discovers the woman everyone blames for it cannot read the confession she signed.

title: Paper Grave
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A young woman the town declared dead two years ago returns under a false name as the auditor hired by the family that buried her, to collect the seven signatures on the deed that became her grave.

title: Made to Expire
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A broke 24-year-old is recruited into an elite bloom program that amplifies her mind and charisma, only to discover every graduate is engineered to rot on a fixed date.

title: Sick by Design
author: Apex Shaw
category: Contemporary Revenge Thriller, Wellness Industry, Female Lead
intro: Maren Calloway spent fourteen years as patient zero of the Calloway Protocol, the wellness empire her family built on her mystery illness. When she finds the file proving she was never sick, she comes home to dismantle them.

title: All the World's a Hostile Takeover
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Four years after her family exiled her for a crime she did not commit, Vesper Hale returns under a false name to the fund dismantling her father's empire. Ten weeks, one forged ledger, and a plan that turns everyone in the room into a player in an ending she wrote.

title: Sold to the Highest Liar
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Exiled for telling the truth, Wren returns to the Aldridge art dynasty to find a dead restorer, a forty-million-dollar forgery, and a family of copies. She will sell the truth to the highest liar.

title: Nobody Left to Ask
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When her estranged mother dies and leaves a water-ruined letter naming a town that is not on any map, a broke documentary creator drives into a dead company town to film the story that saves her career.

title: Empathy Test
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Vesper Kade wrote the Authenticity Index when she was seventeen, then the fire took her face, her name, and her credit. Seven years later she keeps the engine alive unseen from Floor B

title: The Painted Bride
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Willa Vance is the face of the House of Vance, the last boutique luxury house still standing, until a tech and media empire called the Talos Group moves to absorb it and her own uncle signs a peace deal that includes her.

title: Raised by the Murderer
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Eleanor Crane runs the Roseworks, the lab where her dying father's beauty empire distills its signature scent. Then her housekeeper confesses the truth: the man Eleanor calls Father ordered the fire that killed the Voss family, and the baby in the crib that night was never Verity Voss.

title: Every Lie Has a Sound
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In Halcyon City every person walks beside a kin, the animal shape of their soul. Mara Vance's fox hears lies like a struck bell, and her little brother is scheduled for the Quieting. She has thirty-one days to break the dynasty that silences the city's children.

title: Report Me Dead
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Framed by a forged video at her collective's five-year gala, Mara Voss is cast out and left for dead. She chooses to stay dead, takes a name off a headstone, and comes back to burn the lie down.

title: Tame Me If You Can
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Declared dead by the man who owned her star, Ines Calloway has nine days and one stolen car to drive west, reach the ledger that holds eighty-one names, and take her little sister back from the house that made her.

title: The Wounded Are Worth More
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A mill town hollowed by injury and debt. A wellness company that prices every wound and buys every story forever. Tally Meek reads the fine print and turns its own ledger against it, live.

title: Borrowed Sunlight
author: Apex Shaw
intro: For thirteen years Mara Voss was the invisible machine behind Del Archer's wellness empire, forging, scrubbing and burying everything Del needed buried, including the death of a girl in a farm pond. Now Mara confesses all of it to the dead girl's brother, because the confession is the last machine she will ever build and it ends at Del.

title: The Founder's Wife
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Orphaned and broke, Wren Aldridge takes a live-in tutoring job inside Meridian, a utopian town built on total transparency. There she finds the founder's erased wife locked in the east wing.

title: Never Touched the Ground
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In a broke Ohio mill town where the last employer buys human blood and owns nearly every debt, the girl who climbed the rooftops at twelve and never came down returns to make the company pay for every body it ever drew.

title: The Sea Keeps Receipts
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Tern Island has belonged to the Aldridge family since 1911. On the morning a jury convicts her father for a fire he did not set, Nessa Aldridge loses the boatyard, the oyster beds and the island itself to the man who framed him.

title: Before It Wears Off
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Cady Hollow has called Wren Stallard slow since she was eleven. She is not slow. Sundial Neurotechnics pays cash for baseline subjects from the poorest county in Pennsylvania, and Wren signs for the money her grandmother's lungs need.

title: No Record of Her
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Willa Brannock does not exist. Erased from Halstead's Registry at seven, she mends other people's ruined records until the family that stole her name hires her to rebuild the file that buries her claim.

title: Rule Twenty-Two
author: Apex Shaw
intro: After her brother is ruled a suicide, forensic auditor Ava Merritt returns to the company town that raised her and finds the Mutual employee rulebook has a clause for everything, including Rule Twenty-Two.

title: A Sonata for Liars
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Raised as charity inside the family that killed her mother, a hidden piano prodigy waits twenty years for the one performance that strips the Devereux name off everything they stole.

title: Dead Girl Algorithm
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Teenage ward of the state Delia Marek is remade into a megabrand by Aurelia Group, which buys the perpetual rights to a girl's name, face and voice. When she demands her likeness back, the machine kills her off.

title: Say My Brother's Name
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Calloway's twin brother vanished into the Havenwood Fellowship, a sealed mountain residency that promises to make gifted young people famous. When an invitation arrives in his name, Wren cuts her hair, lowers her voice, and walks through the gate wearing his face.

title: Nobody Works for Free
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Calloway wrote the algorithm that made a tech emperor a billionaire, and he took her name off it. Blacklisted and broke, she sends one email to every woman he used and discarded.

title: The Kindest Cut
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nell Ashgrove was raised on Bellwether Island to give her body away and told it was a gift. Betrayed by her best friend, she survives the knife and returns with the ledger of every harvest.

title: Marginalia
author: Apex Shaw
intro: For nine years Vera Halloway wrote every book published under her husband's name. Now she is dying of the poisoned water that killed her mother, and the family wants her declared incompetent.

title: My Sister's Collateral
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Delia Calloway signed her sister Merritt over as collateral on the family debt to keep her marriage into the Keating food empire. In Harrow Works debt is inherited, and Merritt finds the ledger that proves it is slavery with paperwork.

title: He Bought My City
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Thirteen years after Vera Lindqvist left him for the man who could give her the city, Cole Rennick comes back and buys every street that made her. He thinks he is erasing her. She kept receipts.

title: Struck From the Record
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Marlowe Sawyer is the daughter Augustine Sutter erased from his company, his family and his record. She has spent five years as an invisible archivist inside his tower, and when a legacy audit and a confirmation vote force the family to bury its past again, she starts keeping copies.

title: Hold Still
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Kovac paints murals for four hundred dollars. When painter Adrian Sorel makes her his final subject, a foundation comes to own every image of her, and her mother waits under her own portrait.

title: Ruthless as Silk
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Thirteen years ago Anya Quan confessed to a forgery she did not commit and was exiled from her family's legendary jade house. Now she is back, quiet and underestimated, hiding the hands that carved the house's greatest masterpiece, while the men who sold her out prepare to sell it twice.

title: We All Voted for Him
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Framed at nineteen for a factory fire that killed eleven, Nora Ellery served eleven years and came home as someone else. Now a quiet fortune and a hidden audit are all she needs to take apart the beloved mayor the whole town voted for.

title: His Best Work
author: Apex Shaw
intro: At seventeen, Wren Alcott was discovered by the great American novelist Aldous Reyes and installed at Cedar House, his cliffside estate, as his muse and amanuensis. The novel he wrote about her made them both famous and left her ruined.

title: Every Door She Locked
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nina Ashgrove has sixty-three days to marry the man her family chose or lose everything. Then she finds the deed that proves the estate was built by locking a girl in gold.

title: Nobody Sent Me
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A grief-stricken sister returns to the river town that blamed her brother for a deadly fire, and is mistaken for the state examiner sent to audit the family empire that buried the truth.

title: Watch Me Come Home
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Eleven years after her father drowned in his own pool the night he came home, Nell Ashgrove drives back into Cordova, Kentucky, where the stepmother who killed him is about to be honored at the anniversary gala.

title: What the Help Knows
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nessa Quill grew up invisible in the servant wing of Ashgrove, the Alderbrook family's coastal Maine estate. When the empire collapses and the matriarch dies, the keeper of the house is the daughter they never looked at.

title: The Jane Doe Clause
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Mara Sandoval works the night shift in the county morgue's unclaimed-remains unit, where the dead are filed by number and forgotten. When a body tagged with her dead sister's name fails its dental match, Mara finds a records room where nameless bodies are renamed and a name is a thing that can be bought.

title: Dead Women Tell
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Junie Barlowe, 29, an audio archivist from Portland, returns to Marrow, Oregon, the company town the Voss family built, to settle her mother Rue's estate. Rue was the woman the beloved founder Harlan Voss loved, ruined, and erased.

title: They Kept Score
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Vee Lark reinvented herself into a Manhattan It girl, then found out her ruination was a private game played since 1974, one girl every season, bound into blue leather books. She has the receipts.

title: Possession Order
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Calla Pryce was seventeen when the Pryce Foundation declared her possessed and locked her in Rockhaven for the sake of the family fortune. Five years and four months later she is home on a transitional release, quiet, compliant, and counting down the seventy days until the hearing that decides whether the guardianship over her and her mother's four hundred and twelve million dollars becomes permanent.

title: The Sixth Player
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Four years ago five men took Thea Bramwell's company in a rigged shareholder vote and left her with nothing. She came back with a different name, a red order book, and a plan to sit in every one of their chairs.

title: She Was Never There
author: Apex Shaw
intro: At nineteen, Lula Mae Vance walked into the most photographed party in New York and let a private circle turn her into Billie Vane, its borrowed muse. At twenty she went to prison for a forty million dollar art fraud she never committed.

title: Our Lady of Bad Luck
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ten years ago a fire killed three people in a dying Ohio town, and everyone needed someone to blame. They blamed the eighteen year old girl with the keys.

title: She Kept the Negatives
author: Apex Shaw
intro: For seventeen years Calla Deane has run the studio and the negative vault of Julian Sayer, the most celebrated photographer alive. She has kept every negative he threw away and a notebook with eighty-one names, and her sister is on that list.

title: Every Lantern but Hers
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nora Calloway, 24, takes a job cataloging the dying Ashcroft family's papers at Bellhaven, the Hudson Valley manor whose orchard built their name. Four women circle the paralyzed patriarch and the lam

title: Paradise Unpaid
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A grieving audio documentarian checks into a celebrated island community to learn how her younger sister really died there and finds that every kindness there is a debt and every debt is collected in full.

title: Burn the Hero
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Hale was seventeen when the Vance Cannery burned and six died. The town blamed her and the boy she loved. Seventeen years later she finds proof the beloved hero set the fire.

title: Saltwater Alibi
author: Apex Shaw
intro: On Gannet Island, a summer girl's half-remembered accusation destroys a local deckhand. The only witness who can save him is the girl who was secretly with him in the sea cave that night. She will have to give up her family's name to say so.

title: Nothing Goes to Waste
author: Apex Shaw
intro: On the wall of the flagship restaurant, one hundred and sixty-three fellows smile in numbered frames. Forty-one of them left without notice and were never written down again. Dell Sarno signed her name away at twenty-one for a place in those kitchens; twelve years later she returns as the court-appointed monitor of the same empire, where a dead woman is still cooking and the family motto is Nothing Goes to Waste.

title: She Took My Name
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In Halstead a person's life is a licensed record that can be bought, merged and amended. Wren Salter keeps the paper the machines never touched, and her mother's death record now names the city's beloved philanthropist Iris Merrick as the daughter.

title: The Right Name
author: Apex Shaw
intro: The Holloway family built a wellness empire on one book of maxims that the beloved matriarch never wrote. Cora Holloway has spent nine years cataloguing that lie in the basement archive of the family that raised her as a ward and worked her as a servant.

title: Eighty Days of Lies
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A disgraced founder's daughter works the eighty day global roadshow of the man who framed her father, carrying a false name, a dead man's badge, and one chance to restore his name before the company goes public.

title: Cold Open
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A joke she texted her best friend became the evidence that convicted her. Now the three promises she made at sentencing are coming true, and the town that buried her watches her dead account post.

title: The Annotator
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ten years after her brilliant best friend drowned, Nell Vance became the most beloved literary voice in America by annotating the dead woman's one unfinished masterpiece. Then a new annotation appears in her dead friend's handwriting.

title: Piecework
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Cress Ayala has run Sorrel Apparel's company town for six years, keeping its beloved slow-fashion brand clean on paper. Then the brand sends an examiner to manufacture confessions from the migrant women who cut and sew every stitch.

title: Her Own Hand
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Vesper Hall's entire order rests on one sacred thing, and one dead man's name is on all of it. Sena Ito is the scribe who keeps the minutes, and the only person on the island who keeps a second copy of everything.

title: The Letter He Read Aloud
author: Apex Shaw
intro: At seventeen Odile March sent composer Bastian Rook a letter meant for no one else. He read it aloud to a laughing room and it ended her. Twelve years later the whole circle washes ashore on the island she owns.

title: She Never Signed
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Mercy is a mill town that Calder money built, and Calder House has ruined every family that owned it. When the housekeeper's daughter refuses to sell and refuses to sign, the new king of Mercy jails her.

title: Eat What You Kill
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Aster House is the only restaurant in the valley that matters, and its chef tells his cooks that a great kitchen eats its young. Eight months ago a line cook died in its walk-in.

title: I Knew Him Best
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A woman returns to the coastal town that ruined her mother, takes a job cataloging the founding family's private archive, and narrates the autumn she dismantled them.

title: Errata
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Romy Castellan has spent six years cataloguing the Atlas Society's sacred hand-drawn book, and one afternoon she finds her own family name hiding in a dead man's ledger.

title: Everyone Called Me Simple
author: Apex Shaw
intro: For twenty years the Ashgrove family has been America's most beloved dynasty, and June, the daughter they call simple, has quietly written all of it. Now the empire needs one more scapegoat.

title: The Gold Collar
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Declared drowned in her family pond in 2019, Maren Calder returns seven years later as the hired archivist to the gilded Maine house that sold her, to take back the daughter they raised as their own and break the gold that locked them all in.

title: Written in Silk
author: Apex Shaw
intro: For five years Charlie Ames wrote every word of the legend that keeps Hollow Creek's founder beloved, signing none of it. When the town votes to sacrifice her best friend, she writes the truth.

title: Everyone's Type
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Every citizen of the glass-walled Concord wears a public Rating, and desire is rationed by the state. Delisted three years ago from the top of the Catalog, Una Vey returns carrying the one ledger the Directorate cannot survive.

title: Take It With Salt
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Twenty years after the Long Winter strike, Brindleport is about to crown Silas Rourke as its hero on Freedom Day. Wren Calloway knows he is the informer who had her sister killed.

title: Read Him Like a Manual
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Mara Quinn ghostwrote the dating manual that turned a generation of men into con artists, and the company selling it stole her name. Now the women who got hurt bring her their cases, one man at a time, and she takes the whole academy down from the inside.

title: He Named It After Her
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Emeric Verel bottles the essence of a person at the moment they are most alive, one fragrance for every woman he takes it from. The world calls it art. Nell knows it is theft.

title: Made to Smile
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A woman whose face was permanently set into a beauty empire's signature smile returns as the house's hired restoration artist to prove it stole the method from her own grandmother.

title: Every Teller Lies
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A story editor arrives at a desert writers retreat to build season three of the most celebrated audio drama in America, and finds her dead mother's unpublished manuscript under the showrunner's annotations.

title: Good as Real
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Fourteen years after the auction house had her mother jailed for a counterfeiting ring she never ran, a master authenticator returns under a forged name to plant one impossible fake in the house's own Guarantee Sale.

title: Everyone Believed Him
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In 2018 a leaked audio confession and forged messages framed eighteen-year-old lyricist Meridian Voss as a thief, and the internet destroyed her. Eight years later a podcast reopens the case, but Meri never drowned. She is alive in Lisbon under a new name, writing anonymous songs that climb the charts she was erased from, and she has kept every receipt.

title: Sisters of the Fen
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In 2019 the Hoyt family opened a flood gate to save their mill and the lower town of Cressmoor drowned. Cala Weir began a ledger of everyone the family ruined. Six years later it holds one hundred and eight names.

title: The Same Crime
author: Apex Shaw
intro: She gave up her camera to marry the man who owns the city's trains. One night the aide she loved ruined her and was applauded. Two years on she returns to prove one crime cannot have two verdicts.

title: Her Hair Went White
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Branded a monster and left for dead in Tallow Bay, a woman with hair gone white rises from the deep with an invisible fleet, a ledger of every buried crime, and one name she will not speak until he says it first.

title: We Made It True
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A junior editor at a failing vanity press invents a fake conspiracy about a drowned valley, and when the lie goes viral she must prove the one thing she never invented, the town erased from the record.

title: Ghostwritten
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A copy editor at a legendary New York magazine learns that every famous column by its star writer was ghostwritten by women he used and discarded, including her dead sister.

title: No One Was Ever Charged
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Jailed eleven years for a fire she never set, she returns under a new name to run a night shelter in a freight city that keeps losing its girls. Her conviction ledger is the only record of the missing.

title: Raised to Ruin
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Discovered by a viral photo, a girl from a dying mill town is remade into the flawless face of a legendary New York fashion house, and learns that every gift has a blank line where the payer goes.

title: Burn Her Clean
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Seven years after a fifteenth-century manuscript vanished from the Arden Foundation, its youngest curator is summoned to an internal tribunal that will not name the charge.

title: Every Name He Wore
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When her patron Julian Vane drowns, conservator Nell Ashcombe finds his hidden ledger: seven entries, seven cities, seven false names, seven women he ruined. He was never one man but a gallery.

title: Nobody Earns Gold
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In Aurora, a merit city that ranks every citizen by a public Algorithm, a bronze host is framed and convicted so a golden heir can keep his seat. She has seventy days to prove the gold earned nothing.

title: The Third Vow
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A cook confessed to a poisoning to save the woman who raised her. Twenty two years later her daughter, a court records clerk, finds the file that proves the confession was never hers.

title: The Dead Hand Clause
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A town archivist learns the dead founder's estate scores every resident and rewrites the town's past, and that her marriage settlement is the dead hand still holding the pen.

title: First Offering
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A small-town girl made into a beauty empire's face is destroyed by a teenager's false testimony the house used to protect its own predator. Ten years later she returns under a new name to take it all apart.

title: A Beautiful Weapon
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A girl raised in secret as a beautiful weapon to ruin the family that destroyed her mother becomes the face of their empire, and falls for the one man she was built to break.

title: Say It in the Dark
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nine years ago the Halloran family of Gullhaven drowned a nineteen-year-old girl off the jetty and bought the whole town's silence. Her sister testified, lost her voice, and vanished. Now she is back as the family's quiet ambassador, and the boy who loved her runs the family's dirt from the dark.

title: Gold Daughters
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Augustus Halloway built a fragrance empire on a formula stolen from the chemist who loved him like a brother, then gave everything to the two daughters who now run him like hired help. Solene Ackerly takes the live-in job at Bluff House to keep him alive, and in an air vent she finds the ledger that proves whose name was erased from the founding.

title: He Used Us All
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Miles Corliss came out of the laundry district with no talent and a perfect face, and he climbed The Argus newspaper by taking the words and the women of everyone who could write. Neve Brannigan was nineteen when she wrote the column that made him, and nineteen when he ran her out of the city as another man's kept girl.

title: The Muse Dies Last
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A self-taught seamstress takes a job at a legendary couture house on the Maine coast to find out how her sister, its star model, really died on the night of its show.

title: Glass Oath
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Seven years after she was sworn into the Lattice with two golden heirs, a scholarship prodigy is struck from the roll for a forgery she did not commit. Now she is back inside the Vantage Institute as a sponsored challenger.

title: Approval Rating
author: Apex Shaw
intro: June Halloway is the Symmes political dynasty's best speechwriter and the secret fiancee of its heir. Abducted from the estate gate and held three days, she is put through a live public loyalty interview to prove she was not compromised, then cast out.

title: Everyone Signed but Her
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Willa Cade is the clerk of the deed books and the only notary in Bellhaven, a river town swallowed whole by the Shore Group. When the Group's man brings her a folder that would hand the town's common

title: Clause Twenty-Two
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Yara Ellison is the brightest star of the Ovation Group, a beauty and talent empire whose every contract hides Clause 22, a rule that makes leaving mathematically impossible.

title: Ask Me My Real Name
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A young crisis strategist is planted inside the media empire that destroyed her mother, only to learn that the man she was sent to ruin is the one who once tried to save her.

title: The Paid Mourners
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A young grief counselor returns to the Maine town whose whole economy is a funeral empire built on the murder of her father, and teaches a town of paid mourners how to grieve for real.

title: Nobody's Wife
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In Boston a seamstress traded by her own mother to the old-money family that owns the family debt escapes into a new identity, builds a covert network of women traded the same way, and turns the family private ledger into the weapon that ends them.

title: Mandatory Joy
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In Bellhaven happiness is scored sold and mandatory. Nell Ashby runs the algorithm that ranks every citizen's joy, the same algorithm her erased mother invented and the Marlowe family stole. She has been keeping a second set of books.

title: Salt and Treason
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Ruby Sinclair loses her family's food empire to a corporate raider on the night of its eightieth gala. She rebuilds herself into a strategist and takes it all back, using her grandmother's annotated Art of War.

title: Everything the Strong Take
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A self-made shipping heiress returns to the old-money summer colony that exiled her, buys the mansion across the bay, and takes the family that ruined her apart as a war of alliances and betrayals, one favor and one knife at a time.

title: A Pound of Flesh
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A disgraced bond adjudicator returns to the firm that harvested her brother's kidney under Clause 3.3, one pound of flesh, and takes the machine apart with its own ink, until she finds the clause that beats it: the Bond permits them to take flesh, and nothing else.

title: Everyone's Daughter
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Raised under one rule, never say where you came from, Mari Valcourt passed as the beloved second daughter of a dynasty built on a lie, until she learns the real founder was erased and her mother is the secret they pay to keep.

title: Believe Her
author: Apex Shaw
intro: At seventeen Nell Carver was blamed for a death she never caused. Ten years later she comes home just as someone starts nailing Bellhaven's secrets to every door. Everyone thinks it is her. It is not.

title: The Hundred and Eighth Woman
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Merritt Ashgrove went into prison at twenty two for a fire she did not set, and came out at twenty seven under a false name with a dead cellmate's ledger and a plan to collect from the family that owns the river town of Low Water.

title: Nobody Counts the Girls
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A border city girl invents a comforting myth about where the missing women went, then discovers the myth is the shape of the crime

title: My Other Half Went Viral
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Rebuilt by a management empire into the wholesome creator Nadi, Nadia Voss hides her fury behind a second anonymous account. When that masked half goes viral and starts speaking for her, Nadia must take back her own name from the machine that owns it.

title: The Golden Hour
author: Apex Shaw
intro: At nineteen, Nova Halliday was bought out of her mother's medical debt and installed in the Meridian, the hotel-residence where Bellhaven's richest men keep their women. Seven years later the man who owns her is drowning, and the house that priced her is about to be called in.

title: House of Strangers
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When the revered founder of a Providence perfume dynasty dies, his golden granddaughter finds a second bottle and a buried name, then defects to the disowned family he hid across the river.

title: Nobody Grows Here
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In a Rust Belt company town bought whole by a data-infrastructure giant, a woman who stopped growing the night of the disaster that killed her father lives as her family's forever-child mascot, and drums the truth into every screen in town.

title: Specimen Zero
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In a biotech city built on engineered people, the woman who keeps the official register of every creature Merrow Biotech makes discovers the plague spreading through them runs in her own blood, because she is Specimen Zero, the first one, the child the founding family erased and raised as staff.

title: Test Them All
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Aldecott is the daughter her mother's empire erased. Raised in obscurity under a false name, she returns to Arden Hill as a temp assistant to find Aldecott Media carved up by the board her mother trusted, her inheritance forged away by a 2024 codicil that declares her dead, and seventy days until a succession vote ratifies the theft.

title: Nobody Notices the Help
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nell Waverly was taken into the Sorel family's gated lake estate at fifteen as an unpaid helper, invisible to everyone who mattered. When anonymous cards begin exposing the community's secrets, they blame the girl who was always in the room.

title: Every Rule She Broke
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Raised inside an insular fencing house, Ilsa Brandt trained the one student she was forbidden to love. When a forged video brands her a traitor, the House breaks her hand and casts her out.

title: Paid in Forgetting
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Mara Quill sells her own memories to pay for her sister's cure inside a city where the Ledger owns the truth. Reading a banned book, she starts remembering a fire she never lived. To save what is left of her family she has seventy days to put a forbidden memory back into the machine that decides what the city is allowed to recall.

title: Burn Me Famous
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A small-town girl remade herself into a city socialite and hid the fire that killed her sister. Now the last unburned house in the city is scheduled for clearance, and the man who ordered that fire holds the contract on her name.

title: The Seventh Version
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A year after she was scapegoated for her best friend's death at her own company's gala, a fallen star returns with seven secret confessions and releases one every hour until only the truth is left standing.

title: Carved to Smile
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A disfigured woman hired to record a dying dynasty's centennial stories discovers the ten nights of tales all lead back to the fire that scarred her, and to the family that erased her name.

title: Say Her Name to the Lake
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Eleven years after her daughter Piper drowned in Lake Ossa, a death the Osgood family and the whole town buried, Imogen Farrow rows back across the water to the anniversary sale, and to give the girl her name back.

title: Cold Read
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In a port city whose memory is owned by one company, a forensic reader who can reconstruct any crime from its residue is forced into a public test that turns her gift into a weapon aimed at her own little brother.

title: Sing Back My Name
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In Bellhaven, the anthem every American knows was stolen, and a twenty-four-year-old archivist working in the vault of the label that owns it finds her great-grandmother's voice still buried under the master tape.

title: Borrowed Knife
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A girl who stopped growing at seven, after watching the murder that founded her family fortune, keeps a tin drum that hides the missing page of a stolen deed and dismantles the two feuding houses that made her, using their own knives.

title: The Last Station Is Mercy
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Framed for a fire that killed a man, Rue Delaney served eleven years on an island prison. Now she comes back to Fallhaven under a new name, holding a dead friend's cipher to a hidden fortune, to take apart the three people who buried her, one station at a time, until the last station asks her for mercy.

title: Write Her Off
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A gifted ghostwriter whose manuscript was stolen and published under a famous author's name returns to his literary estate under a false identity to dismantle the house that erased her from within, using its own ledgers and the stories she tells at night.

title: What the River Took
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A nineteen year old arrives at a remote island boarding academy to take a job in its archive and quietly investigate the drowning death of her older sister, and finds the school keeps a ledger of every child it has ever taken in and never let leave.

title: Nobody Here Is Sad
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A broke girl takes a residency at Halcyon, a wellness estate where young women are scored for happiness and the highest number wins the Founder's nightly favor. When her best friend rises to become his favorite and she is blamed for another girl's death, she is cast out as unregulated and comes back to burn the machine down.

title: Our Perfect Enemy
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Maren Sarto was taken at fifteen and rebuilt into the Face of the Renewal, a wellness empire that runs the company town of Verity on the Oregon coast, and when she learns that the movement's war against the Wilders in the hills is a fiction staged by its own security office and that the girl who held her title before her was quietly erased, she turns the movement's total archive against the men who made her.

title: Everyone in This House Killed Me
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Marguerite Vane saw what the Halloway family buried and they killed her inside their house. The house would not let her go. Every time it kills her she wakes at the service gate in a new body, hired as new help, until the sixth life, when the family hires her under her own name to write their one hundred year history.

title: Perfectly Obedient
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A coal town's most ungovernable woman learns that a handsome outsider has wagered his fortune that he can make her publicly obey him before the Fourth of July, so she decides to let him win, all the way to the day she stands up at his family's gala and reads out the order that killed fourteen men.

title: Proof of Absence
author: Apex Shaw
intro: The invisible woman who writes every word a New England city believes builds a perfect alibi to bury one night, while the detective who once buried her own truth is the only one who can pull it back up.

title: The Seventh Witness
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A true-crime producer returns to the company town that raised her, is mistaken for the auditor the ruling family fears, and collects six self-serving versions of the night a fire killed her mother.

title: The Heir They Buried
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A probate genealogist is hired by the family that ruined her mother to find the missing heir of a dead desert town's water trust. She is the heir.

title: The Unlisted Wife
author: Apex Shaw
intro: For eleven years Nell Corrigan has kept every record at Greyhaven, the Ashgrove family's Hudson Valley estate, without asking why her own mother's name was struck from them. Ten weeks before the family's centennial gala she opens a room walled shut since 2001 and finds the marriage certificate that proves the Ashgrove fortune was built on erasing her mother, and decides to put her mother back into the record.

title: The Last True Version
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A disgraced creator infiltrates a prestige media empire where every woman is rewritten for profit, then turns its own archive into a weapon.

title: Every Name She Kept
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A fired archive assistant discovers a viral voice memoir was stolen from her dead immigrant mother and weaponizes the startup's own conspiracy to expose its founder.

title: The Apology Queue
author: Apex Shaw
intro: At a university that turns private apologies into viral content, a framed student has seventy-two hours to expose the edit before the school deletes its endangered-language archive.

title: The Saint of Signal Street
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Seven years after the flood that made her a saint, Cora Vaughn learns the city already owns her story. When her body starts failing, she picks up her father's tape and takes the pen back.

title: Wet Concrete Never Lies
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A structural engineer with failing lungs returns to the mountain town where the tower she secretly designed is about to be credited to the man who buried her name.

title: Let Them Confess
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Eleven years ago a thirteen year old signed a statement that put a composer in prison for a fire he did not set. Now the town pays for confessions, her sister sells the version that flatters them, and the erased one comes home as the archivist of the record.

title: He Came as Nobody
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Nomi Bhandari built one capsule and one company in Halcyon Springs, and in eleven years she lost her name, her shares, and her freedom to a financier who wanted her face on his product.

title: No One Gets to Be Oz
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A disgraced former child creator joins a cross-country story contest to reclaim her stolen identity, then turns each confession into evidence against the media mogul who owns the contestants' lives.

title: She Was the Formula
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A young perfumer marries into the century old fragrance dynasty whose bestseller was written by a wife they slowly froze to death, and discovers her own name was already entered in their ledger three years before she met them.

title: They Made Us Beautiful
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Bellamy Bay, Florida. A skincare empire grows its miracle serum in flooded sinkholes, and the girls who dive for it are paid nineteen cents an ounce. Nissa Bell signs ten years of her face to the company that owns her town, steals the ledger, and loses everything. Five years later she comes home to flood them.

title: The Island That Loves You
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Wren Alder was nine when the boathouse burned and took her sight and her mother. For fifteen years Halcyon Island called her its miracle and taught her hymns instead of the truth. When a surgeon restores her eyes, she reads the charter she was raised to recite and finds Appendix C.

title: She Kept the Record
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Halstead, Michigan keeps one book. The Chronicle records every birth, hire, death and removal in town, and for sixty years the mayor has quietly rebound the pages that told the truth. Yuna Hahm, night clerk, has been copying it since she was seventeen.

title: My Father's Best Seller
author: Apex Shaw
intro: August Vallone's memoir sold two million copies and made him a saint. Odessa has read it eleven times, and she knows which page he left her out of, because she was in the house the whole time.

title: Tell It to the Well
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A hospice nurse hired to sit with a dying water baron is the granddaughter of the wife he erased. When a wildfire traps ten women in his house, she gets ten nights to collect the stories that will take his empire apart.

title: Sunlight Clause
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Rue Ferrante grew up in the servants wing of Alder House and was expelled at fifteen. Eleven years later she returns owning the family debt, and carrying the one thing the Alder dynasty cannot live without, which is her own body.

title: Find Me Before October
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A broke skip tracer is hired by a dying shipyard patriarch to find the heir who vanished the night of a fire eleven years ago, before a trust deadline hands the whole fortune to the town saint who killed his mother.

title: Her Handwriting, His Words
author: Apex Shaw
intro: Eighteen years ago a town laughed at a letter a girl was made to write in her own hand. She is back as the state trustee for the poisoned water under that town, and every well in it answers to her.

title: He Never Wrote a Word
author: Apex Shaw
intro: For twelve years Nora Quinn wrote every word Hollis Dunn was praised for. On the Sunday she decides to take her name back, a torn page arrives in the mail in her own handwriting, signed by the only man she ever let go.

title: Nobody Waters a Dead Hedge
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A housekeeper's daughter has seventy-two hours to save the coastal estate she grew up on, using the dead owner's book of fables, one forged signature, and the twelve families who live in the cottages.

title: Every Hand Went Up
author: Apex Shaw
intro: A marine chemist is publicly destroyed at her town's founding ceremony by a forged recording and a staged photograph, declared dead six weeks later, and returns seven months on under another name to make nine hundred peo

title: The Town That Wrote Back
author: Apex Shaw
intro: The last all-night diner on Mercy Street is being demolished by a 1974 clause nobody read. Nessa Quill cannot raise her voice above a whisper, so she writes in the window instead, and the town writes back.

title: Speak Well of Me
author: Apex Shaw
intro: In Pellow, Pennsylvania, everyone listens to Nell Voss, the voice of the town's rising political star. What nobody knows is that at thirteen she buried a man under the town's showpiece building, and that her foster sister Birdie, a court interpreter paid to say other people's words and forbidden to say her own, has been holding the shovel ever since. A Deaf mother's lawsuit and a new foundation dig are about to open the concrete.

title: Maybe Tomorrow
author: Apex Shaw
intro: When a Basin Authority gate opens without warning and drowns her grandfather on the last crossing of the night, ferryman Wren Aubrey learns that in Kestrel Bend nothing exists until it is stamped. The district office will not certify the death, and its clerk has one answer: maybe tomorrow. So she learns the paperwork better than they do, and files it back to them forty-one names at a time.
